Server.Name: AdminService
Server.Source:
-- 클로즈 테스트 입장 제한 + 테스터용 관리자 패널(F2) 명령
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local Cosmetics = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Cosmetics)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local CrateService = require(script.Parent.CrateService)
local MatchService = require(script.Parent.MatchService)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)
local Telemetry = require(script.Parent.TelemetryService)

local AdminService = {}

local function inList(list, userId)
	for _, id in ipairs(list) do
		if id == userId then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function AdminService.IsAdmin(player)
	return RunService:IsStudio() or inList(Config.CBT.Admins, player.UserId)
end

-- 이 명령을 지금 서버에서 쓸 수 있는지 (정식 서버에서는 치트 차단)
function AdminService.CommandAllowed(action)
	return RunService:IsStudio() or Config.DevTools or Config.OpsCommands[action] == true
end

function AdminService.CanJoin(player)
	if not Config.CBT.Enabled or RunService:IsStudio() then
		return true
	end
	if inList(Config.CBT.Testers, player.UserId) or inList(Config.CBT.Admins, player.UserId) then
		return true
	end
	if Config.CBT.GroupId ~= 0 then
		local ok, rank = pcall(function()
			return player:GetRankInGroup(Config.CBT.GroupId)
		end)
		if ok and rank >= Config.CBT.GroupMinRank then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local missionDefaults = { First = Config.MissionFirstDelay, Interval = Config.MissionInterval }

local ACTIONS = {}

ACTIONS.time = function(player, n)
	n = tonumber(n) or 30
	if MatchService.SetTimeLeft(n) then
		return "남은 시간 " .. n .. "초로 변경"
	end
	return "경기/카운트다운 중에만 가능"
end

ACTIONS.endMatch = function()
	if MatchService.SetTimeLeft(0) then
		return "경기를 종료합니다"
	end
	return "진행 중인 경기 없음"
end

ACTIONS.coins = function(player, n)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	n = math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 5000, -1000000, 1000000)
	p.Coins = math.max(0, p.Coins + n)
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return string.format("코인 %+d -> %d", n, p.Coins)
end

ACTIONS.unlockAll = function(player)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	for _, w in ipairs(Weapons.List) do
		p.Owned[w.Id] = true
	end
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return "모든 무기 해금"
end

ACTIONS.crate = function(player, n)
	n = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 1), 1, 50)
	local counts = {}
	local last = nil
	for _ = 1, n do
		last = CrateService.Open(player)
		if last then
			counts[last.RarityName] = (counts[last.RarityName] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(Cosmetics.Rarities) do
		table.insert(parts, string.format("%s %d", r.Name, counts[r.Name] or 0))
	end
	return string.format("무료 개봉 %d회: %s", n, table.concat(parts, " · "))
end

ACTIONS.bots = function()
	Config.FillWithBots = not Config.FillWithBots
	return "봇 채우기: " .. (Config.FillWithBots and "켜짐" or "꺼짐") .. " (다음 경기부터)"
end

ACTIONS.rankedBots = function()
	Config.RankedAllowBots = not Config.RankedAllowBots
	return "봇 포함 랭크 반영: " .. (Config.RankedAllowBots and "켜짐" or "꺼짐")
end

ACTIONS.fastMissions = function()
	if Config.MissionInterval == missionDefaults.Interval then
		Config.MissionFirstDelay = 3
		Config.MissionInterval = 27
		return "빠른 미션: 켜짐 (다음 경기부터 3초 후 시작, 27초 간격)"
	end
	Config.MissionFirstDelay = missionDefaults.First
	Config.MissionInterval = missionDefaults.Interval
	return "빠른 미션: 꺼짐"
end

ACTIONS.special = function(player)
	local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	if not e then
		return "경기 중에만 가능"
	end
	e.Special = Config.SpecialCells
	Combatants.Sync(e)
	return "스페셜 게이지 100%"
end

ACTIONS.rating = function(player, n)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	p.Rating = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(n) or Config.Rating.Start))
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return "레이팅 " .. p.Rating .. " (" .. Config.GetTier(p.Rating).Name .. ")"
end

ACTIONS.resetProfile = function(player)
	DataService.Reset(player)
	player:SetAttribute("FirstMatch", true)
	return "내 데이터 초기화 (첫 접속 상태)"
end

ACTIONS.nextMap = function(player, arg)
	return "다음 경기 맵: " .. MatchService.SetNextMap(arg)
end

ACTIONS.balance = function()
	return Telemetry.BalanceReport()
end

ACTIONS.feedback = function()
	return Telemetry.FeedbackList()
end

function AdminService.Init(remotes)
	remotes.Admin.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, arg)
		if not AdminService.IsAdmin(player) then
			return { ok = false, msg = "관리자 권한 없음" }
		end
		local fn = ACTIONS[action]
		if not fn then
			return { ok = false, msg = "알 수 없는 명령" }
		end
		if not AdminService.CommandAllowed(action) then
			return { ok = false, msg = "정식 서버에서는 사용할 수 없는 개발자 명령" }
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(fn, player, arg)
		print(string.format("[SplashFront][관리자] %s -> %s(%s): %s", player.Name, tostring(action), tostring(arg), tostring(result)))
		if not ok then
			return { ok = false, msg = "오류: " .. tostring(result) }
		end
		return { ok = true, msg = result }
	end
end

-- 입장 시 호출: 허용되지 않으면 내보냄
function AdminService.Gate(player)
	if not AdminService.CanJoin(player) then
		player:Kick(Config.CBT.KickMessage)
		return false
	end
	player:SetAttribute("IsAdmin", AdminService.IsAdmin(player))
	player:SetAttribute("DevTools", RunService:IsStudio() or Config.DevTools)
	return true
end

return AdminService

Server.Name: BotService
Server.Source:
-- 인원이 부족할 때 자리를 채우는 간단한 AI 봇
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)
local CombatService = require(script.Parent.CombatService)

local BotService = {}

local BOT_NAMES = { "Splatty", "NeonNinja", "DripKing", "PaintPanda", "Chromo", "Spritz", "Gloopy", "Blotto",
	"Inkredible", "Hue_Jack", "Smudge", "PrismPop", "Dribble", "Tagger", "Vandal_V", "Swatch" }
local nameIndex = 0
local goalProvider = nil
local cellsFolder = nil
local running = false
local state = {} -- entity -> { Goal, GoalTime, LastPos, StuckTime, Strafe }

function BotService.NextName()
	nameIndex = nameIndex % #BOT_NAMES + 1
	return "[BOT] " .. BOT_NAMES[nameIndex]
end

function BotService.RandomWeapon()
	local pool = { "Pistol", "Rifle", "SMG", "Shotgun", "Launcher", "Rifle" }
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

function BotService.SetGoalProvider(fn)
	goalProvider = fn
end

function BotService.SetCells(folder)
	cellsFolder = folder
end

function BotService.CreateModel(e, cframe, color)
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Bots"
		folder.Parent = workspace
	end
	local desc = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
	local model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	model.Name = e.Name
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	hum.MaxHealth = Config.MaxHealth
	hum.Health = Config.MaxHealth
	hum.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
	hum.DisplayName = e.Name
	hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d.Name == "UpperTorso" or d.Name == "LowerTorso" then
				d.Color = color
			elseif d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
				d.Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55)
			end
		end
	end
	-- 총·헬멧·백팩은 MatchService가 플레이어와 똑같이 붙임 (ModelKit)
	model:PivotTo(cframe)
	model.Parent = folder
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end
	state[e] = { Goal = nil, GoalTime = 0, LastPos = cframe.Position, StuckTime = 0, Strafe = 1 }
	return model
end

local function canSee(e, fromPos, target)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { e.Model, workspace:FindFirstChild("FX") }
	local dir = target.Position - fromPos
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(fromPos, dir, params)
	return hit and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target.Parent)
end

local function randomEnemyCell(e)
	if not cellsFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local cells = cellsFolder:GetChildren()
	if #cells == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local root = e.Model.HumanoidRootPart
	local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
	for _ = 1, 14 do
		local c = cells[math.random(1, #cells)]
		if c:GetAttribute("Owner") ~= e.OwnerId then
			local score = (c.Position - root.Position).Magnitude + math.random() * 25
			if score < bestScore then
				best, bestScore = c, score
			end
		end
	end
	return best and best.Position or cells[math.random(1, #cells)].Position
end

local function spreadDir(dir, degrees)
	if degrees <= 0 then
		return dir.Unit
	end
	local r = math.rad(degrees)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, dir)
	local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local m = math.random() * r
	return (cf * CFrame.Angles(math.cos(a) * m, math.sin(a) * m, 0)).LookVector
end

local function fireAt(e, head, targetPos, extraSpread)
	local w = Weapons.Get(e.WeaponId)
	local dirs = {}
	local base = targetPos - head.Position
	for i = 1, w.Pellets do
		dirs[i] = spreadDir(base, w.Spread + (extraSpread or 0))
	end
	CombatService.Fire(e, head.Position, dirs)
	-- 다른 플레이어 화면에서 봇 상체·팔이 표적 쪽으로 기울도록
	if e.Model and base.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		local pitch = math.floor(math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(base.Unit.Y, -1, 1))) + 0.5)
		if math.abs((e.Model:GetAttribute("AimPitch") or 0) - pitch) >= 3 then
			e.Model:SetAttribute("AimPitch", pitch)
		end
	end
end

local function think(e)
	local model = e.Model
	local hum = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = model and model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not hum or not root or not head or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local s = state[e]
	if not s then
		s = { Goal = nil, GoalTime = 0, LastPos = root.Position, StuckTime = 0, Strafe = 1 }
		state[e] = s
	end
	local w = Weapons.Get(e.WeaponId)
	local now = os.clock()

	-- 1) 보이는 가장 가까운 적
	local target, targetDist = nil, w.Range * 0.85
	for _, other in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
		if other.Alive and Combatants.IsEnemy(e, other) and other.Model then
			local tr = other.Model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or other.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if tr then
				local d = (tr.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
				if d < targetDist and canSee(e, head.Position, tr) then
					target, targetDist = tr, d
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if target then
		-- 교전: 좌우로 흔들며 사격
		if math.random() < 0.15 then
			s.Strafe = -s.Strafe
		end
		local side = (target.Position - root.Position):Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
		if side.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			hum:MoveTo(root.Position + side.Unit * 6 * s.Strafe)
		end
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, Vector3.new(target.Position.X, root.Position.Y, target.Position.Z))
		if e.Ink >= w.InkCost then
			local aimErr = 1.5 + targetDist * 0.04
			fireAt(e, head, target.Position + Vector3.new(0, math.random() * 0.8, 0), aimErr)
		end
		if e.Special >= Config.SpecialCells and math.random() < 0.3 then
			CombatService.UseSpecial(e, target.Position)
		end
		return
	end

	-- 2) 목표 지점으로 이동하며 바닥 칠하기
	local goalNeeded = (not s.Goal) or (now - s.GoalTime > 6) or ((s.Goal - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude < 4
	if goalNeeded then
		local g = nil
		if goalProvider and math.random() < 0.55 then
			g = goalProvider(e)
		end
		s.Goal = g or randomEnemyCell(e)
		s.GoalTime = now
	end
	if s.Goal then
		hum:MoveTo(s.Goal)
		if e.Ink > 25 then
			local flat = (s.Goal - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				local aimPoint = root.Position + flat.Unit * math.min(w.Range * 0.6, 14) - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				fireAt(e, head, aimPoint, 3)
			end
		end
		if e.Special >= Config.SpecialCells and math.random() < 0.05 then
			CombatService.UseSpecial(e, s.Goal)
		end
	end

	-- 3) 끼임 탈출
	if (root.Position - s.LastPos).Magnitude < 0.5 then
		s.StuckTime = s.StuckTime + 0.2
		if s.StuckTime > 1.2 then
			-- 앞이 낭떠러지(스카이 루프탑 빌딩 사이)면 뛰지 않고 목표만 바꿈
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model }
			local ahead = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 5 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			if workspace:Raycast(ahead, Vector3.new(0, -25, 0), params) then
				hum.Jump = true
			end
			s.Goal = nil
			s.StuckTime = 0
		end
	else
		s.StuckTime = 0
	end
	s.LastPos = root.Position
end

function BotService.Start()
	if running then
		return
	end
	running = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while running do
			for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
				if e.IsBot and e.Alive then
					local ok, err = pcall(think, e)
					if not ok then
						warn("[SplashFront] bot error:", err)
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end)
end

function BotService.Stop()
	running = false
	state = {}
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
	if folder then
		folder:ClearAllChildren()
	end
end

return BotService

Server.Name: CityMap
Server.Source:
-- 맵 3: 시가전 (Big City)
-- Studio 인벤토리에서 넣은 "BigCity" 모델(ServerStorage 또는 ServerStorage.Maps 안)을 복제해 전장으로 씀.
-- 모델 안의 스크립트는 안전을 위해 모두 지우고, 도로·광장처럼 평평한 바닥을 위에서 쏘아 찾아 페인트 셀을 깐다.
-- 카툰 외곽선·흰색 팔레트·표면 텍스처는 적용하지 않음 (원본 질감 + 사실적인 흐린 오후 조명)
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local CityMap = {}

local CELL = Config.CellSize
local ORIGIN = Vector3.new(2800, 0, 0) -- 다른 맵과 겹치지 않는 곳
local MAX_X, MAX_Z = 380, 260          -- 전투 구역 최대 크기 (도시가 더 크면 가운데만 사용)
local WALL_H = 160

local function findSource()
	local names = { "BigCity", "Big City", "Big_City" }
	for _, holder in ipairs({ ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Maps"), ServerStorage, workspace }) do
		if holder then
			for _, n in ipairs(names) do
				local m = holder:FindFirstChild(n)
				if m and (m:IsA("Model") or m:IsA("Folder")) then
					return m
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function wall(parent, size, pos)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = "CityBoundary"
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = pos
	p.Transparency = 1
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function cell(parent, pos)
	local c = Instance.new("Part")
	c.Name = "Cell"
	c.Anchored = true
	c.Size = Vector3.new(CELL - 0.08, 0.2, CELL - 0.08)
	c.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
	c.Color = Config.NeutralColor
	c.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	c.CanCollide = false
	c.CanTouch = false
	c.CastShadow = false
	c.Transparency = 1 -- 판정용 격자, 화면의 페인트는 클라이언트 PaintVisual이 그림
	c:SetAttribute("Owner", 0)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

function CityMap.Build()
	local src = findSource()
	if not src then
		warn("[SplashFront] 시가전 맵: ServerStorage에 'BigCity' 모델이 없어 건너뜀")
		return nil
	end
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena_City")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "Arena_City"
	root.Parent = workspace
	local cells = Instance.new("Folder")
	cells.Name = "Cells"
	cells.Parent = root

	local geo = src:Clone()
	geo.Name = "Geometry"
	-- 무료 모델 안의 스크립트(바이러스·지연 로딩 등)는 실행되지 않게 제거
	for _, d in ipairs(geo:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BaseScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local model = geo
	if not geo:IsA("Model") then
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "Geometry"
		for _, c in ipairs(geo:GetChildren()) do
			c.Parent = model
		end
		geo:Destroy()
	end
	model.Parent = root
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
		elseif d:IsA("Sound") then
			d:Stop()
		end
	end
	-- 모델 중심을 ORIGIN으로
	local bcf, bsize = model:GetBoundingBox()
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + (ORIGIN - bcf.Position) + Vector3.new(0, bsize.Y / 2, 0))
	bcf, bsize = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local top = bcf.Position.Y + bsize.Y / 2 + 5
	local bottom = bcf.Position.Y - bsize.Y / 2

	-- 바닥 높이 = 위에서 쏜 광선이 가장 많이 닿은 높이 (도로)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model }
	local hx = math.min(bsize.X / 2 - 6, MAX_X / 2)
	local hz = math.min(bsize.Z / 2 - 6, MAX_Z / 2)
	-- 긴 쪽을 X(팀 진영 방향)로
	local swap = hz > hx
	local hist = {}
	local samples = {}
	local x = -hx + CELL / 2
	while x < hx do
		local z = -hz + CELL / 2
		while z < hz do
			local p = ORIGIN + Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p.X, top, p.Z), Vector3.new(0, bottom - top - 5, 0), params)
			if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.9 then
				local key = math.floor(hit.Position.Y + 0.5)
				hist[key] = (hist[key] or 0) + 1
				table.insert(samples, { X = p.X, Z = p.Z, Y = hit.Position.Y })
			end
			z = z + CELL
		end
		x = x + CELL
	end
	local groundY, best = bottom, 0
	for k, n in pairs(hist) do
		if n > best then
			groundY, best = k, n
		end
	end

	-- 바닥 셀: 도로 높이 ±3 이내의 평평한 곳만 (건물 지붕 아래·내부는 제외)
	local list = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(samples) do
		if math.abs(s.Y - groundY) <= 3 then
			local c = cell(cells, Vector3.new(s.X, s.Y, s.Z))
			table.insert(list, c)
		end
	end

	-- 전투 구역 경계 (투명 벽 + 천장)
	local cx, cz = ORIGIN.X, ORIGIN.Z
	local midY = groundY + WALL_H / 2
	wall(root, Vector3.new(hx * 2 + 4, WALL_H, 2), Vector3.new(cx, midY, cz - hz - 1))
	wall(root, Vector3.new(hx * 2 + 4, WALL_H, 2), Vector3.new(cx, midY, cz + hz + 1))
	wall(root, Vector3.new(2, WALL_H, hz * 2 + 4), Vector3.new(cx - hx - 1, midY, cz))
	wall(root, Vector3.new(2, WALL_H, hz * 2 + 4), Vector3.new(cx + hx + 1, midY, cz))
	wall(root, Vector3.new(hx * 2 + 4, 2, hz * 2 + 4), Vector3.new(cx, groundY + WALL_H, cz))
	-- 바닥 아래 안전판 (모델 바닥에 구멍이 있어도 떨어지지 않게)
	local floor = wall(root, Vector3.new(hx * 2 + 4, 2, hz * 2 + 4), Vector3.new(cx, groundY - 1.2, cz))
	floor.Name = "CitySafetyFloor"

	-- 먼 배경: 도시 둘레의 낮은 산 능선 (대기 안개에 실루엣으로 보이도록 어두운 녹갈색, 충돌·판정 없음)
	local backdrop = Instance.new("Folder")
	backdrop.Name = "Backdrop"
	backdrop.Parent = root
	local rng = Random.new(1957)
	local ringR = math.max(bsize.X, bsize.Z) / 2 + 260
	local count = 28
	for i = 1, count do
		local ang = (i / count) * math.pi * 2 + rng:NextNumber(-0.06, 0.06)
		local h = rng:NextNumber(90, 210)
		local w = rng:NextNumber(220, 360)
		local r = ringR + rng:NextNumber(-40, 80)
		local pos = Vector3.new(cx + math.cos(ang) * r, groundY + h / 2 - 6, cz + math.sin(ang) * r)
		local face = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(cx, pos.Y, cz))
		for k = -1, 1, 2 do
			local wdg = Instance.new("WedgePart")
			wdg.Name = "Ridge"
			wdg.Anchored = true
			wdg.CanCollide = false
			wdg.CanQuery = false
			wdg.CanTouch = false
			wdg.CastShadow = false
			wdg.Material = Enum.Material.Ground
			wdg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62 + rng:NextInteger(-8, 8), 66 + rng:NextInteger(-8, 8), 52)
			wdg.Size = Vector3.new(w * 0.9, h, w / 2)
			-- 쐐기 두 개를 등지게 붙여 삼각 능선
			wdg.CFrame = face * CFrame.new(0, 0, -k * w / 4) * CFrame.Angles(0, k == 1 and 0 or math.pi, 0)
			wdg.Parent = backdrop
		end
	end
	local base = Instance.new("Part")
	base.Name = "OuterGround"
	base.Anchored = true
	base.CanCollide = false
	base.CanQuery = false
	base.CastShadow = false
	base.Material = Enum.Material.Ground
	base.Color = Color3.fromRGB(72, 70, 58)
	base.Size = Vector3.new(ringR * 2.4, 1, ringR * 2.4)
	base.Position = Vector3.new(cx, groundY - 3, cz)
	base.Parent = backdrop

	-- 진영 축: 긴 쪽
	local function axisPos(a, b) -- a = 진영 축 좌표, b = 옆 축 좌표
		if swap then
			return Vector3.new(cx + b, groundY, cz + a)
		end
		return Vector3.new(cx + a, groundY, cz + b)
	end
	local along = swap and hz or hx
	local function axisOf(c)
		local d = c.Position - ORIGIN
		return swap and d.Z or d.X, swap and d.X or d.Z
	end

	-- 스폰: 양 끝 거리 18 이내의 바닥 셀 중 옆으로 흩어진 5곳
	local function pickEnd(sign)
		local cand = {}
		for _, c in ipairs(list) do
			local a = axisOf(c)
			if a * sign > along - 22 then
				table.insert(cand, c)
			end
		end
		table.sort(cand, function(p, q)
			local _, bp = axisOf(p)
			local _, bq = axisOf(q)
			return bp < bq
		end)
		local out = {}
		local n = #cand
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local c = cand[math.max(1, math.floor(n * (i - 0.5) / 5 + 0.5))]
			if c then
				local pos = c.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
				table.insert(out, CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(cx, pos.Y, cz)))
			end
		end
		if #out == 0 then
			local pos = axisPos(sign * (along - 10), 0) + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			table.insert(out, CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(cx, pos.Y, cz)))
		end
		return out
	end
	local spawns = { [1] = pickEnd(-1), [2] = pickEnd(1) }

	-- 셀 중 목표 지점에 가장 가까운 바닥
	local function nearestGround(target)
		local bestC, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, c in ipairs(list) do
			local d = (Vector3.new(c.Position.X, 0, c.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(target.X, 0, target.Z)).Magnitude
			if d < bestD then
				bestC, bestD = c, d
			end
		end
		return bestC and (bestC.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)) or target
	end
	local side = swap and hx or hz
	local solo = {}
	for _, p in ipairs({ { -0.9, 0 }, { 0.9, 0 }, { 0, 0.8 }, { 0, -0.8 }, { -0.5, 0.7 }, { 0.5, -0.7 }, { 0.5, 0.7 }, { -0.5, -0.7 } }) do
		local g = nearestGround(axisPos(p[1] * along, p[2] * side)) + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
		table.insert(solo, CFrame.lookAt(g, Vector3.new(cx, g.Y, cz)))
	end
	local missionSpots = {}
	for _, p in ipairs({ { 0, 0 }, { -0.35, 0.5 }, { 0.35, -0.5 }, { -0.35, -0.5 }, { 0.35, 0.5 }, { 0, 0.6 }, { 0, -0.6 }, { -0.5, 0 }, { 0.5, 0 } }) do
		table.insert(missionSpots, nearestGround(axisPos(p[1] * along, p[2] * side)))
	end

	print(string.format("[SplashFront] 시가전 맵 준비: 바닥 셀 %d개, 도로 높이 %.1f, 전투 구역 %dx%d", #list, groundY, hx * 2, hz * 2))
	return {
		Id = "BigCity",
		Name = "시가전",
		Folder = root,
		Geometry = model,
		Cells = cells,
		Spawns = spawns,
		SoloSpawns = solo,
		FlagPoints = {
			{ Name = "A", Position = nearestGround(axisPos(0, -0.55 * side)) },
			{ Name = "C", Position = nearestGround(axisPos(0, 0)) },
			{ Name = "B", Position = nearestGround(axisPos(0, 0.55 * side)) },
		},
		MissionSpots = missionSpots,
		BaseCenters = { [1] = axisPos(-(along - 10), 0), [2] = axisPos(along - 10, 0) },
		KillY = groundY - 40,
		Lighting = "City",
		NoTextures = true,
		Realistic = true,
		TeamBanners = {},
	}
end

return CityMap

Server.Name: CombatService
Server.Source:
-- 사격·피해·스페셜·잉크/체력 회복 (서버 권한 판정)
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)
local PaintService = require(script.Parent.PaintService)

local CombatService = {}

local remotes = nil
local colorOf = function()
	return Config.NeutralColor
end
local active = false

function CombatService.Init(remoteFolder)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	remotes.Fire.OnServerEvent:Connect(CombatService.OnPlayerFire)
	remotes.Special.OnServerEvent:Connect(CombatService.OnPlayerSpecial)
end

function CombatService.SetActive(on)
	active = on
end

function CombatService.SetColorResolver(fn)
	colorOf = fn
end

local function rootOf(e)
	local m = e.Model
	return m and m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function humanoidOf(e)
	local m = e.Model
	return m and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function headOf(e)
	local m = e.Model
	return m and m:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

local function fxFolder()
	local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "FX"
		f.Parent = workspace
	end
	return f
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 피해
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function CombatService.Damage(attacker, victim, amount, headshot, hitPos)
	if not victim.Alive then
		return false
	end
	if os.clock() < victim.ProtectedUntil then
		return false
	end
	local hum = humanoidOf(victim)
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	victim.LastDamaged = os.clock()
	victim.LastAttacker = attacker
	victim.LastHeadshot = headshot
	local newHealth = math.max(0, hum.Health - amount)
	hum.Health = newHealth
	local killed = newHealth <= 0

	if attacker and attacker.Player then
		remotes.HitConfirm:FireClient(attacker.Player, {
			Damage = math.floor(amount + 0.5), Head = headshot, Pos = hitPos, Kill = killed,
		})
	end
	if victim.Player then
		local from = rootOf(attacker or victim)
		local color = attacker and colorOf(attacker.OwnerId) or nil
		remotes.Damaged:FireClient(victim.Player, from and from.Position or hitPos, amount, color)
	end
	return killed
end

local function splashDamage(attacker, center, radius, maxDamage)
	for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
		if e.Alive and Combatants.IsEnemy(attacker, e) then
			local r = rootOf(e)
			if r then
				local d = (r.Position - center).Magnitude
				if d <= radius then
					local dmg = maxDamage * (1 - 0.5 * (d / radius))
					CombatService.Damage(attacker, e, dmg, false, r.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 명중 보정 (지연 보상): 서버에서 보는 적 위치는 쏜 사람 화면보다 조금 늦으므로
-- 레이가 적 머리·몸통 가까이(허용 거리 안) 지나가면 명중으로 인정. 벽 뒤는 인정 안 함
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local BODY_PARTS = { "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }
local function assistHit(e, origin, dir, maxDist, params)
	local A = Config.HitAssist
	if not A then
		return nil
	end
	local best, bestT, bestHead = nil, math.huge, false
	for _, v in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
		if v.Alive and v.Model and Combatants.IsEnemy(e, v) then
			local function perpOf(part)
				local rel = part.Position - origin
				local t = rel:Dot(dir)
				if t <= 0 or t > maxDist then
					return math.huge, t
				end
				return (rel - dir * t).Magnitude, t
			end
			local head = v.Model:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local hp, ht = math.huge, 0
			if head then
				hp, ht = perpOf(head)
			end
			local bp, bt = math.huge, 0
			for _, n in ipairs(BODY_PARTS) do
				local part = v.Model:FindFirstChild(n)
				if part then
					local p2, t2 = perpOf(part)
					if p2 < bp then
						bp, bt = p2, t2
					end
				end
			end
			local isHead, t = nil, nil
			if hp <= A.Head + ht * A.PerStud then
				isHead, t = true, ht
			elseif bp <= A.Body + bt * A.PerStud then
				isHead, t = false, bt
			end
			if t and t < bestT then
				-- 시야 확인: 맞힌 지점까지 벽이 없어야 함
				local p = origin + dir * t
				local block = workspace:Raycast(origin, p - origin, params)
				if not block or Combatants.FromPart(block.Instance) == v or (block.Position - origin).Magnitude >= t - 1.5 then
					best, bestT, bestHead = v, t, isHead
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		return best, bestHead, origin + dir * bestT
	end
	return nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 사격 (플레이어·봇 공용)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 쏜 사람 화면에서 맞힌 지점(claim)을 검증: 그 캐릭터가 서버에서도 근처에 있고, 탄도 위에 있고, 벽에 막히지 않았으면 인정
local function verifyClaim(e, origin, dir, range, claim)
	local K = Config.HitClaim
	if not K or type(claim) ~= "table" or typeof(claim.Part) ~= "Instance" or typeof(claim.Pos) ~= "Vector3" then
		return nil
	end
	if not claim.Part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	local v = Combatants.FromPart(claim.Part)
	if not v or not v.Alive or not Combatants.IsEnemy(e, v) then
		return nil
	end
	local rel = claim.Pos - origin
	local t = rel:Dot(dir)
	if t <= 0 or t > range or (rel - dir * t).Magnitude > K.MaxPerp then
		return nil
	end
	if (claim.Part.Position - claim.Pos).Magnitude > K.MaxMove + claim.Part.Size.Magnitude / 2 then
		return nil
	end
	-- 시야: 캐릭터들을 빼고 지형만으로 막히는지
	local ignore = { e.Model, fxFolder(), workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots") }
	for _, o in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
		if o.Model then
			table.insert(ignore, o.Model)
		end
	end
	local mp = RaycastParams.new()
	mp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	mp.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	if workspace:Raycast(origin, rel * 0.98, mp) then
		return nil
	end
	local part = claim.Part
	local isHead = part.Name == "Head"
	if not isHead and part.Parent and part.Parent:IsA("Accessory") then
		for _, a in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if a:IsA("Attachment") and (string.find(a.Name, "Hat") or string.find(a.Name, "Hair") or string.find(a.Name, "Face")) then
				isHead = true
			end
		end
	end
	local target = isHead and (v.Model:FindFirstChild("Head") or part) or part
	return { Instance = target, Position = claim.Pos, Normal = -dir }
end

function CombatService.Fire(e, origin, directions, claims)
	if not active or not e.Alive then
		return false
	end
	local w = Weapons.Get(e.WeaponId)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - e.LastFire < w.FireInterval * 0.75 then
		return false
	end
	-- 황금총: 잉크 없이 1발, 맞으면 무조건 처치, 쏘면 사라짐
	local golden = e.Golden == true
	if not golden and e.Ink < w.InkCost then
		return false
	end
	local head = headOf(e)
	if not head or (head.Position - origin).Magnitude > 10 then
		return false
	end
	e.LastFire = now
	local range = w.Range
	if golden then
		e.Golden = false
		if e.Player then
			e.Player:SetAttribute("Golden", false)
		end
		range = Config.GoldenRange
	else
		e.Ink = e.Ink - w.InkCost
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { e.Model, fxFolder(), workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") }

	local endpoints = {}
	local count = golden and math.min(#directions, 1) or math.min(#directions, w.Pellets)
	for i = 1, count do
		local dir = directions[i]
		if typeof(dir) == "Vector3" and dir.Magnitude > 0.5 then
			dir = dir.Unit
			e.Shots = (e.Shots or 0) + 1
			local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * range, params)
			local endPos
			-- 서버 레이가 빗나갔으면(지연 때문에 적이 서버에서 조금 옆에 있음) 플레이어 사격에 한해
			-- 1) 쏜 사람 화면의 명중 판정을 검증해 인정  2) 그래도 없으면 탄도 근처 적 보정
			local directVictim = result and Combatants.FromPart(result.Instance)
			if e.Player and not (directVictim and Combatants.IsEnemy(e, directVictim)) then
				local claimed = verifyClaim(e, origin, dir, range, type(claims) == "table" and claims[i] or nil)
				if claimed then
					result = claimed
				else
					local maxDist = result and ((result.Position - origin).Magnitude + 1) or range
					local v, isHead, pos = assistHit(e, origin, dir, maxDist, params)
					if v then
						local part = v.Model:FindFirstChild(isHead and "Head" or "UpperTorso") or v.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						result = { Instance = part, Position = pos, Normal = -dir }
					end
				end
			end
			if result then
				endPos = result.Position
				local victim = Combatants.FromPart(result.Instance)
				if victim then
					if Combatants.IsEnemy(e, victim) then
						local isHead = result.Instance.Name == "Head"
						e.Hits = (e.Hits or 0) + 1
						if isHead then
							e.Headshots = (e.Headshots or 0) + 1
						end
						local dmg = golden and 9999 or (w.Damage * (isHead and w.HeadMul or 1))
						CombatService.Damage(e, victim, dmg, isHead, endPos)
						PaintService.PaintBelow(endPos, 2.5, e.OwnerId, e)
					end
				elseif result.Normal.Y > 0.5 then
					PaintService.PaintAt(endPos, w.PaintRadius, e.OwnerId, e)
				else
					-- 벽에 맞으면 아래로 흘러내림
					PaintService.PaintBelow(endPos + result.Normal * 1.5, w.PaintRadius * 0.7, e.OwnerId, e)
				end
				if w.Splash > 0 then
					splashDamage(e, endPos, w.Splash, w.Damage)
					PaintService.PaintBelow(endPos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), w.PaintRadius, e.OwnerId, e)
				end
			else
				endPos = origin + dir * range
				PaintService.PaintBelow(endPos, w.PaintRadius * 0.7, e.OwnerId, e)
			end
			if w.PathPaint then
				local dist = math.min((endPos - origin).Magnitude, w.PathMax or 240)
				local step = w.PathStep or 7
				local d = step
				while d < dist do
					PaintService.PaintBelow(origin + dir * d, w.PathRadius or 2.5, e.OwnerId, e)
					d = d + step
				end
			end
			table.insert(endpoints, endPos)
		end
	end

	remotes.FX:FireAllClients("Tracer", {
		Shooter = e.Player, From = origin, To = endpoints, Color = golden and Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40) or colorOf(e.OwnerId), Weapon = w.Id,
		Model = e.Model, Golden = golden,
	})
	Combatants.Sync(e)
	return true
end

function CombatService.OnPlayerFire(player, weaponId, origin, directions, claims)
	local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	if not e or typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or type(directions) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if weaponId ~= e.WeaponId then
		return
	end
	CombatService.Fire(e, origin, directions, claims)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 스페셜: 크로마 봄
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 투척물: 포물선으로 날아가다 바닥·벽·캐릭터에 닿는 순간 onLand(위치) 호출
-- 클라이언트는 같은 초기값(From·Vel·G)으로 공을 그리고 ProjEnd에서 터뜨림
local projCount = 0
function CombatService.Throw(e, target, kind, color, onLand)
	local head = headOf(e)
	if not head or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end
	local T = Config.Throw
	local from = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	local offset = target - from
	if offset.Magnitude > 75 then
		target = from + offset.Unit * 75
		offset = target - from
	end
	local g = Vector3.new(0, -T.Gravity, 0)
	local flight = math.clamp(offset.Magnitude / T.Speed, 0.25, 1.4)
	local vel = offset / flight - g * (0.5 * flight)
	projCount = projCount + 1
	local id = projCount
	remotes.FX:FireAllClients("Proj", { Id = id, From = from, Vel = vel, G = g, Color = color, Kind = kind })
	task.spawn(function()
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { e.Model, fxFolder(), workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") }
		local pos, v, t = from, vel, 0
		local hitPos = nil
		local last = os.clock()
		while t < T.MaxTime and active do
			task.wait()
			local step = math.min(os.clock() - last, 0.1)
			last = os.clock()
			local nv = v + g * step
			local np = pos + (v + nv) * (0.5 * step)
			local r = workspace:Raycast(pos, np - pos, params)
			if r then
				hitPos = r.Position + r.Normal * 0.3
				break
			end
			-- 몸에 스치듯 지나가도 터지게 (근접 신관)
			for _, o in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
				if o ~= e and o.Alive then
					local root = rootOf(o)
					if root and (root.Position - np).Magnitude < 2.6 then
						hitPos = np
					end
				end
			end
			if hitPos then
				break
			end
			pos, v, t = np, nv, t + step
		end
		hitPos = hitPos or pos
		remotes.FX:FireAllClients("ProjEnd", { Id = id, Pos = hitPos, Kind = kind, Color = color, Radius = Config.SpecialRadius })
		if onLand then
			onLand(hitPos)
		end
	end)
	return true
end

function CombatService.UseSpecial(e, target)
	if not active or not e.Alive or e.Special < Config.SpecialCells then
		return false
	end
	if not headOf(e) or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end
	e.Special = 0
	Combatants.Sync(e)
	local color = colorOf(e.OwnerId)
	if CombatService.OnSpecialUsed and e.Player then
		CombatService.OnSpecialUsed(e.Player)
	end
	CombatService.Throw(e, target, "Bomb", color, function(pos)
		if not active then
			return
		end
		PaintService.PaintBelow(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Config.SpecialRadius, e.OwnerId, e)
		PaintService.PaintAt(pos, Config.SpecialRadius * 0.6, e.OwnerId, e)
		splashDamage(e, pos, Config.SpecialRadius, Config.SpecialDamage)
	end)
	return true
end

function CombatService.OnPlayerSpecial(player, target)
	local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	if e then
		CombatService.UseSpecial(e, target)
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 잉크 충전·체력 회복 (Main 루프에서 0.1초마다 호출)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
function CombatService.Tick(dt)
	if not active then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
		if e.Alive then
			local root = rootOf(e)
			if root then
				if now - e.LastFire > Config.InkRefillDelay and e.Ink < Config.InkMax then
					local own = PaintService.OwnerBelow(root.Position) == e.OwnerId
					local rate = own and Config.InkRefillOwnColor or Config.InkRefill
					e.Ink = math.min(Config.InkMax, e.Ink + rate * dt)
				end
				local hum = humanoidOf(e)
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth and now - e.LastDamaged > Config.RegenDelay then
					hum.Health = math.min(hum.MaxHealth, hum.Health + Config.RegenPerSecond * dt)
				end
			end
			Combatants.Sync(e)
		end
	end
end

return CombatService

Server.Name: Combatants
Server.Source:
-- 매치 참가자(플레이어 + 봇) 레지스트리
-- entity = { Id, Name, IsBot, Player, Model, OwnerId, TeamId, WeaponId,
--            Ink, Special, Kills, Deaths, Cells, LastFire, LastDamaged,
--            ProtectedUntil, Spread, Alive }
local Signal = require(script.Parent.Signal)
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)

local Combatants = {}
Combatants.Painted = Signal.new()   -- (entity, cellsChanged)
Combatants.Killed = Signal.new()    -- (killerEntity|nil, victimEntity, headshot)

local byId = {}
local byModel = {}

function Combatants.New(fields)
	local e = {
		Id = fields.Id,
		Name = fields.Name,
		IsBot = fields.IsBot or false,
		Player = fields.Player,
		Model = nil,
		OwnerId = fields.OwnerId,
		TeamId = fields.TeamId,
		WeaponId = fields.WeaponId or "Pistol",
		Ink = Config.InkMax,
		Special = 0,
		Kills = 0,
		Deaths = 0,
		Cells = 0,
		MissionWins = 0,
		LastFire = 0,
		LastDamaged = 0,
		ProtectedUntil = 0,
		Spread = 0,
		Alive = false,
		Coins = 0,
	}
	byId[e.Id] = e
	return e
end

function Combatants.SetModel(e, model)
	if e.Model then
		byModel[e.Model] = nil
	end
	e.Model = model
	if model then
		byModel[model] = e
	end
end

function Combatants.Remove(e)
	if e.Model then
		byModel[e.Model] = nil
	end
	byId[e.Id] = nil
end

function Combatants.Clear()
	byId = {}
	byModel = {}
end

function Combatants.FromModel(model)
	return byModel[model]
end

function Combatants.FromPart(part)
	local node = part
	while node and node ~= workspace do
		local e = byModel[node]
		if e then
			return e
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

function Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	return byId["P" .. player.UserId]
end

function Combatants.All()
	local list = {}
	for _, e in pairs(byId) do
		table.insert(list, e)
	end
	return list
end

function Combatants.IsEnemy(a, b)
	return a ~= b and a.TeamId ~= b.TeamId
end

-- 플레이어 HUD 동기화용 (속성은 자동 복제됨)
function Combatants.Sync(e)
	if e.Player then
		e.Player:SetAttribute("Ink", math.floor(e.Ink + 0.5))
		e.Player:SetAttribute("Special", math.min(1, e.Special / Config.SpecialCells))
		e.Player:SetAttribute("MatchKills", e.Kills)
		e.Player:SetAttribute("MatchCells", e.Cells)
	end
end

return Combatants

Server.Name: CrateService
Server.Source:
-- 크로마 크레이트(랜덤 상자) 개봉 + 외형 장착
-- 실제 판매: Creator Hub에서 79 R$ 개발자 상품을 만들고 Config.Monetization.CrateProductId에 ID 입력
-- Studio에서는 상품 ID 없이 "테스트 개봉" 버튼으로 확률·연출 확인 가능
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Cosmetics = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Cosmetics)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local Telemetry = require(script.Parent.TelemetryService)

local CrateService = {}

local rng = Random.new()
local remotes = nil

-- 상자 하나 개봉. 결과 테이블 반환 (구매 처리 성공 후에만 호출)
function CrateService.Open(player)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	if not p then
		return nil
	end
	p.CratePity = (p.CratePity or 0) + 1
	p.CratesOpened = (p.CratesOpened or 0) + 1
	local pityHit = p.CratePity >= Cosmetics.PityCount
	local item, rarity = Cosmetics.Roll(rng, pityHit)
	if rarity.Id == "Legendary" then
		p.CratePity = 0
	end
	local duplicate = p.Cosmetics[item.Id] == true
	local refund = 0
	if duplicate then
		refund = rarity.Refund
		p.Coins = p.Coins + refund
	else
		p.Cosmetics[item.Id] = true
	end
	DataService.Publish(player)
	DataService.Save(player)
	Telemetry.Custom(player, "CrateOpen", 1, rarity.Id, item.Id, duplicate and "dup" or "new")
	if refund > 0 then
		Telemetry.Economy(player, true, refund, p.Coins, "Gameplay", "CrateRefund")
	end
	local result = {
		ItemId = item.Id, Name = item.Name, Kind = item.Kind, Rarity = rarity.Id, RarityName = rarity.Name,
		Color = rarity.Color, Duplicate = duplicate, Refund = refund, Pity = p.CratePity, Pitied = pityHit,
	}
	remotes.CrateResult:FireClient(player, result)
	return result
end

function CrateService.Equip(player, itemId)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	local item = Cosmetics.ById[itemId]
	if not p then
		return { ok = false, msg = "데이터 없음" }
	end
	if itemId == nil then
		return { ok = false, msg = "잘못된 요청" }
	end
	if not item or not p.Cosmetics[itemId] then
		return { ok = false, msg = "보유하지 않은 아이템" }
	end
	local slot = (item.Kind == "Skin" and "EquippedSkin") or (item.Kind == "Pattern" and "EquippedPattern") or "EquippedEffect"
	if p[slot] == itemId then
		p[slot] = nil -- 다시 누르면 해제
		DataService.Publish(player)
		return { ok = true, msg = item.Name .. " 해제" }
	end
	p[slot] = itemId
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return { ok = true, msg = item.Name .. " 장착" }
end

-- Studio 전용 무료 테스트 개봉
function CrateService.TestOpen(player)
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then
		return { ok = false, msg = "테스트 개봉은 Studio에서만 가능해요" }
	end
	CrateService.Open(player)
	return { ok = true, msg = "테스트 개봉" }
end

function CrateService.Init(remoteFolder)
	remotes = remoteFolder
end

return CrateService

Server.Name: DataService
Server.Source:
-- 플레이어 저장 데이터 (코인, 보유 무기, 장착 무기, 레이팅, 통계)
-- Studio에서 저장하려면: 게임 설정 > 보안 > "Studio의 API 서비스 액세스 사용" 켜기
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)

local DataService = {}

local store = nil
pcall(function()
	store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SplashFront_Profile_" .. Config.DataVersion)
end)

local profiles = {}

local function defaultProfile()
	return {
		Coins = 300,
		Owned = { [Weapons.Default] = true },
		Equipped = Weapons.Default,
		Rating = Config.Rating.Start,
		Wins = 0,
		Matches = 0,
		Kills = 0,
		Cells = 0,
		Cosmetics = {},          -- [아이템 Id] = true
		EquippedSkin = nil,
		EquippedPattern = nil,
		EquippedEffect = nil,
		CratePity = 0,           -- 마지막 레전더리 이후 개봉 수
		CratesOpened = 0,
		Level = 1,
		XP = 0,
		Quests = {},             -- QuestService가 관리 (기간 키 + 진행도)
	}
end

local function ownedString(owned)
	local list = {}
	for id, v in pairs(owned) do
		if v then
			table.insert(list, id)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return table.concat(list, ",")
end

function DataService.Publish(player)
	local p = profiles[player]
	if not p then
		return
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Coins", p.Coins)
	player:SetAttribute("Rating", p.Rating)
	player:SetAttribute("Tier", Config.GetTier(p.Rating).Name)
	player:SetAttribute("Weapon", p.Equipped)
	player:SetAttribute("Owned", ownedString(p.Owned))
	player:SetAttribute("Wins", p.Wins)
	player:SetAttribute("Skin", p.EquippedSkin)
	player:SetAttribute("Pattern", p.EquippedPattern)
	player:SetAttribute("KillEffect", p.EquippedEffect)
	player:SetAttribute("OwnedCosmetics", ownedString(p.Cosmetics or {}))
	player:SetAttribute("CratePity", p.CratePity or 0)
	player:SetAttribute("Level", p.Level or 1)
	player:SetAttribute("XP", p.XP or 0)
	player:SetAttribute("XPNeed", Config.XPNeed(p.Level or 1))
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls then
		ls.Rating.Value = p.Rating
		ls.Wins.Value = p.Wins
	end
end

function DataService.Load(player)
	local data = nil
	local failed = false
	if store then
		-- 일시적 오류는 몇 번 다시 시도. 끝내 실패하면 이번 접속은 저장하지 않음 (빈 데이터로 덮어써 구매품을 잃지 않게)
		failed = true
		for attempt = 1, 4 do
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return store:GetAsync("u" .. player.UserId)
			end)
			if ok then
				data = result
				failed = false
				break
			end
			warn("[SplashFront] 데이터 불러오기 실패(" .. attempt .. "/4):", result)
			task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
		end
	end
	local p = defaultProfile()
	if type(data) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(data) do
			p[k] = v
		end
		if type(p.Owned) ~= "table" then
			p.Owned = { [Weapons.Default] = true }
		end
		p.Owned[Weapons.Default] = true
		if type(p.Cosmetics) ~= "table" then
			p.Cosmetics = {}
		end
	end
	p.LoadFailed = failed or nil
	profiles[player] = p
	if failed then
		player:SetAttribute("DataWarning", "저장 데이터를 불러오지 못했어요. 이번 접속의 구매·진행은 저장되지 않으니 잠시 후 다시 접속해 주세요")
	end

	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	local r = Instance.new("IntValue")
	r.Name = "Rating"
	r.Parent = ls
	local w = Instance.new("IntValue")
	w.Name = "Wins"
	w.Parent = ls
	ls.Parent = player

	-- VIP 게임패스
	local vip = false
	if Config.Monetization.VipGamePassId ~= 0 then
		pcall(function()
			vip = MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, Config.Monetization.VipGamePassId)
		end)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Vip", vip)

	player:SetAttribute("FirstMatch", (p.Matches or 0) == 0)
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return p
end

-- 경험치: 레벨업하면 코인 보너스. 반환: 이번에 오른 레벨 수
function DataService.AddXP(player, amount)
	local p = profiles[player]
	if not p or amount <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	p.Level = p.Level or 1
	p.XP = (p.XP or 0) + math.floor(amount)
	local ups = 0
	while p.XP >= Config.XPNeed(p.Level) do
		p.XP = p.XP - Config.XPNeed(p.Level)
		p.Level = p.Level + 1
		ups = ups + 1
		p.Coins = p.Coins + Config.LevelReward(p.Level)
		player:SetAttribute("LevelUp", p.Level .. ":" .. Config.LevelReward(p.Level) .. ":" .. os.clock())
	end
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return ups
end

function DataService.Reset(player)
	local p = defaultProfile()
	p.ForceReset = true -- 관리자 초기화: 이번 저장은 합치지 않고 덮어씀
	profiles[player] = p
	DataService.Publish(player)
	DataService.Save(player)
end

-- 보유 목록은 합집합으로 저장: 다른 서버가 먼저 저장한 구매품이 있어도 절대 지워지지 않음
local function union(a, b)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(type(a) == "table" and a or {}) do
		if v then
			out[k] = true
		end
	end
	for k, v in pairs(type(b) == "table" and b or {}) do
		if v then
			out[k] = true
		end
	end
	return out
end

function DataService.Save(player)
	local p = profiles[player]
	if not p or not store or p.LoadFailed then
		return false
	end
	for attempt = 1, 3 do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync("u" .. player.UserId, function(old)
				if type(old) == "table" and not p.ForceReset then
					p.Owned = union(old.Owned, p.Owned)
					p.Cosmetics = union(old.Cosmetics, p.Cosmetics)
				end
				p.SavedAt = os.time()
				local copy = table.clone(p)
				copy.LoadFailed = nil
				copy.ForceReset = nil
				return copy
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			p.ForceReset = nil
			return true
		end
		warn("[SplashFront] 저장 실패(" .. attempt .. "/3):", err)
		task.wait(attempt)
	end
	return false
end

function DataService.IsSafe(player)
	local p = profiles[player]
	return p ~= nil and not p.LoadFailed
end

function DataService.Get(player)
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.AddCoins(player, amount)
	local p = profiles[player]
	if not p then
		return 0
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("Vip") then
		amount = math.floor(amount * Config.VipCoinMul + 0.5)
	end
	p.Coins = p.Coins + amount
	DataService.Publish(player)
	return amount
end

function DataService.Unload(player)
	DataService.Save(player)
	profiles[player] = nil
end

function DataService.Start()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(DataService.Unload)
	game:BindToClose(function()
		-- 서버 종료: 모두 동시에 저장하고 끝날 때까지 기다림
		local pending = 0
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			pending = pending + 1
			task.spawn(function()
				DataService.Save(pl)
				pending = pending - 1
			end)
		end
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 25 do
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(120)
			for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				DataService.Save(pl)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DataService

Server.Name: ImageService
Server.Source:
-- 업로드한 이미지(데칼)를 게임에 적용
-- 1) 데칼 ID → 실제 이미지 주소 (InsertService로 데칼을 불러와 Texture 속성을 읽음)
-- 2) ReplicatedStorage.Images 폴더 속성으로 공유 (클라이언트 HUD 아이콘: "icon_coin" 등)
-- 3) 맵 표면에 Texture(타일 반복) 입히기 — 판정용 모양은 그대로
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local AssetIds = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AssetIds)

local ImageService = {}

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Images"
folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local urls = {}  -- "tex_floor_tile" -> "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=..."

local function resolve(decalId)
	local ok, asset = pcall(function()
		return InsertService:LoadAsset(decalId)
	end)
	if not ok or not asset then
		warn("[SplashFront] 이미지 불러오기 실패:", decalId, asset)
		return nil
	end
	local d = asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true) or asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture", true)
	local url = d and d.Texture
	asset:Destroy()
	if url and url ~= "" then
		return url
	end
	return nil
end

function ImageService.Load()
	local n = 0
	for group, list in pairs({ tex = AssetIds.Textures or {}, icon = AssetIds.Icons or {} }) do
		for name, id in pairs(list) do
			if id ~= 0 then
				local url = resolve(id)
				if url then
					urls[group .. "_" .. name] = url
					folder:SetAttribute(group .. "_" .. name, url)
					n = n + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	print("[SplashFront] 이미지", n, "개 준비 (없는 이미지는 단색·이모지로 대체)")
end

function ImageService.Url(key)
	return urls[key]
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 맵 표면 텍스처
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local F = Enum.NormalId
local SIDES = { F.Front, F.Back, F.Left, F.Right }
local ALL = { F.Top, F.Bottom, F.Front, F.Back, F.Left, F.Right }

-- 이름 → { 텍스처, 면 목록, 타일 크기(U, V), 색 입히기 여부 }
local RULES = {
	Floor = { "floor_tile", { F.Top }, 8, 8 },
	Platform = { { "floor_tile", { F.Top }, 8, 8 }, { "wall_panel", SIDES, 8, 8 } },
	MidTower = { { "floor_tile", { F.Top }, 8, 8 }, { "wall_panel", SIDES, 24, 24 } },
	SpawnTower = { { "floor_tile", { F.Top }, 8, 8 }, { "wall_panel", SIDES, 24, 24 } },
	WarehouseRoof = { "floor_tile", { F.Top }, 8, 8 },
	Wall = { "wall_panel", { F.Top, F.Front, F.Back, F.Left, F.Right }, 8, 8 },
	WarehouseWall = { "wall_panel", { F.Top, F.Front, F.Back, F.Left, F.Right }, 8, 8 },
	Boundary = { "wall_panel", SIDES, 8, 8 },
	SpawnWall = { "wall_panel", SIDES, 8, 8 },
	Parapet = { "wall_panel", { F.Top, F.Front, F.Back, F.Left, F.Right }, 6, 6 },
	Lintel = { "wall_panel", SIDES, 8, 8 },
	WallSill = { "hazard", { F.Top, F.Front, F.Back }, 3, 3 },
	Crate = { "crate_wood", ALL, 8, 3 },
	Container = { "container_rib", SIDES, 12.8, 7, true },
	Ramp = { "ramp_plate", { F.Top }, 6, 6 },
	Stage = { "ramp_plate", { F.Top }, 8, 8, true },
}

local function apply(part, texName, faces, u, v, tint)
	local url = urls["tex_" .. texName]
	if not url then
		return
	end
	for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
		local t = Instance.new("Texture")
		t.Name = "SF_Tex"
		t.Texture = url
		t.Face = face
		t.StudsPerTileU = u
		t.StudsPerTileV = v
		if tint then
			t.Color3 = part.Color
		end
		t.Parent = part
	end
end

function ImageService.ApplyTextures(root, overrides)
	if not next(urls) then
		return
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "Cell" and p.Transparency < 0.5 then
			local rule = (overrides and overrides[p.Name]) or RULES[p.Name]
			if rule then
				if type(rule[1]) == "table" then
					for _, r in ipairs(rule) do
						apply(p, r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5])
					end
				else
					apply(p, rule[1], rule[2], rule[3], rule[4], rule[5])
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 로비: 어두운 바닥에 타일 무늬를 보라빛으로 물들여 깔기
ImageService.LobbyRules = {
	Floor = { "floor_tile", { F.Top }, 10, 10, true },
	Stage = { "ramp_plate", { F.Top }, 6, 6, true },
}

return ImageService

Server.Name: ItemService
Server.Source:
-- 미션 보상 아이템: 보관(최대 3개) · 사용(F) · 순서 바꾸기(G) · 효과 시간 관리
-- 보관함은 플레이어 속성 "Items"(쉼표 목록)로 클라이언트에 보임
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ModelKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ModelKit)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)
local CombatService = require(script.Parent.CombatService)

local ItemService = {}

local remotes = nil
local inv = {}   -- player -> { itemId, ... }
local ById = {}
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
	ById[it.Id] = it
end
ItemService.ById = ById

local function now()
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function publish(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Items", table.concat(inv[player] or {}, ","))
end

local function notify(player, text, color)
	if remotes then
		remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, text, color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120))
	end
end

function ItemService.Grant(player, id)
	if not ById[id] then
		return
	end
	local list = inv[player] or {}
	inv[player] = list
	table.insert(list, id)
	while #list > Config.ItemSlots do
		table.remove(list, 1) -- 가득 차면 가장 오래된 것부터 버림
	end
	publish(player)
	player:SetAttribute("LastItem", id .. ":" .. tostring(os.clock()))
end

function ItemService.GrantRandom(player)
	local total = 0
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		total = total + (it.Weight or 1)
	end
	local r = math.random() * total
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		r = r - (it.Weight or 1)
		if r <= 0 then
			ItemService.Grant(player, it.Id)
			return it
		end
	end
end

function ItemService.Clear(player)
	inv[player] = {}
	publish(player)
	for _, a in ipairs({ "JetpackUntil", "ShieldUntil", "ZoomBuff", "ZoomUntil", "Golden" }) do
		player:SetAttribute(a, nil)
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 효과
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function torsoOf(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
end

local function attachJetpack(e, color)
	local model = e.Model
	local torso = torsoOf(model)
	if not torso then
		return
	end
	local old = model:FindFirstChild("SF_Jetpack")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local pack = model:FindFirstChild("SF_Backpack")
	if pack then
		pack:Destroy() -- 잉크 탱크 대신 제트팩을 멤
	end
	local jp = ModelKit.Item("Jetpack", color)
	jp.Name = "SF_Jetpack"
	for _, p in ipairs(jp:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Massless = true
		end
	end
	jp:PivotTo(torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, torso.Size.Z / 2 + 0.2))
	for _, p in ipairs(jp:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = false
			local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			w.Part0 = torso
			w.Part1 = p
			w.Parent = p
		end
	end
	-- 노즐 불꽃 (모두에게 보임)
	for _, a in ipairs(jp:GetDescendants()) do
		if a:IsA("Attachment") and a.Name == "Flame" then
			local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 160), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 30))
			pe.LightEmission = 1
			pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
			pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.18, 0.3)
			pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 14)
			pe.Rate = 60
			pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Left -- 원기둥을 세웠으므로 로컬 -X = 아래
			pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(8, 8)
			pe.Parent = a
			local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
			l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)
			l.Range = 8
			l.Brightness = 2
			l.Parent = a
		end
	end
	jp.Parent = model
end

local function spawnSmoke(pos, duration)
	local fx = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX") or workspace
	local cloud = Instance.new("Model")
	cloud.Name = "SmokeCloud"
	local R = Config.SmokeRadius
	local rng = Random.new()
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local a = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
		local d = rng:NextNumber(0, R * 0.55)
		local size = rng:NextNumber(R * 0.75, R * 1.1)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = "Puff"
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		p.Size = Vector3.one * 2
		p.Position = pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * d, rng:NextNumber(2, 6), math.sin(a) * d)
		p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(rng:NextInteger(205, 230), rng:NextInteger(208, 232), rng:NextInteger(215, 238))
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Transparency = 0.6
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false -- 총알은 통과(시야만 가림)
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Parent = cloud
		TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.6 + i * 0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = Vector3.one * size, Transparency = 0.04 }):Play()
		task.delay(duration - 1.5, function()
			if p.Parent then
				TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(1.4), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			end
		end)
	end
	local core = cloud:FindFirstChild("Puff")
	if core then
		local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(230, 232, 240))
		pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(4, 9)
		pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1)
		pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 3)
		pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
		pe.Rate = 12
		pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		pe.Parent = core
		task.delay(duration - 2, function()
			pe.Enabled = false
		end)
	end
	cloud.Parent = fx
	Debris:AddItem(cloud, duration + 0.5)
end

local function use(player, target)
	local list = inv[player]
	local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	if not list or #list == 0 then
		return
	end
	if not e or not e.Alive or not player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
		notify(player, "아이템은 경기 중에 쓸 수 있어요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 120))
		return
	end
	local id = list[1]
	local def = ById[id]
	local color = player:GetAttribute("TeamColor") or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	if id == "Jetpack" then
		player:SetAttribute("JetpackUntil", now() + def.Duration)
		attachJetpack(e, color)
	elseif id == "Shield" then
		e.ProtectedUntil = os.clock() + def.Duration
		player:SetAttribute("ShieldUntil", now() + def.Duration)
		if e.Model then
			local ff = Instance.new("ForceField")
			ff.Name = "SF_Shield"
			ff.Visible = true
			ff.Parent = e.Model
			Debris:AddItem(ff, def.Duration)
		end
	elseif id == "Smoke" then
		if typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end
		CombatService.Throw(e, target, "Smoke", Color3.fromRGB(220, 224, 232), function(pos)
			spawnSmoke(pos, def.Duration)
		end)
	elseif id == "Golden" then
		e.Golden = true
		player:SetAttribute("Golden", true)
		local gun = e.Model and e.Model:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun")
		if gun then
			ModelKit.SetGolden(gun, true)
		end
	elseif id == "Zoom3" or id == "Zoom6" then
		player:SetAttribute("ZoomBuff", def.Zoom)
		player:SetAttribute("ZoomUntil", now() + def.Duration)
	end
	table.remove(list, 1)
	publish(player)
	notify(player, def.Name .. " 사용!", Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 200))
	if ItemService.OnUsed then
		ItemService.OnUsed(player, id)
	end
end

local function cycle(player)
	local list = inv[player]
	if list and #list > 1 then
		table.insert(list, table.remove(list, 1))
		publish(player)
	end
end

function ItemService.Init(remoteFolder)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	remotes.UseItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, target)
		if action == "use" then
			use(player, target)
		elseif action == "cycle" then
			cycle(player)
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl)
		inv[pl] = nil
	end)
	-- 효과 시간 만료 처리
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.25)
			local t = now()
			for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local ju = pl:GetAttribute("JetpackUntil")
				if ju and t > ju then
					pl:SetAttribute("JetpackUntil", nil)
					local jp = pl.Character and pl.Character:FindFirstChild("SF_Jetpack")
					if jp then
						jp:Destroy()
					end
				end
				local su = pl:GetAttribute("ShieldUntil")
				if su and t > su then
					pl:SetAttribute("ShieldUntil", nil)
				end
				local zu = pl:GetAttribute("ZoomUntil")
				if zu and t > zu then
					pl:SetAttribute("ZoomUntil", nil)
					pl:SetAttribute("ZoomBuff", nil)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	-- 황금총을 쏘면(서버가 Golden=false) 총 색을 되돌림
	local function watch(pl)
		pl:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Golden"):Connect(function()
			if not pl:GetAttribute("Golden") then
				local gun = pl.Character and pl.Character:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun")
				if gun then
					ModelKit.SetGolden(gun, false, pl:GetAttribute("TeamColor"))
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		watch(pl)
	end
end

-- 부활할 때 황금총이 남아 있으면 새 총도 금색으로
function ItemService.OnSpawn(e)
	if e.Player and e.Golden and e.Model then
		local gun = e.Model:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun")
		if gun then
			ModelKit.SetGolden(gun, true)
		end
	end
end

return ItemService

-- 조준 각도·자세 공유 (자주 보내므로 신뢰성 없는 이벤트)
do
	local pose = Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent")
	pose.Name = "Pose"
	pose.Parent = remotes
	local STANCES = { Normal = true, Run = true, Walk = true, Crouch = true }
	pose.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(pl, pitch, stance)
		if type(pitch) == "number" and pitch == pitch then
			local p = math.clamp(math.floor(pitch + 0.5), -70, 70)
			if math.abs((pl:GetAttribute("AimPitch") or 0) - p) >= 2 then
				pl:SetAttribute("AimPitch", p)
			end
		end
		if STANCES[stance] and pl:GetAttribute("Stance") ~= stance then
			pl:SetAttribute("Stance", stance)
		end
	end)
end
for _, name in ipairs({ "Shop", "Admin", "Feedback", "Leaderboard" }) do

	f.Parent = remotes
end

}
-- 시가전: ServerStorage에 BigCity 모델이 있을 때만 추가
do
	local ok, city = pcall(require(script.Parent.CityMap).Build)
	if ok and city then

	elseif not ok then

	end
end

-- 업로드한 표면 텍스처·HUD 아이콘 (없으면 단색·이모지로 대체)
ImageService.Load()
ImageService.ApplyTextures(lobby.Folder, ImageService.LobbyRules)
for _, m in ipairs(maps) do
	if not m.NoTextures then
		ImageService.ApplyTextures(m.Folder)
	end
end
local activeCells = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
activeCells.Name = "ActiveCells" -- 클라이언트가 현재 맵의 바닥 셀을 찾는 용도
activeCells.Value = maps[1].Cells
activeCells.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
PaintService.Init(maps[1].Cells)

-- 서비스
Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false
DataService.Start()
CombatService.Init(remotes)
ShopService.Init(remotes)
MatchService.Init(remotes, maps, lobby)
Telemetry.Init(remotes)
AdminService.Init(remotes)
RankService.StartBoard(lobby.Leaderboard)

QuestService.Init(remotes)
CombatService.OnSpecialUsed = function(pl)
	QuestService.Add(pl, "Specials", 1)
end
ItemService.OnUsed = function(pl)

end

-- 전투 틱 (잉크 충전·체력 회복)
task.spawn(function()
	local last = os.clock()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		local t = os.clock()
		CombatService.Tick(t - last)
		last = t
	end

local function onPlayer(player)
	if not AdminService.Gate(player) then
		return
	end
	player.DevEnableMouseLock = false -- Shift는 달리기 (기본 시프트락 끔)

					end
				end)
			end
		end)

end

print("[SplashFront] 서버 준비 완료 (빌드 " .. Config.Build .. ") — 로비의 발판을 밟아 매치에 참가하세요")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local MapBuilder = {}

local function part(props)
	local p = Instance.new(props.Wedge and "WedgePart" or "Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 84, 96)
	p.Size = props.Size
	if props.CFrame then
		p.CFrame = props.CFrame
	else
		p.Position = props.Position
	end
	p.Name = props.Name or "Part"
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.CanCollide == false then
		p.CanCollide = false
	end
	if props.CanQuery == false then
		p.CanQuery = false
	end
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	p.Parent = props.Parent
	return p
end

local function label(parentPart, text, face, textSize)

-- 경사로: x1(낮은 쪽)에서 x2(높은 쪽)으로 height만큼 오르는 판
local function ramp(parent, x1, x2, z, width, baseY, height)
	local len = math.abs(x2 - x1)
	local slope = math.sqrt(len * len + height * height)
	local angle = math.atan(height / len)
	if x2 < x1 then
		angle = -angle
	end
	local mid = Vector3.new((x1 + x2) / 2, baseY + height / 2 - 0.5, z)
	return part({
		Name = "Ramp", Parent = parent, Size = Vector3.new(slope, 1, width),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(mid) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 140), Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate,
	})
end

-- 맵별 조명 (레퍼런스: 낮게 뜬 해 + 눈부심, 햇살 줄기, 따뜻한 대기 안개, 입체 구름, 먼 곳 살짝 흐림)

local PRESETS = {

		Sat = 0.18, Con = 0.1, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 242, 248), Bloom = 0.6, Thresh = 1.4,
		Rays = 0.1, RaySpread = 0.8, Dof = 0.12, Clouds = { Cover = 0.5, Density = 0.55, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 236) }, Sun = 18 },
	-- 시가전: 레퍼런스 1번처럼 지평선 가까운 해, 주황빛 먼지 안개, 햇살 번짐, 먼 건물은 실루엣
	City = { Clock = 17.75, Lat = 25, Bright = 2.6, Amb = Color3.fromRGB(110, 86, 78), Out = Color3.fromRGB(150, 118, 100), Spec = 1,
		AtmDensity = 0.42, AtmOffset = 0.25, AtmColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 150), AtmDecay = Color3.fromRGB(176, 104, 74), Haze = 2.6, Glare = 1.6,
		Sat = 0.06, Con = 0.14, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 208), Bloom = 0.7, Thresh = 1.15,
		Rays = 0.16, RaySpread = 0.85, Dof = 0.28, Clouds = { Cover = 0.62, Density = 0.7, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 160) }, Sun = 22 },
}
local function ensure(class, parent)
	local o = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(class)
	if not o then
		o = Instance.new(class)
		o.Parent = parent
	end
	return o
end

function MapBuilder.ApplyLighting(name)
	local p = PRESETS[name] or PRESETS.Day
	Lighting.ClockTime = p.Clock
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = p.Lat or 35
	Lighting.Brightness = p.Bright
	Lighting.Ambient = p.Amb
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = p.Out
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = p.Spec
	local a = ensure("Atmosphere", Lighting)
	a.Density, a.Offset, a.Color, a.Decay, a.Haze, a.Glare = p.AtmDensity, p.AtmOffset or 0.15, p.AtmColor, p.AtmDecay, p.Haze, p.Glare
	local cc = ensure("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
	cc.Saturation, cc.Contrast, cc.TintColor = p.Sat, p.Con, p.Tint
	local b = ensure("BloomEffect", Lighting)
	b.Intensity, b.Threshold, b.Size = p.Bloom, p.Thresh, 28
	local rays = ensure("SunRaysEffect", Lighting)
	rays.Intensity, rays.Spread = p.Rays or 0.06, p.RaySpread or 0.6
	local dof = ensure("DepthOfFieldEffect", Lighting)
	dof.FarIntensity = p.Dof or 0.1
	dof.NearIntensity = 0
	dof.FocusDistance = 40
	dof.InFocusRadius = 90
	local sky = ensure("Sky", Lighting)
	sky.SunAngularSize = p.Sun or 14
	local clouds = ensure("Clouds", workspace.Terrain)
	if p.Clouds then
		clouds.Enabled = true
		clouds.Cover, clouds.Density, clouds.Color = p.Clouds.Cover, p.Clouds.Density, p.Clouds.Color
	else
		clouds.Enabled = false
	end
end

function MapBuilder.SetupLighting()
	-- 0.6: 밝은 한낮 카툰 톤 (흰 구조물 위에 진한 팀 페인트가 또렷하게)
	Lighting.ClockTime = 14.2
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = 35
	Lighting.Brightness = 3
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 146, 165)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(165, 172, 192)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.6
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.25
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	if not Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere") then
		local a = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		a.Density = 0.27
		a.Offset = 0.15
		a.Color = Color3.fromRGB(199, 222, 255)
		a.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(110, 150, 215)
		a.Glare = 0.2
		a.Haze = 1.1
		a.Parent = Lighting
	end
	if not Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") then
		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		sky.SunAngularSize = 14
		sky.Parent = Lighting
	end
	if not Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		cc.Saturation = 0.22
		cc.Contrast = 0.06
		cc.Brightness = 0.02
		cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 252, 248)
		cc.Parent = Lighting
	end
	if not Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("SunRaysEffect") then
		local rays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
		rays.Intensity = 0.06
		rays.Parent = Lighting
	end
	if not Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect") then
		local b = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
		b.Intensity = 0.35
		b.Threshold = 1.7
		b.Parent = Lighting
	end	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.18
	MapBuilder.ApplyLighting("Day")
end

-- 기획서 3장: 엄폐물은 어두운 외곽선으로 바닥과 구분
local OUTLINED = { Crate = true, Wall = true, WarehouseWall = true, Container = true, Parapet = true, WallSill = true, Platform = true,
	Ramp = true, Boundary = true, SpawnWall = true, Lintel = true, WarehouseRoof = true }

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 0.6 아트 패스: 밝은 카툰 팔레트 + 엄폐물 디테일(모서리 프레임·받침·캡)
-- 판정용 모양은 그대로 두고 장식 파트만 덧붙임 (CanCollide·CanQuery 끔)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local PALETTE = {
	Floor = { Color3.fromRGB(238, 240, 247), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Boundary = { Color3.fromRGB(214, 220, 234), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Wall = { Color3.fromRGB(226, 230, 240), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	WarehouseWall = { Color3.fromRGB(226, 230, 240), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Lintel = { Color3.fromRGB(214, 218, 230), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	WallSill = { Color3.fromRGB(214, 218, 230), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Parapet = { Color3.fromRGB(230, 234, 244), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	SpawnWall = { Color3.fromRGB(210, 216, 230), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Platform = { Color3.fromRGB(206, 212, 228), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	MidTower = { Color3.fromRGB(196, 204, 222), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	SpawnTower = { Color3.fromRGB(188, 196, 216), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Ramp = { Color3.fromRGB(186, 192, 210), Enum.Material.DiamondPlate },
	Crate = { Color3.fromRGB(236, 176, 100), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks },
	WarehouseRoof = { Color3.fromRGB(222, 218, 206), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	CityGround = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 178), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
	Street = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 178), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
}
local PASTEL = Color3.fromRGB(190, 210, 238)

local function deco(parent, size, cf, color, mat)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = "Detail"
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function stylize(folder)
	local detail = Instance.new("Folder")
	detail.Name = "Detail"
	detail.Parent = folder
	for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "Cell" and p.Parent ~= detail then
			local pal = PALETTE[p.Name]
			if pal then
				p.Color = pal[1]
				p.Material = pal[2]
			elseif p.Name == "Building" or p.Name == "CityBuilding" then
				p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(PASTEL, 0.75)
				p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			elseif p.Name == "Container" then
				p.Color = p.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25)
				p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			end
			local sz, cf = p.Size, p.CFrame
			if p.Name == "Crate" then
				-- 모서리 각재 4개 + 윗테 4개 + 가운데 X 대신 가로대
				local dark = Color3.fromRGB(170, 108, 56)
				for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
					for _, sz2 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
						deco(detail, Vector3.new(0.5, sz.Y + 0.04, 0.5), cf * CFrame.new(sx * (sz.X / 2 - 0.2), 0, sz2 * (sz.Z / 2 - 0.2)), dark, Enum.Material.Wood)
					end
				end
				for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
					deco(detail, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, sz.Z + 0.06), cf * CFrame.new(sx * (sz.X / 2 - 0.15), sz.Y / 2 - 0.15, 0), dark, Enum.Material.Wood)
					deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.06, 0.4, 0.4), cf * CFrame.new(0, sz.Y / 2 - 0.15, sx * (sz.Z / 2 - 0.15)), dark, Enum.Material.Wood)
					deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.06, 0.35, 0.36), cf * CFrame.new(0, -0.1, sx * (sz.Z / 2 - 0.12)), dark, Enum.Material.Wood)
				end
			elseif p.Name == "Wall" or p.Name == "WarehouseWall" or p.Name == "Boundary" or p.Name == "SpawnWall" then
				-- 아래 걸레받이 + 위 캡(살짝 넓게) + 일정 간격 패널 이음새
				local long = (sz.X >= sz.Z) and "X" or "Z"
				deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.12, 0.6, sz.Z + 0.12), cf * CFrame.new(0, -sz.Y / 2 + 0.3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(150, 158, 180))
				deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.3, 0.35, sz.Z + 0.3), cf * CFrame.new(0, sz.Y / 2 + 0.17, 0), Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 252))
				local len = (long == "X") and sz.X or sz.Z
				local n = math.floor(len / 8)
				for k = 1, n - 1 do
					local o = -len / 2 + k * (len / n)
					local off = (long == "X") and CFrame.new(o, 0, 0) or CFrame.new(0, 0, o)
					local s2 = (long == "X") and Vector3.new(0.18, sz.Y - 0.8, sz.Z + 0.06) or Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.06, sz.Y - 0.8, 0.18)
					deco(detail, s2, cf * off, Color3.fromRGB(190, 196, 214))
				end
			elseif p.Name == "Platform" or p.Name == "Parapet" then
				-- 윗면 가장자리 띠
				deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.16, 0.3, sz.Z + 0.16), cf * CFrame.new(0, sz.Y / 2 - 0.12, 0), Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 255))
			elseif p.Name == "Container" then
				-- 골판 무늬(세로 리브) + 문 손잡이
				local long = (sz.X >= sz.Z) and "X" or "Z"
				local len = (long == "X") and sz.X or sz.Z
				local shade = p.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.18)
				for k = 1, math.floor(len / 1.6) do
					local o = -len / 2 + (k - 0.5) * 1.6
					local off = (long == "X") and CFrame.new(o, 0, 0) or CFrame.new(0, 0, o)
					local s2 = (long == "X") and Vector3.new(0.35, sz.Y - 0.6, sz.Z + 0.1) or Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.1, sz.Y - 0.6, 0.35)
					deco(detail, s2, cf * off, shade)
				end
				deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.14, 0.3, sz.Z + 0.14), cf * CFrame.new(0, sz.Y / 2 - 0.15, 0), shade)
				deco(detail, Vector3.new(sz.X + 0.14, 0.3, sz.Z + 0.14), cf * CFrame.new(0, -sz.Y / 2 + 0.15, 0), shade)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function addOutlines(folder, keepOriginal)
	if not keepOriginal then
		stylize(folder)
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and OUTLINED[p.Name] then
			local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
			sb.Adornee = p
			sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 70)
			sb.LineThickness = 0.05
			sb.SurfaceTransparency = 1
			sb.Parent = p
		end
	end
end
