-- 로비: 광장(페인트 스플랫 바닥) + 로고 타이틀 + 매치 발판 무대 + 랭킹 보드 + 상점 부스
local LOBBY_COLORS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 46, 170), Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 0),
	Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 80), Color3.fromRGB(175, 80, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30),
}

local function cyl(props)
	-- 세로로 선 원기둥/원판 (Roblox 원기둥은 X축이 길이 방향이라 90도 돌림)
	local h, d = props.Height, props.Diameter
	props.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	props.Size = Vector3.new(h, d, d)
	props.CFrame = CFrame.new(props.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	props.Position = nil
	props.Height, props.Diameter = nil, nil
	return part(props)
end

local function titleText(gui, text, pos, size, c1, c2)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Position = pos
	t.Size = size
	t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.Text = text
	t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	t.Parent = gui
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2)
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Parent = t
	local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	st.Thickness = 10
	st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(16, 12, 30)
	st.Parent = t
	return t
end

function MapBuilder.BuildLobby()
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local lobby = Instance.new("Folder")
	lobby.Name = "Lobby"
	lobby.Parent = workspace
	local deco = Instance.new("Folder")
	deco.Name = "Decoration"
	deco.Parent = lobby
	local rng = Random.new(77)

	local Y = 400
	local W, D = 170, 130
	------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- SF 격납고 로비: 짙은 남색 강철 벽 + 노랑/자홍 네온 칸, 유리 천장과 네온 갈비대,
	-- 무지개 네온 통로, 떠 있는 육각 무기 진열대 (레퍼런스: 사이파이 하이퍼 FPS 로비)
	------------------------------------------------------------------
	local STEEL = Color3.fromRGB(30, 38, 62)
	local STEEL2 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 52, 84)
	local STEEL3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 46)
	local NEON_Y = Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 40)
	local NEON_M = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 200)
	local NEON_P = Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 255)
	local NEON_C = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 255)
	local H = 46 -- 천장 높이

	-- 바닥: 진한 강철판 + 10스터드 이음새
	part({ Name = "Floor", Parent = lobby, Size = Vector3.new(W, 2, D), Position = Vector3.new(0, Y - 1, 0),
		Color = STEEL3, Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate })
	for x = -W / 2 + 10, W / 2 - 10, 10 do
		part({ Name = "Seam", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(0.18, 0.04, D), Position = Vector3.new(x, Y + 0.02, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 24), CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
	end
	for z = -D / 2 + 10, D / 2 - 10, 10 do
		part({ Name = "Seam", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(W, 0.04, 0.18), Position = Vector3.new(0, Y + 0.02, z),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 24), CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
	end
	-- 중앙 통로 (스폰 → 발판 무대): 밝은 패널 + 양옆 무지개 네온 줄
	local pathZ1, pathZ2 = -12, D / 2 - 4
	part({ Name = "Walkway", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(26, 0.1, pathZ2 - pathZ1), Position = Vector3.new(0, Y + 0.05, (pathZ1 + pathZ2) / 2),
		Color = STEEL2, Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
	local segs = 24
	for i = 0, segs - 1 do
		local z1 = pathZ1 + (pathZ2 - pathZ1) * i / segs
		local len = (pathZ2 - pathZ1) / segs
		local c = Color3.fromHSV((i / segs) * 0.85, 0.85, 1)
		for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			part({ Name = "RainbowLine", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.12, len + 0.02), Position = Vector3.new(sx * 13.4, Y + 0.08, z1 + len / 2),
				Color = c, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
		end
	end
	-- 통로 가운데 화살표 표시
	for z = pathZ2 - 12, pathZ1 + 8, -10 do
		for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local w = part({ Name = "Chevron", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.06, 4), CFrame = CFrame.new(sx * 1.4, Y + 0.12, z)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(sx * 40), 0), Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 210), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
			w.Transparency = 0.45
		end
	end

	-- 벽: 14스터드 칸마다 안쪽 패널 + 칸 경계 기둥(노랑/자홍 네온) + 아래·위 시안 띠
	local function wallSide(axis, sgn)
		local len = axis == "X" and W or D
		local function at(t, y, inset)
			if axis == "X" then
				return Vector3.new(t, y, sgn * (D / 2 - inset))
			end
			return Vector3.new(sgn * (W / 2 - inset), y, t)
		end
		local function size(along, h, thick)
			if axis == "X" then
				return Vector3.new(along, h, thick)
			end
			return Vector3.new(thick, h, along)
		end
		part({ Name = "HangarWall", Parent = lobby, Size = size(len, H, 2), Position = at(0, Y + H / 2, -1), Color = STEEL, Material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		part({ Name = "WallSkirt", Parent = deco, Size = size(len, 0.5, 0.4), Position = at(0, Y + 4, 0.2), Color = NEON_C, Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			CanQuery = false, CanCollide = false })
		part({ Name = "WallCrown", Parent = deco, Size = size(len, 0.5, 0.4), Position = at(0, Y + H - 8, 0.2), Color = NEON_P, Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			CanQuery = false, CanCollide = false })
		local k = 0
		for t = -len / 2 + 7, len / 2 - 7, 14 do
			k = k + 1
			-- 들어간 패널 (가운데 조금 밝게)
			part({ Name = "WallPanel", Parent = deco, Size = size(11, H - 16, 0.6), Position = at(t, Y + 4 + (H - 12) / 2, 0.3), Color = STEEL2,
				Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanQuery = false })
			part({ Name = "PanelSlit", Parent = deco, Size = size(8, 0.25, 0.7), Position = at(t, Y + 14, 0.35), Color = STEEL3, CanQuery = false })
			part({ Name = "PanelSlit", Parent = deco, Size = size(8, 0.25, 0.7), Position = at(t, Y + 26, 0.35), Color = STEEL3, CanQuery = false })
			-- 칸 경계 기둥 + 세로 네온
			local edge = t + 7
			if edge < len / 2 - 1 then
				part({ Name = "WallRib", Parent = deco, Size = size(2.2, H, 1.6), Position = at(edge, Y + H / 2, 0.6), Color = STEEL3,
					Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanQuery = false })
				local nc = (k % 2 == 0) and NEON_M or NEON_Y
				local bar = part({ Name = "WallNeon", Parent = deco, Size = size(0.7, 14, 0.5), Position = at(edge, Y + 13, 1.5), Color = nc,
					Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanQuery = false, CanCollide = false })
				if k % 2 == 1 then
					local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
					l.Color = nc
					l.Range = 18
					l.Brightness = 1.4
					l.Parent = bar
				end
			end
		end
	end
	wallSide("X", -1)
	wallSide("X", 1)
	wallSide("Z", -1)
	wallSide("Z", 1)

	-- 유리 천장 + 자홍/보라 네온 갈비대 (하늘과 구름이 비침)
	part({ Name = "CeilingGlass", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(W, 0.4, D), Position = Vector3.new(0, Y + H, 0), Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255),
		Material = Enum.Material.Glass, Transparency = 0.6, CanQuery = false })
	local ri = 0
	for x = -W / 2, W / 2, 14 do
		ri = ri + 1
		part({ Name = "CeilingRib", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(2, 2.4, D), Position = Vector3.new(x, Y + H - 1, 0), Color = STEEL3,
			Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanQuery = false })
		part({ Name = "RibNeon", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.3, D - 2), Position = Vector3.new(x, Y + H - 2.3, 0),
			Color = (ri % 2 == 0) and NEON_M or NEON_P, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanQuery = false, CanCollide = false })
	end
	for z = -D / 2, D / 2, 26 do
		part({ Name = "CeilingBeam", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(W, 1.6, 1.6), Position = Vector3.new(0, Y + H - 1.2, z), Color = STEEL3,
			Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanQuery = false })
	end
	-- 천장에 매단 조명 (흰 사각 등)
	for x = -56, 56, 28 do
		for z = -30, 40, 35 do
			local lamp = part({ Name = "CeilingLamp", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.4, 2), Position = Vector3.new(x, Y + H - 2.6, z),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanQuery = false, CanCollide = false })
			local sl = Instance.new("SurfaceLight")
			sl.Face = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
			sl.Range = 40
			sl.Angle = 90
			sl.Brightness = 1.2
			sl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 225, 255)
			sl.Parent = lamp
		end
	end

	-- 떠 있는 육각 무기 진열대 (총은 클라이언트에서 천천히 회전: Spin 속성)
	local displays = { { -42, 30, "Sniper" }, { 42, 30, "Rifle" }, { -42, 4, "Launcher" }, { 42, 4, "Shotgun" } }
	for i, dsp in ipairs(displays) do
		local base = Vector3.new(dsp[1], Y + 3.2, dsp[2])
		for k = 0, 2 do
			part({ Name = "HexDeck", Parent = lobby, Size = Vector3.new(9.2, 1.2, 16), CFrame = CFrame.new(base) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(60 * k), 0),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 232, 245), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
			part({ Name = "HexRim", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(9.4, 0.3, 16.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(60 * k), 0), Color = (i % 2 == 0) and NEON_C or NEON_M, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanQuery = false,
				CanCollide = false })
		end
		-- 아래로 좁아지는 받침 (떠 있는 느낌)
		part({ Name = "HexUnder", Parent = deco, Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(8, 3, 8), Position = base + Vector3.new(0, -1.6, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 80, 110), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanQuery = false })
		local glow = part({ Name = "HexGlow", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Position = base + Vector3.new(0, -3, 0), Transparency = 1,
			CanQuery = false, CanCollide = false })
		local gl = Instance.new("PointLight")
		gl.Color = (i % 2 == 0) and NEON_C or NEON_M
		gl.Range = 14
		gl.Brightness = 2.5
		gl.Parent = glow
		local ok, gun = pcall(function()
			local ModelKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ModelKit)
			local m = ModelKit.Gun(dsp[3], (i % 2 == 0) and NEON_C or NEON_M)
			m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * 2.2)
			return m
		end)
		if ok and gun then
			gun.Name = "DisplayGun"
			gun:PivotTo(CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
			gun:SetAttribute("Spin", 30)
			gun.Parent = deco
		end
		-- 진열대 위 홀로 이름판
		local board = part({ Name = "HoloSign", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(7, 2, 0.2), Position = base + Vector3.new(0, 8.5, 0), Transparency = 1,
			CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Size = UDim2.new(7, 0, 1.6, 0)
		bb.LightInfluence = 0
		bb.MaxDistance = 90
		bb.Parent = board
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 18, 34)
		t.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		t.TextScaled = true
		t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		t.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Italic)
		local w = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons).Get(dsp[3])
		t.Text = string.upper(w.Class) .. "  ·  " .. w.Name
		t.Parent = bb
		local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		st.Color = (i % 2 == 0) and NEON_C or NEON_M
		st.Thickness = 2
		st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		st.Parent = t
	end

	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "LobbySpawn"
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.Duration = 0
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(14, 0.6, 14)
	spawn.Position = Vector3.new(0, Y + 0.3, 44)
	spawn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)
	spawn.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	spawn.Transparency = 0.2
	spawn.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.Parent = lobby

	------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 타이틀 로고 (북쪽 벽, 스폰을 바라봄)
	------------------------------------------------------------------
	local TZ = -D / 2 + 3
	local TY = Y + 22
	local board = part({ Name = "TitleBoard", Parent = lobby, Size = Vector3.new(70, 24, 1.5), Position = Vector3.new(0, TY, TZ),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 18, 38), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
	-- 네온 테두리
	for _, e in ipairs({ { 0, 12.4, 71.6, 0.8 }, { 0, -12.4, 71.6, 0.8 }, { -35.4, 0, 0.8, 25.6 }, { 35.4, 0, 0.8, 25.6 } }) do
		part({ Name = "TitleFrame", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(e[3], e[4], 1.8), Position = Vector3.new(e[1], TY + e[2], TZ),
			Color = (e[2] ~= 0) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 200) or Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 40), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanQuery = false })
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "Logo"
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Back
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = 30
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Parent = board
	titleText(gui, "SPLASH", UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.03), UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.47), Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 215), Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 140))
	titleText(gui, "FRONT", UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.47), UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.37), Color3.fromRGB(130, 245, 255), Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255))
	local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.85)
	sub.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.12)
	sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	sub.TextScaled = true
	sub.Text = "PAINT  ·  SHOOT  ·  CONQUER"
	sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90)
	sub.Parent = gui
	-- 로고 아래로 흘러내리는 페인트
	for i = 1, 14 do
		local x = -31 + (i - 1) * (62 / 13) + rng:NextNumber(-1, 1)
		local len = rng:NextNumber(1.5, 6)
		local c = LOBBY_COLORS[(i % #LOBBY_COLORS) + 1]
		local w = rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.6)
		part({ Name = "Drip", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(w, len, 0.5), Position = Vector3.new(x, TY - 12.8 - len / 2, TZ + 0.9),
			Color = c, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
		part({ Name = "DripTip", Parent = deco, Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(w * 1.3, w * 1.3, w * 1.3),
			Position = Vector3.new(x, TY - 12.8 - len, TZ + 0.9), Color = c, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
	end
	-- 양옆 스피커 타워 + 무대 조명
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local tx = s * 46

	{ -56, 40, 8, 8, 7 },               -- 저격 타워

	{ -73, 0, 10, 28, 1 },              -- 베이스

local function mirrored(list)
	local out = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(list) do
		table.insert(out, o)
		local mirror = o[7]
		if #o == 6 then
			mirror = o[6]
		end
		if o[1] ~= 0 and mirror ~= false then
			local copy = {}
			for i, v in ipairs(o) do
				copy[i] = v
			end
			copy[1] = -o[1]
			copy.Mirror = true
			table.insert(out, copy)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function decorate(geo)
	local deco = Instance.new("Folder")

	local rng = Random.new(2026) -- 항상 같은 도시가 나오도록 고정 시드
	local neon = { Config.Teams[1].Color, Config.Teams[2].Color, Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0), Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 255) }

	-- 1) 경기장 밖 빌딩 숲
	local function building(x, z, w, d)
		local h = rng:NextInteger(26, 70)
		local b = part({ Name = "Building", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(w, h, d), Position = Vector3.new(x, h / 2, z),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(rng:NextInteger(26, 44), rng:NextInteger(26, 40), rng:NextInteger(40, 60)), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
		b.CanQuery = false
		local c = neon[rng:NextInteger(1, #neon)]
		-- 창문 띠
		local y = 6
		while y < h - 4 do
			if rng:NextNumber() < 0.55 then
				part({ Name = "Window", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(w + 0.2, 0.6, d + 0.2), Position = Vector3.new(x, y, z),
					Color = c, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false }).Transparency = 0.35
			end
			y = y + rng:NextInteger(4, 7)
		end
		-- 옥상 네온 간판
		if rng:NextNumber() < 0.35 then
			part({ Name = "RoofSign", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(w * 0.7, 3, 0.6), Position = Vector3.new(x, h + 2, z),

	end
	for x = -110 * MS, 110 * MS, 24 do
		building(x + rng:NextInteger(-3, 3), -86 * MS - rng:NextInteger(0, 12), rng:NextInteger(14, 22), rng:NextInteger(14, 22))
		building(x + rng:NextInteger(-3, 3), 86 * MS + rng:NextInteger(0, 12), rng:NextInteger(14, 22), rng:NextInteger(14, 22))
	end
	for z = -66 * MS, 66 * MS, 24 do

	part({ Name = "CityGround", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(320 * MS, 1, 260 * MS), Position = Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 38), Material = Enum.Material.Asphalt, CanQuery = false })

	-- 2) 외벽 위 가로등 (조명)
	for _, x0 in ipairs({ -70, -50, -30, -10, 10, 30, 50, 70 }) do
		local x = x0 * MS

			local head = part({ Name = "Lamp", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.6, 1.4), Position = Vector3.new(x, 24.2, s * HALF_Z),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 220), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })

			light.Range = 48
			light.Angle = 80
			light.Brightness = 2.2
			light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 215)
			light.Parent = head
		end
	end

	-- 3) 베이스 위 팀 배너 (경기마다 팀 색·이름으로 다시 칠함)
	local banners = {}
	for i, t in ipairs(Config.Teams) do

	return labels, banners
end

function MapBuilder.BuildArena()
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local arena = Instance.new("Folder")
	arena.Name = "Arena"
	arena.Parent = workspace
	local geo = Instance.new("Folder")
	geo.Name = "Geometry"
	geo.Parent = arena
	local cells = Instance.new("Folder")
	cells.Name = "Cells"
	cells.Parent = arena

	-- 바닥
	part({ Name = "Floor", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(HALF_X * 2 + 8, 2, HALF_Z * 2 + 8), Position = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 82), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	-- 외벽 + 네온 라인
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		part({ Name = "Boundary", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(HALF_X * 2 + 8, 16, 2), Position = Vector3.new(0, 8, s * (HALF_Z + 1)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(44, 46, 58), Material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		part({ Name = "Boundary", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(2, 16, HALF_Z * 2 + 8), Position = Vector3.new(s * (HALF_X + 1), 8, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(44, 46, 58), Material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		part({ Name = "NeonLine", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(HALF_X * 2 + 8, 0.5, 0.3), Position = Vector3.new(0, 15.5, s * HALF_Z),
			Color = Config.Teams[s == -1 and 1 or 2].Color, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
	end
	-- 투명 천장(지붕 위로 나가지 않게)
	part({ Name = "Ceiling", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(HALF_X * 2 + 8, 2, HALF_Z * 2 + 8), Position = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0),
		Transparency = 1, CanQuery = false })

	local blocked = {} -- 셀을 깔지 않을 바닥 영역
	local function block(cx, cz, sx, sz)
		table.insert(blocked, { cx - sx / 2, cx + sx / 2, cz - sz / 2, cz + sz / 2 })
	end

	-- 장애물
	for _, o in ipairs(mirrored(OBSTACLES)) do
		local cx, cz, sx, sz, h, kind = o[1] * MS, o[2] * MS, o[3] * MS, o[4] * MS, o[5], o[6]
		local color, mat
		if kind == "wall" then
			color, mat = Color3.fromRGB(52, 54, 70), Enum.Material.Metal
		else
			color, mat = Color3.fromRGB(160, 120, 70), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks
		end
		local p = part({ Name = kind == "wall" and "Wall" or "Crate", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(sx, h, sz),
			Position = Vector3.new(cx, h / 2, cz), Color = color, Material = mat })
		p:SetAttribute("Cover", kind)
		if kind == "wall" then
			-- 벽 윗선 네온
			part({ Name = "WallTrim", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(sx + 0.1, 0.3, sz + 0.1), Position = Vector3.new(cx, h + 0.15, cz),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanQuery = false })
		end
		block(cx, cz, sx, sz)
	end

	-- 플랫폼 + 그 위 셀
	local function addCells(x1, x2, z1, z2, y)
		local x = x1 + CELL / 2
		while x < x2 do
			local z = z1 + CELL / 2
			while z < z2 do
				local free = true
				if y < 0.5 then
					for _, b in ipairs(blocked) do
						if x > b[1] - 0.5 and x < b[2] + 0.5 and z > b[3] - 0.5 and z < b[4] + 0.5 then
							free = false
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if free then
					local c = part({ Name = "Cell", Parent = cells, Size = Vector3.new(CELL - 0.08, 0.2, CELL - 0.08),
						Position = Vector3.new(x, y + 0.1, z), Color = Config.NeutralColor, Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
						CanCollide = false })
					c.CanTouch = false
					c.CastShadow = false
					c.Transparency = 1 -- 판정용 격자는 숨기고, 화면의 페인트는 클라이언트 PaintVisual이 그림
					c:SetAttribute("Owner", 0)
				end
				z = z + CELL
			end
			x = x + CELL
		end
	end

	for _, pl in ipairs(mirrored(PLATFORMS)) do
		local cx, cz, sx, sz, h = pl[1] * MS, pl[2] * MS, pl[3] * MS, pl[4] * MS, pl[5]
		part({ Name = "Platform", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(sx, h, sz), Position = Vector3.new(cx, h / 2, cz),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(96, 100, 116), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
		block(cx, cz, sx, sz)
		addCells(cx - sx / 2, cx + sx / 2, cz - sz / 2, cz + sz / 2, h)
	end

	-- 경사로
	ramp(geo, -16 * MS, -10 * MS, 0, 8 * MS, 0, 3)
	ramp(geo, 16 * MS, 10 * MS, 0, 8 * MS, 0, 3)
	for _, s in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
		ramp(geo, -74 * MS, -60 * MS, 40 * MS * s, 4 * MS, 0, 7)
		ramp(geo, 74 * MS, 60 * MS, 40 * MS * s, 4 * MS, 0, 7)
		-- 타워 앞쪽 흉벽(앉으면 숨는 높이)
		part({ Name = "Parapet", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(1, 2.6, 8 * MS), Position = Vector3.new(-52.5 * MS, 8.3, 40 * MS * s),
			Color = Config.Teams[1].Color, Material = Enum.Material.Glass, })
		part({ Name = "Parapet", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(1, 2.6, 8 * MS), Position = Vector3.new(52.5 * MS, 8.3, 40 * MS * s),
			Color = Config.Teams[2].Color, Material = Enum.Material.Glass })
	end

	block(-13 * MS, 0, 6 * MS, 8 * MS)
	block(13 * MS, 0, 6 * MS, 8 * MS)
	for _, s in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
		block(-67 * MS, 40 * MS * s, 14 * MS, 4 * MS)
		block(67 * MS, 40 * MS * s, 14 * MS, 4 * MS)
	end

	local jumbotron, banners = decorate(geo)

	-- 바닥 셀
	addCells(-HALF_X, HALF_X, -HALF_Z, HALF_Z, 0)

	-- 스폰 위치 (베이스 위)
	local spawns = { [1] = {}, [2] = {} }
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local z = (-10 + i * 5) * MS
		table.insert(spawns[1], CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-73 * MS, 4, z), Vector3.new(0, 4, z)))
		table.insert(spawns[2], CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(73 * MS, 4, z), Vector3.new(0, 4, z)))
	end
	-- 솔로 모드: 맵 가장자리 8곳
	local solo = {}
	local soloPts = { { -73, 0 }, { 73, 0 }, { 0, 48 }, { 0, -48 }, { -40, 48 }, { 40, -48 }, { 40, 48 }, { -40, -48 } }
	for _, p in ipairs(soloPts) do
		local y = (math.abs(p[1]) > 68) and 4 or 3
		table.insert(solo, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(p[1] * MS, y, p[2] * MS), Vector3.new(0, y, 0)))
	end

	local flags = {
		{ Name = "A", Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -40 * MS) },
		{ Name = "C", Position = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) },
		{ Name = "B", Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 40 * MS) },
	}

	local missionSpots = {}
	for _, m in ipairs({ { 0, 3, 0 }, { -30, 0, 44 }, { 30, 0, -44 }, { -30, 0, -44 }, { 30, 0, 44 }, { 0, 0, 40 }, { 0, 0, -40 },
		{ -40, 0, 0 }, { 40, 0, 0 }, { -50, 0, 22 }, { 50, 0, -22 } }) do
		table.insert(missionSpots, Vector3.new(m[1] * MS, m[2], m[3] * MS))
	end

	addOutlines(geo)
	return {
		Id = "ChromaSquare",
		Name = "크로마 스퀘어",
		KillY = -40,
		Folder = arena,
		Geometry = geo,
		Cells = cells,
		Spawns = spawns,
		SoloSpawns = solo,
		FlagPoints = flags,
		MissionSpots = missionSpots,
		BaseCenters = { [1] = Vector3.new(-73 * MS, 1, 0), [2] = Vector3.new(73 * MS, 1, 0) },
		Jumbotron = jumbotron,
		TeamBanners = banners,
	}
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 맵 2: 스카이 루프탑
-- 고층 빌딩 옥상 3동(가운데 + 양 팀 스폰 빌딩) 사이를 경사로·점프패드·집라인으로 잇는 수직 맵.
-- 중앙에는 컨테이너·박스로 가득한 창고(1층 실내전 + 지붕 고지대)와 벽 아래 '저격 구멍'.
-- 빌딩 사이로 떨어지면 탈락(KillY). 좌표는 옥상 기준 상대좌표 → skyPos로 변환
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local SKY_Y = 150                         -- 가운데 옥상 바닥 높이
local SKY_O = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1400)     -- 크로마 스퀘어와 겹치지 않게 떨어진 위치 (맵 2배에 맞춰 더 멀리)

-- 설계 좌표(1배) → 월드 좌표. 가로·세로만 MS배, 높이는 그대로라
-- 점프패드(수평 속도도 MS배)·집라인의 궤적과 난간 사이 여유가 그대로 유지됨
local function skyPos(x, y, z)
	return Vector3.new(SKY_O.X + x * MS, SKY_Y + y, SKY_O.Z + z * MS)
end

function MapBuilder.BuildSkyRooftop()
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("SkyRooftop")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "SkyRooftop"
	root.Parent = workspace
	local geo = Instance.new("Folder")
	geo.Name = "Geometry"
	geo.Parent = root
	local cells = Instance.new("Folder")
	cells.Name = "Cells"
	cells.Parent = root
	local deco = Instance.new("Folder")
	deco.Name = "Decoration"
	deco.Parent = root

	local CONCRETE = Color3.fromRGB(78, 80, 92)
	local skyBanners = {}
	local METAL = Color3.fromRGB(118, 108, 92)
	local blocked = {}

	local function block(level, cx, cz, sx, sz)
		table.insert(blocked, { level, (cx - sx / 2) * MS, (cx + sx / 2) * MS, (cz - sz / 2) * MS, (cz + sz / 2) * MS })
	end

	-- 상대좌표 상자: 바닥 y1에서 높이 h (가로·세로 MS배)
	local function box(name, cx, y1, cz, sx, h, sz, color, mat, parent)
		return part({ Name = name, Parent = parent or geo, Size = Vector3.new(sx * MS, h, sz * MS), Position = skyPos(cx, y1 + h / 2, cz),
			Color = color or CONCRETE, Material = mat or Enum.Material.Concrete })
	end

	-- 바닥 셀 깔기 (같은 높이의 장애물 자리는 제외)
	local function cellsOn(x1, x2, z1, z2, y)
		x1, x2, z1, z2 = x1 * MS, x2 * MS, z1 * MS, z2 * MS
		local x = x1 + CELL / 2
		while x < x2 do
			local z = z1 + CELL / 2
			while z < z2 do
				local free = true
				for _, b in ipairs(blocked) do
					if math.abs(b[1] - y) < 0.5 and x > b[2] - 0.5 and x < b[3] + 0.5 and z > b[4] - 0.5 and z < b[5] + 0.5 then
						free = false
						break
					end
				end
				if free then
					local c = part({ Name = "Cell", Parent = cells, Size = Vector3.new(CELL - 0.08, 0.2, CELL - 0.08),
						Position = Vector3.new(SKY_O.X + x, SKY_Y + y + 0.1, SKY_O.Z + z), Color = Config.NeutralColor, CanCollide = false })
					c.CanTouch = false
					c.CastShadow = false
					c.Transparency = 1 -- 판정용 격자는 숨기고, 화면의 페인트는 클라이언트 PaintVisual이 그림
					c:SetAttribute("Owner", 0)
				end
				z = z + CELL
			end
			x = x + CELL
		end
	end

	-- 경사로 + 난간 (xLow 높이 y0 → xHigh 높이 y0+h)
	local function skyRamp(xLow, xHigh, z, width, y0, h)
		width = width * MS
		local len = math.abs(xHigh - xLow) * MS
		local slope = math.sqrt(len * len + h * h)
		local angle = math.atan(h / len)
		if xHigh < xLow then
			angle = -angle
		end
		local cf = CFrame.new(skyPos((xLow + xHigh) / 2, y0 + h / 2 - 0.5, z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle)
		part({ Name = "Ramp", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(slope, 1, width), CFrame = cf,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160), Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate })
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			part({ Name = "Rail", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(slope, 2.4, 0.4), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.7, side * (width / 2 + 0.2)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		end
	end

	-- 점프패드: 밟으면 launch 속도로 발사 (플레이어는 클라이언트, 봇은 서버가 처리)
	local function jumpPad(x, y, z, launch)
		launch = Vector3.new(launch.X * MS, launch.Y, launch.Z * MS) -- 비행 시간은 같고 수평 거리만 MS배
		local pad = part({ Name = "JumpPad", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.6, 6), Position = skyPos(x, y + 0.3, z),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 220), Material = Enum.Material.Neon })
		pad:SetAttribute("Launch", launch)
		CollectionService:AddTag(pad, "SF_JumpPad")
		local ring = part({ Name = "PadRing", Parent = deco, Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 7.5, 7.5),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(skyPos(x, y + 0.65, z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
		ring.Transparency = 0.5
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = pad.Color
		light.Range = 12
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = pad
		local cooldown = {}
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
			if not model or not bots or not model:IsDescendantOf(bots) then
				return
			end
			if cooldown[model] and os.clock() - cooldown[model] < 0.8 then
				return
			end
			cooldown[model] = os.clock()
			local r = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if r then
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launch
			end
		end)
		block(y, x, z, 6 / MS, 6 / MS)
		return pad
	end

	-- 집라인: 시작 기둥의 E 프롬프트로 탑승, from → to 로 미끄러져 내려감
	local function zipline(from, to, fromBase, toBase)
		local h1, h2 = from.Y - (SKY_Y + fromBase), to.Y - (SKY_Y + toBase)
		local startPole = part({ Name = "ZipStart", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(0.8, h1, 0.8), Position = from - Vector3.new(0, h1 / 2, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		part({ Name = "ZipEnd", Parent = geo, Size = Vector3.new(0.8, h2, 0.8), Position = to - Vector3.new(0, h2 / 2, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0), Material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		local len = (to - from).Magnitude
		part({ Name = "ZipCable", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, len), CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) / 2, to),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), Material = Enum.Material.Metal, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
		startPole:SetAttribute("ZipFrom", from)
		startPole:SetAttribute("ZipTo", to)
		CollectionService:AddTag(startPole, "SF_Zipline")
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "집라인 타기"
		prompt.ObjectText = "집라인"
		prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = startPole
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 빌딩 3동
	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	box("MidTower", 0, -SKY_Y, 0, 100, SKY_Y, 104, Color3.fromRGB(46, 48, 62))
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		box("SpawnTower", 76 * s, -SKY_Y, 0, 20, SKY_Y + 8, 60, Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 56))
	end
	-- 빌딩 외벽 네온 창문 띠
	local y = -12
	local band = 0
	while y > -SKY_Y + 10 do
		band = band + 1
		local c = (band % 2 == 0) and Config.Teams[1].Color or Config.Teams[2].Color
		part({ Name = "WindowBand", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(100 * MS + 0.4, 0.8, 104 * MS + 0.4), Position = skyPos(0, y, 0), Color = c,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false }).Transparency = 0.45
		for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			part({ Name = "WindowBand", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(20 * MS + 0.4, 0.8, 60 * MS + 0.4), Position = skyPos(76 * s, y + 6, 0),
				Color = Config.Teams[s == -1 and 1 or 2].Color, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false }).Transparency = 0.45
		end
		y = y - 12
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 옥상 가장자리 난간(앉으면 숨는 높이)
	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		box("Parapet", 0, 0, 51.5 * t, 100, 2.5, 1, CONCRETE)
		block(0, 0, 51.5 * t, 100, 1)
	end
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, seg in ipairs({ { -52, -25 }, { -19, 19 }, { 25, 52 } }) do
			local cz, len = (seg[1] + seg[2]) / 2, seg[2] - seg[1]
			box("Parapet", 49.5 * s, 0, cz, 1, 2.5, len, CONCRETE)
			block(0, 49.5 * s, cz, 1, len)
		end
		-- 스폰 빌딩 옥상: 뒤 벽(높음), 옆 난간, 앞 난간(경사로 자리 비움)
		local back = box("SpawnWall", 85.5 * s, 8, 0, 1, 6, 60, Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 48))
		block(8, 85.5 * s, 0, 1, 60)
		local bl = label(back, "SKY ROOFTOP", s == -1 and Enum.NormalId.Right or Enum.NormalId.Left)
		bl.TextColor3 = Config.Teams[s == -1 and 1 or 2].Color
		skyBanners[s == -1 and 1 or 2] = { Label = bl }
		for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			box("Parapet", 76 * s, 8, 29.5 * t, 20, 2.5, 1, CONCRETE)
			block(8, 76 * s, 29.5 * t, 20, 1)
		end
		for _, seg in ipairs({ { -30, -25 }, { -19, 19 }, { 25, 30 } }) do
			local cz, len = (seg[1] + seg[2]) / 2, seg[2] - seg[1]
			box("Parapet", 66.5 * s, 8, cz, 1, 2.5, len, CONCRETE)
			block(8, 66.5 * s, cz, 1, len)
		end
		-- 빌딩 사이 경사로 2개 (허공 위 다리)
		for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			skyRamp(50 * s, 66 * s, 22 * t, 6, 0, 8)
		end
		-- 스폰 옥상 엄폐 박스
		for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			box("Crate", 70 * s, 8, 12 * t, 4, 3, 4, Color3.fromRGB(160, 120, 70), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
			block(8, 70 * s, 12 * t, 4, 4)
		end
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 중앙 창고 (1층 실내전 + 지붕 고지대, 벽 아래 저격 구멍)
	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	local W_H = 10
	local function wallX(z, x1, x2)    -- z 고정, x 방향 벽
		local cx, len = (x1 + x2) / 2, x2 - x1
		box("WarehouseWall", cx, 0, z, len, W_H, 1, METAL, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal)
		block(0, cx, z, len, 1)
	end
	local function wallZ(x, z1, z2)    -- x 고정, z 방향 벽
		local cz, len = (z1 + z2) / 2, z2 - z1
		box("WarehouseWall", x, 0, cz, 1, W_H, len, METAL, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal)
		block(0, x, cz, 1, len)
	end
	local function lintelX(z, x1, x2)
		box("Lintel", (x1 + x2) / 2, 7, z, x2 - x1, W_H - 7, 1, METAL, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal)
	end
	local function lintelZ(x, z1, z2)
		box("Lintel", x, 7, (z1 + z2) / 2, 1, W_H - 7, z2 - z1, METAL, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal)
	end
	for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local z = 13.5 * t
		-- 양 끝 구간은 바닥 1~2.4 높이가 뚫린 '저격 구멍' (앉아서 쏘는 낮은 틈)
		for _, seg in ipairs({ { -20, -12 }, { 12, 20 } }) do
			local cx, len = (seg[1] + seg[2]) / 2, seg[2] - seg[1]
			box("WallSill", cx, 0, z, len, 1, 1, METAL, Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal)

		end
		wallX(z, -6, 6)
		lintelX(z, -12, -6)
		lintelX(z, 6, 12)
	end
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local x = 19.5 * s
		wallZ(x, -14, -4)
		wallZ(x, 4, 14)
		lintelZ(x, -4, 4)
	end
	-- 지붕 (가운데 길쭉한 채광창 구멍)
	local roofParts = { { -20, -3, -14, 14 }, { 3, 20, -14, 14 }, { -3, 3, 10, 14 }, { -3, 3, -14, -10 } }
	for _, r in ipairs(roofParts) do

	-- 지붕 난간
	for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do

		block(W_H + 1, 0, 13.75 * t, 40, 0.5)
		box("RoofRail", 19.75 * t, W_H + 1, 0, 0.5, 1.6, 28, Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0), Enum.Material.Metal)
		block(W_H + 1, 19.75 * t, 0, 0.5, 28)
	end
	-- 실내 박스 + 조명
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do

		local lamp = part({ Name = "CeilingLamp", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.3, 1), Position = skyPos(10 * s, W_H - 0.4, 0),

		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")

	--------------------------------------------------------------------

		block(0, 0, 42 * t, 16, 6)
	end

	-- 옥상 박스(절반 엄폐)
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, c in ipairs({ { -37, 0 }, { -40, 26 }, { -40, -26 }, { -28, 8 }, { -28, -8 }, { -12, 26 }, { -12, -26 },

	--------------------------------------------------------------------

	for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do

	end
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		jumpPad(26 * s, 0, 0, Vector3.new(-14 * s, 75, 0))       -- 창고 정문 앞 → 창고 지붕
		jumpPad(45 * s, 0, 0, Vector3.new(42 * s, 78, 0))        -- 옥상 끝 → 허공 건너 스폰 빌딩 (스폰 난간 위로 넘김)
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 집라인 (높은 곳 → 낮은 곳)
	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			-- 시뮬레이션으로 난간·경사로 난간·컨테이너와 안 부딪히는 높이/경로 확인

	--------------------------------------------------------------------

	cellsOn(-50, 50, -52, 52, 0)                       -- 가운데 옥상 + 창고 1층
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do

	end

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 배경: 발아래 도시 + 먼 스카이라인, 전광판, 옥상 조명
	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	local rng = Random.new(1750)
	local neon = { Config.Teams[1].Color, Config.Teams[2].Color, Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0), Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 255) }
	part({ Name = "Street", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(700 * MS, 1, 700 * MS), Position = Vector3.new(SKY_O.X, -0.5, SKY_O.Z),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32), Material = Enum.Material.Asphalt, CanQuery = false })
	for i = 1, 70 do
		local a = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
		local dist = rng:NextNumber(115, 300) * MS
		local far = dist > 220 * MS
		local h = far and rng:NextInteger(160, 240) or rng:NextInteger(50, 135)
		local w = rng:NextInteger(16, 30) * (MS > 1 and 1.5 or 1)
		local pos = Vector3.new(SKY_O.X + math.cos(a) * dist, h / 2, SKY_O.Z + math.sin(a) * dist)
		part({ Name = "CityBuilding", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(w, h, w), Position = pos,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(rng:NextInteger(24, 40), rng:NextInteger(24, 36), rng:NextInteger(38, 58)), Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			CanQuery = false })
		local c = neon[rng:NextInteger(1, #neon)]
		local wy = 8
		while wy < h - 4 do
			if rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 then
				part({ Name = "Window", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(w + 0.2, 0.6, w + 0.2), Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, wy, pos.Z),

			end
			wy = wy + rng:NextInteger(5, 9)
		end
	end
	-- 옥상 투광등
	for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, t in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local lamp = part({ Name = "Floodlight", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2), Position = skyPos(48 * s, 9, 50 * t),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 225), Material = Enum.Material.Neon, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false })
			local spot = Instance.new("SpotLight")
			spot.Face = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
			spot.Range = 45
			spot.Angle = 90
			spot.Brightness = 2
			spot.Parent = lamp
			box("LightPole", 48 * s, 0, 50.6 * t, 0.5, 8.5, 0.5, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50), Enum.Material.Metal, deco).CanQuery = false
		end
	end
	-- 전광판
	local screen = part({ Name = "Jumbotron", Parent = deco, Size = Vector3.new(1, 9, 24), Position = skyPos(0, 30, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 16), CanQuery = false })
	screen.CanCollide = false
	local jumbotron = {}
	for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right }) do
		table.insert(jumbotron, label(screen, "SKY ROOFTOP", face))
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 스폰·깃발·미션 지점
	--------------------------------------------------------------------
	local spawns = { [1] = {}, [2] = {} }
	for _, z in ipairs({ -16, -8, 0, 8, 16 }) do
		table.insert(spawns[1], CFrame.lookAt(skyPos(-79, 11, z), skyPos(0, 11, z)))
		table.insert(spawns[2], CFrame.lookAt(skyPos(79, 11, z), skyPos(0, 11, z)))
	end
	local solo = {}
	for _, p3 in ipairs({ { -79, 11, 0 }, { 79, 11, 0 }, { 0, 3, 49 }, { 0, 3, -49 }, { -30, 3, 48 }, { 30, 3, -48 }, { 30, 3, 48 }, { 8, 14, 0 } }) do
		table.insert(solo, CFrame.lookAt(skyPos(p3[1], p3[2], p3[3]), skyPos(0, p3[2], 0)))
	end

	-- 스카이 루프탑은 처음의 어두운 네온 도시 + 노을 분위기 그대로 (흰색 팔레트·표면 텍스처 적용 안 함)
	addOutlines(geo, true)
	return {
		Id = "SkyRooftop",
		Name = "스카이 루프탑",
		Folder = root,
		Geometry = geo,

			{ Name = "A", Position = skyPos(0, 12, -42) },

		},
		MissionSpots = {

			skyPos(-30, 0, 42), skyPos(30, 0, -42), skyPos(40, 0, 0), skyPos(-40, 0, 0), skyPos(10, 11, 0),
		},

Server.Name: MatchService
Server.Source:
-- 매치 흐름: 로비 대기 → 카운트다운 → 경기(터프/플래그/솔로) → 결과·보상·랭크 → 로비
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local Cosmetics = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Cosmetics)
local ModelKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ModelKit)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)
local PaintService = require(script.Parent.PaintService)
local CombatService = require(script.Parent.CombatService)
local MissionService = require(script.Parent.MissionService)
local BotService = require(script.Parent.BotService)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local RankService = require(script.Parent.RankService)
local Telemetry = require(script.Parent.TelemetryService)
local ItemService = require(script.Parent.ItemService)
local QuestService = require(script.Parent.QuestService)
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent.MapBuilder)

local MatchService = {}

local remotes, arena, lobby
local maps = {}
local nextMapIndex = 1
local queueMap = {}    -- queueId -> 방장이 고른 맵 Id ("random" 포함)
local joinAt = {}      -- player -> 대기열 참가 시각 (발판 이탈 검사 유예)
local S = {
	Phase = "Lobby",
	QueueId = nil,
	Mode = nil,
	EndsAt = 0,
	Owners = {},     -- 경기 참가 ownerId 목록 { {OwnerId, Name, Color} }
	Bonus = {},      -- ownerId -> 미션 보너스
	FlagScore = {},  -- ownerId -> 점수 (플래그 모드)
	Flags = {},      -- { Name, Position, Owner, Progress = {ownerId -> 0~1}, Model }
	Mission = nil,
	FinalSplash = false,
}

local function now()
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function queueDef(id)
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		if q.Id == id then
			return q
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function ownerInfo(ownerId)
	for _, o in ipairs(S.Owners) do
		if o.OwnerId == ownerId then
			return o
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function MatchService.ColorOf(ownerId)
	local o = ownerInfo(ownerId)
	return o and o.Color or Config.NeutralColor
end

local function announce(text, color)
	remotes.Notify:FireAllClients(text, color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 미션이 쓰는 API
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local missionApi = {
	AddBonus = function(ownerId, pts)
		S.Bonus[ownerId] = (S.Bonus[ownerId] or 0) + pts
		if S.Mode == "Flag" then
			S.FlagScore[ownerId] = (S.FlagScore[ownerId] or 0) + pts * 5
		end
	end,
	RewardOwner = function(ownerId, coins)
		for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
			if e.OwnerId == ownerId then
				e.Coins = e.Coins + coins
			end
		end
	end,
	-- 미션 성공 팀원(플레이어) 전원에게 무작위 아이템 1개
	RewardItems = function(ownerId)
		for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
			if e.OwnerId == ownerId and e.Player and e.Player.Parent then
				QuestService.Add(e.Player, "Missions", 1)
				DataService.AddXP(e.Player, Config.XP.Mission)
				local it = ItemService.GrantRandom(e.Player)
				if it then
					remotes.Notify:FireClient(e.Player, "미션 보상: " .. it.Name .. " 획득! [F] 사용", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90))
				end
			end
		end
	end,
	SetMission = function(m)
		S.Mission = m
	end,
	Announce = announce,
	Cue = function(name, owner, pos)
		remotes.FX:FireAllClients("Cue", { Name = name, Owner = owner, Pos = pos })
	end,
	OwnerName = function(ownerId)
		local o = ownerInfo(ownerId)
		return o and o.Name or "?"
	end,
	ColorOf = function(ownerId)
		return MatchService.ColorOf(ownerId)
	end,
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 점수
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function scores()
	local coverage = PaintService.GetCoverage()
	local kills = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
		kills[e.OwnerId] = (kills[e.OwnerId] or 0) + e.Kills
	end
	-- 전체 합계 (몫 계산용)
	local sumCov, sumCombat = 0, 0
	for _, o in ipairs(S.Owners) do
		sumCov = sumCov + (coverage[o.OwnerId] or 0)
		sumCombat = sumCombat + (kills[o.OwnerId] or 0) + (S.Bonus[o.OwnerId] or 0) * Config.MissionKillValue
	end
	local W = Config.WinWeights
	local list = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(S.Owners) do
		local cov = coverage[o.OwnerId] or 0
		local bonus = S.Bonus[o.OwnerId] or 0
		local combat = (kills[o.OwnerId] or 0) + bonus * Config.MissionKillValue
		local score
		if S.Mode == "Flag" then
			score = S.FlagScore[o.OwnerId] or 0
		else
			-- 페인트 몫 80% + 전투(처치·미션) 몫 20% → 0~100점
			local paintShare = (sumCov > 0) and (cov / sumCov) or 0
			local combatShare = (sumCombat > 0) and (combat / sumCombat) or 0
			score = 100 * (W.Paint * paintShare + W.Combat * combatShare)
		end
		table.insert(list, {
			OwnerId = o.OwnerId, Name = o.Name, Color = o.Color, Kills = kills[o.OwnerId] or 0,
			Coverage = math.floor(cov * 10 + 0.5) / 10, Bonus = bonus, Score = math.floor(score * 10 + 0.5) / 10,
		})
	end
	return list
end

local function queueCounts()
	local counts = {}
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		counts[q.Id] = 0
	end
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local q = pl:GetAttribute("Queue")
		if q and counts[q] and not pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
			counts[q] = counts[q] + 1
		end
	end
	return counts
end

-- 팀전 존(A=1/B=2)별 대기 인원
local function sideCounts(queueId)
	local c = { 0, 0 }
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl:GetAttribute("Queue") == queueId and not pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
			local sd = pl:GetAttribute("QueueSide")
			if sd == 1 or sd == 2 then
				c[sd] = c[sd] + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return c
end

local function broadcast()
	local flags = {}
	for _, f in ipairs(S.Flags) do
		local best = 0
		for _, v in pairs(f.Progress) do
			best = math.max(best, v)
		end
		table.insert(flags, { Name = f.Name, Owner = f.Owner, Progress = best })
	end
	local modeDef = S.Mode and Config.Modes[S.Mode]
	if arena.Jumbotron then
		local text = Config.GameName
		if S.Phase == "Playing" then
			local parts = {}
			for _, t in ipairs(scores()) do
				table.insert(parts, string.format("%.0f", t.Score))
			end
			local left = math.max(0, math.floor(S.EndsAt - now()))
			text = string.format("%d:%02d\n%s", math.floor(left / 60), left % 60, table.concat(parts, "  :  "))
		elseif S.Phase == "Results" then
			text = "RESULTS"
		end
		for _, l in ipairs(arena.Jumbotron) do
			l.Text = text
		end
	end
	-- 대기열별 방장(먼저 들어온 사람)·선택 맵
	local queueInfo = {}
	local counts = queueCounts()
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		local host = MatchService.QueueHost(q.Id)
		if counts[q.Id] == 0 then
			queueMap[q.Id] = nil
		end
		local choice = queueMap[q.Id]
		local mapName = "순환 (" .. (maps[nextMapIndex] and maps[nextMapIndex].Name or "") .. ")"
		if choice == "random" then
			mapName = "랜덤"
		elseif choice then
			for _, m in ipairs(maps) do
				if m.Id == choice then
					mapName = m.Name
				end
			end
		end
		local cap = (q.Mode == "Solo") and 8 or q.TeamSize * 2
		local sides = q.Mode ~= "Solo" and sideCounts(q.Id) or nil
		queueInfo[q.Id] = { Host = host and host.DisplayName or nil, HostId = host and host.UserId or nil, Map = mapName, MapId = choice,
			Capacity = cap, Full = counts[q.Id] >= cap, Sides = sides, TeamSize = q.TeamSize }
		if sides and lobby and lobby.QueuePadList then
			for _, ent in ipairs(lobby.QueuePadList) do
				if ent.Queue == q.Id and ent.Side > 0 then
					local tag = ent.Pad:FindFirstChild("ZoneTag")
					local tx = tag and tag:FindFirstChild("Text")
					local want = (ent.Side == 1 and "A" or "B") .. "존 " .. sides[ent.Side] .. "/" .. q.TeamSize
					if tx and tx.Text ~= want then
						tx.Text = want
					end
				end
			end
		end
		-- 로비 발판 위 안내판
		local pl = lobby and lobby.QueueLabels and lobby.QueueLabels[q.Id]
		if pl then
			local n = counts[q.Id]
			local line2 = (n > 0) and string.format('<font color="#FFE060">대기 %d명</font>', n)
				or (q.Mode == "Solo" and '<font color="#B0B0C8">발판을 밟아 참가</font>' or '<font color="#B0B0C8">A존 / B존 중 골라 서기</font>')
			local txt = line2 .. (pl.Ranked and '  <font color="#FFC840">랭크</font>' or "")
			if pl.Label.Text ~= txt then
				pl.Label.Text = txt
			end
		end
	end
	-- 상단 TOP 5 (처치 → 칠한 셀 순)
	local board = {}
	if S.Phase == "Playing" or S.Phase == "Results" then
		local all = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
			table.insert(all, e)
		end
		table.sort(all, function(a, b)
			if a.Kills ~= b.Kills then
				return a.Kills > b.Kills
			end
			return a.Cells > b.Cells
		end)
		for i = 1, math.min(5, #all) do
			local e = all[i]
			table.insert(board, { Name = e.Name, UserId = e.Player and e.Player.UserId or nil, Kills = e.Kills, Streak = e.Streak or 0,
				Color = MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId), OwnerId = e.OwnerId })
		end
	end
	local mapList = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(maps) do
		table.insert(mapList, { Id = m.Id, Name = m.Name })
	end
	remotes.State:FireAllClients({
		Phase = S.Phase,
		QueueId = S.QueueId,
		Mode = S.Mode,
		ModeName = modeDef and modeDef.Name or "",
		MapName = arena.Name,
		MapId = arena.Id,
		NextMapName = maps[nextMapIndex] and maps[nextMapIndex].Name or "",
		EndsAt = S.EndsAt,
		Teams = scores(),
		Mission = S.Mission,
		Flags = flags,
		QueueCounts = counts,
		QueueInfo = queueInfo,
		Board = board,
		Maps = mapList,
		FinalSplash = S.FinalSplash,
	})
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 스폰
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 팀 보호구: 가슴·등 플레이트, 어깨 패드, 무릎 패드, 탄약 벨트 (ModelKit.Armor)
local function teamVest(character, color)
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("SF_Armor")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	ModelKit.Armor(character, color)
end

-- 총(오른손) + 크루 헬멧 + 잉크 탱크 백팩 (Blender 모델, 업로드 전에는 내장 대체 모델)
-- 손에 든 총: 팔을 앞으로 든 자세(클라이언트 CharacterPose)에서 총구가 정면을 향하도록
-- 손의 -Y(손끝 방향)를 총의 앞(-Z)으로 맞춤
local GUN_GRIP = CFrame.new(0, -0.35, -0.05) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
local function attachGun(e, model)
	local old = model:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local color = MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId)
	local hand = model:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or model:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	if hand then
		local skin = e.Player and Cosmetics.ById[e.Player:GetAttribute("Skin") or ""] or nil
		local gun = ModelKit.Gun(e.WeaponId, color, skin, skin and Cosmetics.MaterialOf(skin.Material) or nil)
		gun.Name = "SF_Gun"
		ModelKit.WeldTo(gun, hand, GUN_GRIP)
	end
end

local function attachGear(e, model)
	for _, n in ipairs({ "SF_Helmet", "SF_Backpack" }) do
		local old = model:FindFirstChild(n)
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local color = MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId)
	attachGun(e, model)
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if head then
		-- 모자 액세서리는 헬멧과 겹치므로 경기 중에만 숨김 (머리카락은 그대로)
		for _, acc in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			local handle = acc:IsA("Accessory") and acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle and handle:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment") then
				handle.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		local helmet = ModelKit.Helmet(color)
		helmet.Name = "SF_Helmet"
		ModelKit.WeldTo(helmet, head, CFrame.new(0, 0.1, 0))
	end
	local torso = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if torso then
		local pack = ModelKit.Backpack(color)
		pack.Name = "SF_Backpack"
		ModelKit.WeldTo(pack, torso, CFrame.new(0, 0.05, torso.Size.Z / 2))
	end
end

local function spawnCFrame(e)
	if S.Mode == "Solo" then
		return arena.SoloSpawns[((e.OwnerId - 1) % #arena.SoloSpawns) + 1]
	end
	local list = arena.Spawns[e.TeamId]
	return list[math.random(1, #list)]
end

local onDied

local function activate(e, model)
	Combatants.SetModel(e, model)
	e.Alive = true
	e.Ink = Config.InkMax
	e.ProtectedUntil = os.clock() + Config.SpawnProtection
	e.SpawnedAt = os.clock()
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	hum.MaxHealth = Config.MaxHealth
	hum.Health = Config.MaxHealth
	hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	local ff = Instance.new("ForceField")
	ff.Visible = true
	ff.Parent = model
	task.delay(Config.SpawnProtection, function()
		if ff.Parent then
			ff:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	teamVest(model, MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId))
	local okGear, gearErr = pcall(attachGear, e, model)
	if not okGear then
		warn("[SplashFront] 장비 부착 실패:", gearErr)
	end
	ItemService.OnSpawn(e)
	-- 기획서 4장: 적 색 위에 서 있으면 발밑에서 페인트가 튀어 위치가 드러남
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
		att.Name = "FeetAttachment"
		att.Position = Vector3.new(0, -2.8, 0)
		att.Parent = root
		local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		pe.Name = "EnemyInkReveal"
		pe.Enabled = false
		pe.Rate = 18
		pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)
		pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
		pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60)
		pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0)
		pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0.05)
		pe.LightEmission = 0.4
		pe.Parent = att
	end
	hum.Died:Connect(function()
		onDied(e, model)
	end)
	Combatants.Sync(e)
end

local function spawnEntity(e)
	if S.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return
	end
	local cf = spawnCFrame(e)
	if e.IsBot then
		local model = BotService.CreateModel(e, cf, MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId))
		activate(e, model)
	else
		local player = e.Player
		if not player or not player.Parent then
			return
		end
		player:LoadCharacter()
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		if root then
			character:PivotTo(cf)
		end
		activate(e, character)
	end
end

onDied = function(e, model)
	if not e.Alive or e.Model ~= model then
		return
	end
	e.Alive = false
	e.Deaths = e.Deaths + 1
	e.Streak = 0
	local killer = e.LastAttacker
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if killer and killer ~= e then
		killer.Kills = killer.Kills + 1
		killer.Streak = (killer.Streak or 0) + 1
		local t = os.clock()
		if t - (killer.LastKillAt or -99) <= Config.MultiKillWindow then
			killer.Multi = (killer.Multi or 1) + 1
		else
			killer.Multi = 1
		end
		killer.LastKillAt = t
		if killer.Player then
			local head = e.LastHeadshot == true
			local coins = Config.Rewards.Kill + (head and Config.Rewards.Headshot or 0)
			local xp = Config.XP.Kill + (head and Config.XP.Headshot or 0)
			DataService.AddXP(killer.Player, xp)
			QuestService.Add(killer.Player, "Kills", 1)
			if head then
				QuestService.Add(killer.Player, "Headshots", 1)
			end
			remotes.FX:FireClient(killer.Player, "Elim", {
				Victim = e.Name, VictimColor = MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId), Head = head, Multi = killer.Multi,
				Streak = killer.Streak, Coins = coins, XP = xp,
			})
		end
		Combatants.Killed:Fire(killer, e, e.LastHeadshot)
		if root then
			PaintService.PaintBelow(root.Position, 6, killer.OwnerId, killer)
		end
	end
	remotes.FX:FireAllClients("Kill", {
		Killer = killer and killer.Name or nil,
		KillerColor = killer and MatchService.ColorOf(killer.OwnerId) or nil,
		Victim = e.Name,
		VictimColor = MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId),
		Head = e.LastHeadshot,
		Effect = killer and killer.KillEffect or nil,
		Weapon = killer and Weapons.Get(killer.WeaponId).Name or nil,
		WeaponId = killer and killer.WeaponId or nil,
		KillerStreak = killer and killer.Streak or 0,
		WeaponClass = killer and Weapons.Get(killer.WeaponId).Class or nil,
		Pos = root and root.Position or nil,
		KillerPlayer = killer and killer.Player or nil,
		VictimPlayer = e.Player,
	})
	e.LastAttacker = nil
	e.LastHeadshot = false
	task.delay(Config.RespawnTime, function()
		if S.Phase == "Playing" and Combatants.FromModel(model) == e then
			if e.IsBot and model.Parent then
				model:Destroy()
			end
			spawnEntity(e)
		end
	end)
end

local function flagTick(dt)
	for _, f in ipairs(S.Flags) do
		local present = {}
		local nPresent = 0
		for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
			if e.Alive and e.Model then
				local r = e.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if r then
					local d = r.Position - f.Position
					if Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude <= Config.Flag.Radius and math.abs(d.Y) < 7 then
						if not present[e.TeamId] then
							present[e.TeamId] = true
							nPresent = nPresent + 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if nPresent == 1 then
			local team = next(present)
			if team ~= f.Owner then
				local ground = PaintService.OwnerBelow(f.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
				local t = Config.Flag.PlantTime
				if ground ~= 0 and ground ~= team then
					t = Config.Flag.PlantTimeEnemyGround
				end
				f.Progress[team] = (f.Progress[team] or 0) + dt / t
				if f.Progress[team] >= 1 then
					f.Owner = team
					f.Progress = {}
					local color = MatchService.ColorOf(team)
					f.Model.Cloth.Color = color
					f.Model.Base.Color = color
					PaintService.PaintAt(f.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Config.Flag.Radius, team, nil)
					announce(string.format("%s 팀이 깃발 %s를 꽂았다!", missionApi.OwnerName(team), f.Name), color)
					remotes.FX:FireAllClients("Cue", { Name = "flag", Owner = team })
				end
			end
		elseif nPresent == 0 then
			for k, v in pairs(f.Progress) do
				f.Progress[k] = math.max(0, v - dt * 0.25)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 색상환에서 충분히 떨어진 두 팀 색을 무작위로 고름
local function pickTeams()
	local pal = Config.TeamPalette or Config.Teams
	for _ = 1, 60 do
		local a = pal[math.random(1, #pal)]
		local b = pal[math.random(1, #pal)]
		if a ~= b then
			local h1 = a.Color:ToHSV()
			local h2 = b.Color:ToHSV()
			local d = math.abs(h1 - h2)
			d = math.min(d, 1 - d)
			if d >= (Config.TeamMinHueGap or 0.2) then
				return { { Id = 1, Name = a.Name, Color = a.Color }, { Id = 2, Name = b.Name, Color = b.Color } }
			end
		end
	end
	return Config.Teams
end

local function mapIndexFor(q)
	local choice = queueMap[q.Id]
	queueMap[q.Id] = nil
	if choice == "random" then
		return math.random(1, #maps), false
	end
	for i, m in ipairs(maps) do
		if m.Id == choice then
			return i, false
		end
	end
	return nextMapIndex, true
end

local function startMatch(q)
	local mode = q.Mode
	local capacity = (mode == "Solo") and 8 or q.TeamSize * 2

	-- 참가자 선정
	local humans = {}
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl:GetAttribute("Queue") == q.Id and not pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") and #humans < capacity then
			table.insert(humans, pl)
		end
	end
	if #humans == 0 then
		return false
	end

	Combatants.Clear()
	local mapIndex, rotate = mapIndexFor(q)
	MatchService.ApplyMap(maps[mapIndex])
	if rotate then
		nextMapIndex = nextMapIndex % #maps + 1
	end
	PaintService.SetRadiusMultiplier(1)
	S.QueueId = q.Id
	S.Mode = mode
	S.Bonus = {}
	S.FlagScore = {}
	S.Flags = {}
	S.Mission = nil
	S.FinalSplash = false
	S.Owners = {}
	S.HasBots = false
	local fx = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
	if fx then
		fx:ClearAllChildren()
	end

	local slots = {}
	if mode == "Solo" then
		for i = 1, capacity do
			table.insert(S.Owners, { OwnerId = i, Name = "", Color = Config.SoloColors[i] })
			slots[i] = { OwnerId = i, TeamId = i }
		end
	else
		local teams = pickTeams()
		for _, t in ipairs(teams) do
			table.insert(S.Owners, { OwnerId = t.Id, Name = t.Name, Color = t.Color })
		end
		-- 경기장 팀 배너를 이번 판 색·이름으로
		for i, b in pairs(arena.TeamBanners or {}) do
			local t = teams[i]
			if t then
				if b.Part then
					b.Part.Color = t.Color
				else
					b.Label.TextColor3 = t.Color
				end
				b.Label.Text = t.Name
			end
		end
		-- 로비에서 선 존(A=1팀, B=2팀) 그대로 팀 구성. 존 정보가 없으면 인원이 적은 쪽으로 → 남는 자리는 봇
		local per = { 0, 0 }
		for i, pl in ipairs(humans) do
			local team = pl:GetAttribute("QueueSide")
			if team ~= 1 and team ~= 2 or per[team] >= q.TeamSize then
				team = (per[1] <= per[2]) and 1 or 2
			end
			per[team] = per[team] + 1
			slots[i] = { OwnerId = team, TeamId = team }
		end
		local i = #humans
		for team = 1, 2 do
			while per[team] < q.TeamSize do
				per[team] = per[team] + 1
				i = i + 1
				slots[i] = { OwnerId = team, TeamId = team }
			end
		end
	end
	local palette = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(S.Owners) do
		palette[o.OwnerId] = o.Color
	end
	PaintService.SetPalette(palette)
	CombatService.SetColorResolver(MatchService.ColorOf)

	local entities = {}
	for i, pl in ipairs(humans) do
		local profile = DataService.Get(pl)
		local e = Combatants.New({
			Id = "P" .. pl.UserId, Name = pl.DisplayName, Player = pl,
			OwnerId = slots[i].OwnerId, TeamId = slots[i].TeamId,
			WeaponId = profile and profile.Equipped or Weapons.Default,
		})
		if profile and profile.EquippedPattern and Cosmetics.ById[profile.EquippedPattern] then
			e.PatternMaterial = Cosmetics.MaterialOf(Cosmetics.ById[profile.EquippedPattern].Material)
		end
		e.KillEffect = profile and profile.EquippedEffect or nil
		local played = pl:GetAttribute("SessionMatches") or 0
		Telemetry.Funnel(pl, played == 0 and "MatchStarted" or "SecondMatch")
		pl:SetAttribute("SessionMatches", played + 1)
		pl:SetAttribute("InMatch", true)
		pl:SetAttribute("OwnerId", e.OwnerId)
		pl:SetAttribute("TeamId", e.TeamId)
		pl:SetAttribute("TeamColor", MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId))
		pl:SetAttribute("Weapon", e.WeaponId)
		table.insert(entities, e)
		if mode == "Solo" then
			S.Owners[i].Name = pl.DisplayName
		end
	end
	local filled = #humans
	if Config.FillWithBots then
		for i = filled + 1, capacity do
			local e = Combatants.New({
				Id = "B" .. i, Name = BotService.NextName(), IsBot = true,
				OwnerId = slots[i].OwnerId, TeamId = slots[i].TeamId, WeaponId = BotService.RandomWeapon(),
			})
			S.HasBots = true
			table.insert(entities, e)
			if mode == "Solo" then
				S.Owners[i].Name = e.Name
			end
		end
	end
	if mode == "Solo" then
		-- 빈 슬롯(봇 미사용 시)은 점수판에서 제외
		local used = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(entities) do
			used[e.OwnerId] = true
		end
		local trimmed = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(S.Owners) do
			if used[o.OwnerId] then
				table.insert(trimmed, o)
			end
		end
		S.Owners = trimmed
	end

	if mode == "Flag" then
		buildFlags()
	end

	S.Phase = "Playing"
	S.StartedAt = now()
	S.EndsAt = now() + Config.MatchLength
	CombatService.SetActive(true)
	for _, e in ipairs(entities) do
		task.spawn(spawnEntity, e)
	end
	BotService.Start()
	MissionService.Start()
	for _, pl in ipairs(humans) do
		remotes.FX:FireClient(pl, "Cue", { Name = "countdown_go" })
	end
	announce(Config.Modes[mode].Name .. " 시작! " .. Config.Modes[mode].Desc, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	return true
end

local function endMatch()
	S.Phase = "Results"
	CombatService.SetActive(false)
	MissionService.Stop()
	local final = scores()
	table.sort(final, function(a, b)
		return a.Score > b.Score
	end)
	local winner = nil
	if #final >= 2 and final[1].Score > final[2].Score then
		winner = final[1].OwnerId
	elseif #final == 1 then
		winner = final[1].OwnerId
	end

	local q = queueDef(S.QueueId)
	local ranked = q and q.Ranked and (not S.HasBots or Config.RankedAllowBots)

	-- 팀 내 기여 순위
	local all = Combatants.All()
	local byOwner = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(all) do
		byOwner[e.OwnerId] = byOwner[e.OwnerId] or {}
		table.insert(byOwner[e.OwnerId], e)
	end
	local perf = {}
	for _, list in pairs(byOwner) do
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return (a.Cells + a.Kills * 30) > (b.Cells + b.Kills * 30)
		end)
		for i, e in ipairs(list) do
			perf[e] = (#list > 1) and (1 - (i - 1) / (#list - 1)) or 1
		end
	end

	local rows = {}
	local statRows = {}
	local seconds = math.max(1, now() - (S.StartedAt or now()))
	for _, e in ipairs(all) do
		local won = (winner ~= nil and e.OwnerId == winner)
		local coins = (won and Config.Rewards.Win or Config.Rewards.Lose)
			+ e.Kills * Config.Rewards.Kill
			+ math.floor(e.Cells / 100) * Config.Rewards.Per100Cells
			+ (e.Headshots or 0) * Config.Rewards.Headshot
			+ e.Coins
		local ratingDelta = nil
		if e.Player and e.Player.Parent then
			coins = DataService.AddCoins(e.Player, coins)
			local p = DataService.Get(e.Player)
			if p then
				p.Matches = p.Matches + 1
				p.Kills = p.Kills + e.Kills
				p.Cells = p.Cells + e.Cells
				if won then
					p.Wins = p.Wins + 1
				end
			end
			if ranked then
				ratingDelta = RankService.Apply(e.Player, won, perf[e])
			end
			RankService.RecordMeta(e.Player)
			DataService.AddXP(e.Player, (won and Config.XP.Win or Config.XP.Lose) + math.floor(e.Cells / Config.XP.PerCells))
			QuestService.Add(e.Player, "Matches", 1)
			QuestService.Add(e.Player, "Cells", e.Cells)
			if won then
				QuestService.Add(e.Player, "Wins", 1)
			end
			Telemetry.Funnel(e.Player, "MatchFinished")
			Telemetry.Economy(e.Player, true, coins, p and p.Coins or 0, "Gameplay", "MatchReward")
			Telemetry.Custom(e.Player, "MatchEnd", e.Cells, S.Mode .. "/" .. tostring(S.QueueId), e.WeaponId, won and "win" or "lose")
			e.Player:SetAttribute("FirstMatch", false)
			table.insert(statRows, {
				WeaponId = e.WeaponId, Won = won, Kills = e.Kills, Deaths = e.Deaths, Shots = e.Shots or 0,
				Hits = e.Hits or 0, Headshots = e.Headshots or 0, Cells = e.Cells, Seconds = seconds,
			})
			DataService.Publish(e.Player)
		end
		table.insert(rows, {
			Name = e.Name, IsBot = e.IsBot, Player = e.Player, OwnerId = e.OwnerId,
			Score = e.Cells + e.Kills * 30, Weapon = Weapons.Get(e.WeaponId).Name,
			Color = MatchService.ColorOf(e.OwnerId), Kills = e.Kills, Deaths = e.Deaths,
			Cells = e.Cells, Coins = e.IsBot and 0 or coins, RatingDelta = ratingDelta, Won = won,
		})
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		return (a.Cells + a.Kills * 30) > (b.Cells + b.Kills * 30)
	end)
	Telemetry.RecordMatch(statRows)

	local winnerInfo = winner and ownerInfo(winner)
	remotes.Results:FireAllClients({
		Mode = S.Mode,
		Teams = final,
		WinnerName = winnerInfo and winnerInfo.Name or nil,
		WinnerColor = winnerInfo and winnerInfo.Color or nil,
		Rows = rows,
		Ranked = ranked,
	})
	broadcast()
	task.wait(Config.ResultsTime)

	-- 정리 후 로비로
	BotService.Stop()
	local fx = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
	if fx then
		fx:ClearAllChildren()
	end
	S.Flags = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(all) do
		if e.Player and e.Player.Parent then
			e.Player:SetAttribute("InMatch", false)
			e.Player:SetAttribute("Queue", nil)
			e.Player:SetAttribute("QueueSide", nil)
			e.Player:SetAttribute("OwnerId", nil)
			e.Player:SetAttribute("TeamColor", nil)
			e.Player:SetAttribute("SpawnZone", false)
			ItemService.Clear(e.Player)
			e.Player:LoadCharacter()
			DataService.Save(e.Player)
		end
	end
	Combatants.Clear()
	MapBuilder.ApplyLighting("Day") -- 로비로 돌아오면 낮 조명
	S.Phase = "Lobby"
	S.Mode = nil
	S.QueueId = nil
	S.Mission = nil
	S.Owners = {}
	broadcast()
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 루프
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pickQueue()
	local counts = queueCounts()
	local best, bestN = nil, 0
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		if counts[q.Id] > bestN then
			best, bestN = q, counts[q.Id]
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- 대기열의 방장 = 가장 먼저 들어온 사람
function MatchService.QueueHost(queueId)
	local best, bestT = nil, math.huge
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if pl:GetAttribute("Queue") == queueId and not pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
			local t = pl:GetAttribute("QueueTime") or 0
			if t < bestT then
				best, bestT = pl, t
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- 큐 + 존에 해당하는 발판 (솔로는 side 0)
local function padOf(queueId, side)
	for _, ent in ipairs(lobby and lobby.QueuePadList or {}) do
		if ent.Queue == queueId and ent.Side == (side or 0) then
			return ent.Pad
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function setQueue(player, queueId, viaPad, side)
	if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
		return
	end
	local q = queueId ~= nil and queueDef(queueId)
	if queueId ~= nil and not q then
		return
	end
	if q and q.Mode ~= "Solo" then
		local c = sideCounts(queueId)
		if player:GetAttribute("Queue") == queueId then
			local cur = player:GetAttribute("QueueSide")
			if cur == 1 or cur == 2 then
				c[cur] = c[cur] - 1
			end
		end
		if side ~= 1 and side ~= 2 then
			side = (c[1] <= c[2]) and 1 or 2
		end
		if c[side] >= q.TeamSize then
			local other = 3 - side
			if viaPad or c[other] >= q.TeamSize then
				remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, (side == 1 and "A" or "B") .. "존이 꽉 찼어요" .. (c[other] < q.TeamSize and " — 반대쪽 존에 서 주세요" or ""),
					Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 120))
				return
			end
			side = other
		end
	else
		side = nil
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("Queue") == queueId and player:GetAttribute("QueueSide") == side then
		return
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Queue", queueId)
	player:SetAttribute("QueueSide", side)
	if queueId then
		player:SetAttribute("QueueTime", os.clock())
		joinAt[player] = os.clock()
		Telemetry.Funnel(player, "Queued")
		-- UI로 참가하면 해당 발판 위로 이동 (발판을 벗어나면 취소되는 규칙과 맞춤)
		local pad = padOf(queueId, side)
		local char = player.Character
		if not viaPad and pad and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pad.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 2, 3.5, math.sin(a) * 2)))
		end
	else
		player:SetAttribute("QueueTime", nil)
		player:SetAttribute("QueueSide", nil)
		joinAt[player] = nil
	end
end

-- 방장만 맵을 고를 수 있음 (mapId = 맵 Id 또는 "random", nil이면 순환)
local function setHostMap(player, mapId)
	local qid = player:GetAttribute("Queue")
	if not qid or player:GetAttribute("InMatch") or MatchService.QueueHost(qid) ~= player then
		return
	end
	if mapId ~= nil and mapId ~= "random" then
		local ok = false
		for _, m in ipairs(maps) do
			if m.Id == mapId then
				ok = true
			end
		end
		if not ok then
			return
		end
	end
	queueMap[qid] = mapId
end

-- 방장: 발판에 정원이 모두 모였으면 카운트다운을 건너뛰고 바로 시작
local function startNow(player)
	local qid = player:GetAttribute("Queue")
	local q = qid and queueDef(qid)
	if not q or MatchService.QueueHost(qid) ~= player then
		return
	end
	local cap = (q.Mode == "Solo") and 8 or q.TeamSize * 2
	if queueCounts()[qid] < cap then
		remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "정원이 모두 모여야 바로 시작할 수 있어요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90))
		return
	end
	if S.Phase == "Countdown" and S.QueueId == qid then
		S.EndsAt = math.min(S.EndsAt, now() + 1)
		announce("방장이 바로 시작을 눌렀어요!", Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 200))
	end
end

-- 경기 도중 로비로 나가기 (보상 없음, 자리는 남은 인원으로 계속)
function MatchService.LeaveMatch(player)
	if not player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
		return
	end
	-- 어떤 단계(경기·결과)에서든 확실히 로비로: 각 정리 단계가 실패해도 다음 단계는 계속
	local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	pcall(function()
		if e then
			e.Alive = false
			Combatants.Remove(e)
		end
	end)
	for _, a in ipairs({ "Queue", "QueueTime", "QueueSide", "OwnerId", "TeamId", "TeamColor" }) do
		player:SetAttribute(a, nil)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("SpawnZone", false)
	player:SetAttribute("InMatch", false)
	pcall(ItemService.Clear, player)
	pcall(function()
		if player.Character then
			player.Character:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[SplashFront] 로비 부활 실패:", err)
		task.delay(1, function()
			if player.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					player:LoadCharacter()
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
	Telemetry.Custom(player, "LeftMatch", 1, S.Mode or "", tostring(S.QueueId), "")
	remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "경기에서 나와 로비로 돌아왔어요", Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255))
end

-- 경기 중 무기 교체: 부활 직후이거나 우리 스폰 근처일 때만
local function nearOwnSpawn(e)
	local r = e.Model and e.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not r then
		return false
	end
	local list = (S.Mode == "Solo") and arena.SoloSpawns or arena.Spawns[e.TeamId]
	for _, cf in ipairs(list or {}) do
		if (cf.Position - r.Position).Magnitude <= Config.WeaponSwitchRadius then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function canSwitch(e)
	if not e.Alive or S.Phase ~= "Playing" then
		return false
	end
	return (os.clock() - (e.SpawnedAt or 0)) <= Config.WeaponSwitchGrace or nearOwnSpawn(e)
end

local function switchWeapon(player, weaponId)
	local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(player)
	local w = Weapons.ById[weaponId]
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	if not e or not w or not p or e.WeaponId == w.Id then
		return
	end
	if not p.Owned[w.Id] then
		remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "보유하지 않은 무기예요 — 로비 상점에서 구매", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 140))
		return
	end
	if not canSwitch(e) then
		remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "무기 교체는 스폰 지점에서만 가능해요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90))
		return
	end
	e.WeaponId = w.Id
	e.Ink = Config.InkMax
	p.Equipped = w.Id
	DataService.Publish(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Weapon", w.Id)
	if e.Model then
		pcall(attachGun, e, e.Model)
		ItemService.OnSpawn(e)
	end
	Combatants.Sync(e)
	remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "무기 교체: " .. w.Name .. " (" .. w.Class .. ")", Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 200))
end

-- 이번 경기에 쓸 맵으로 모든 서비스를 전환
function MatchService.ApplyMap(info)
	arena = info
	MapBuilder.ApplyLighting(info.Lighting or "Day")
	PaintService.Init(info.Cells)
	BotService.SetCells(info.Cells)
	MissionService.SetMap(info)
	local v = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ActiveCells")
	if v then
		v.Value = info.Cells
	end
end

function MatchService.SetNextMap(query)
	for i, m in ipairs(maps) do
		if tostring(query) == tostring(i) or m.Id == query or m.Name == query then
			nextMapIndex = i
			return m.Name
		end
	end
	nextMapIndex = nextMapIndex % #maps + 1
	return maps[nextMapIndex].Name
end

function MatchService.Init(remoteFolder, mapList, lobbyInfo)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	maps = mapList
	arena = maps[1]
	lobby = lobbyInfo
	MissionService.Init(arena, missionApi)
	BotService.SetCells(arena.Cells)
	BotService.SetGoalProvider(function(e)
		if S.Mode == "Flag" then
			local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
			local root = e.Model and e.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			for _, f in ipairs(S.Flags) do
				if f.Owner ~= e.TeamId and root then
					local d = (f.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						best, bestD = f.Position, d
					end
				end
			end
			return best
		end
		if S.Mission and S.Mission.Pos then
			return S.Mission.Pos
		end
		return nil
	end)

	remotes.Queue.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, a, b)
		if a == "map" then
			setHostMap(player, b)
		elseif a == "startNow" then
			startNow(player)
		elseif a == "leaveMatch" then
			MatchService.LeaveMatch(player)
		elseif a == nil or type(a) == "string" then
			setQueue(player, a, false)
		end
	end)
	remotes.SwitchWeapon.OnServerEvent:Connect(switchWeapon)
	for _, ent in ipairs(lobby.QueuePadList) do
		local id, side = ent.Queue, ent.Side
		ent.Pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if not pl or pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
				return
			end
			local want = side > 0 and side or nil
			if pl:GetAttribute("Queue") == id and pl:GetAttribute("QueueSide") == want then
				return
			end
			setQueue(pl, id, true, want)
			if pl:GetAttribute("Queue") == id then
				local zone = side == 1 and " A존" or side == 2 and " B존" or ""
				remotes.Notify:FireClient(pl, "대기열 참가: " .. id .. zone .. " — 발판에서 내려오면 취소돼요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
			end
		end)
	end
	-- 발판을 벗어나면 대기 취소
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.3)
			for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local qid = pl:GetAttribute("Queue")
				if qid and not pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") and os.clock() - (joinAt[pl] or 0) > Config.PadLeaveGrace then
					local pad = padOf(qid, pl:GetAttribute("QueueSide"))
					local char = pl.Character
					local r = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if pad and r and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
						local d = r.Position - pad.Position
						local radius = math.max(pad.Size.Y, pad.Size.Z) / 2 + 0.8
						local onPad = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude <= radius and d.Y > -2 and d.Y < 9
						if not onPad then
							setQueue(pl, nil)
							remotes.Notify:FireClient(pl, "발판을 벗어나 대기가 취소됐어요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 120))
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl)
		joinAt[pl] = nil
		local e = Combatants.FromPlayer(pl)
		if e then
			e.Alive = false
			Combatants.Remove(e)
		end
	end)
end

function MatchService.Run()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			broadcast()
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)

	-- 바닥 색 처리: 적 색 노출 파티클(전원) + 봇 이동속도(플레이어는 클라이언트가 처리)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if S.Phase == "Playing" then
				for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
					if e.Alive and e.Model then
						local r = e.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local h = e.Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local o = r and PaintService.OwnerBelow(r.Position) or 0
						local fa = r and r:FindFirstChild("FeetAttachment")
						local pe = fa and fa:FindFirstChild("EnemyInkReveal")
						if pe then
							local onEnemy = o ~= 0 and o ~= e.OwnerId
							pe.Enabled = onEnemy
							if onEnemy then
								pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(MatchService.ColorOf(o))
							end
						end
						if e.Player then
							local can = canSwitch(e)
							if e.Player:GetAttribute("SpawnZone") ~= can then
								e.Player:SetAttribute("SpawnZone", can)
							end
						end
						if e.IsBot and r and h then
							if o == e.OwnerId then
								h.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeedOwn
							elseif o ~= 0 then
								h.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeedEnemy
							else
								h.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			-- 1) 로비 대기
			S.Phase = "Lobby"
			local q = nil
			while not q do
				task.wait(1)
				q = pickQueue()
			end
			-- 2) 카운트다운
			S.Phase = "Countdown"
			S.QueueId = q.Id
			S.EndsAt = now() + Config.LobbyCountdown
			local aborted = false
			local lastSec = nil
			while now() < S.EndsAt do
				task.wait(0.25)
				local sec = math.ceil(S.EndsAt - now())
				if sec ~= lastSec and sec <= 3 and sec >= 1 then
					lastSec = sec
					for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if pl:GetAttribute("Queue") == q.Id then
							remotes.FX:FireClient(pl, "Cue", { Name = "countdown_tick" })
						end
					end
				end
				if queueCounts()[q.Id] == 0 then
					aborted = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not aborted and startMatch(q) then
				-- 3) 경기
				local last = os.clock()
				while S.Phase == "Playing" do
					task.wait(0.25)
					local dt = os.clock() - last
					last = os.clock()
					local left = S.EndsAt - now()
					if not S.FinalSplash and left <= Config.FinalSplashTime then
						S.FinalSplash = true
						PaintService.SetRadiusMultiplier(Config.FinalSplashMul)
						announce("파이널 스플래시! 페인트 범위 1.5배", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60))
						remotes.FX:FireAllClients("Cue", { Name = "final_splash", Volume = 0.8 })
					end
					if S.Mode == "Flag" then
						flagTick(dt)
						for _, f in ipairs(S.Flags) do
							if f.Owner ~= 0 then
								S.FlagScore[f.Owner] = (S.FlagScore[f.Owner] or 0) + Config.Flag.PointsPerSecond * dt
							end
						end
						for _, v in pairs(S.FlagScore) do
							if v >= Config.Flag.WinScore then
								left = 0
							end
						end
					end
					-- 낙사 판정 (스카이 루프탑 등 낭떠러지 맵)
					if arena.KillY then
						for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
							if e.Alive and e.Model then
								local r = e.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local h = e.Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
								if r and h and h.Health > 0 and r.Position.Y < arena.KillY then
									if os.clock() - e.LastDamaged > 6 then
										e.LastAttacker = nil
									end
									h.Health = 0
								end
							end
						end
					end
					local anyHuman = false
					for _, e in ipairs(Combatants.All()) do
						if not e.IsBot then
							anyHuman = true
						end
					end
					if left <= 0 or not anyHuman then
						endMatch()
					end
				end
			else
				S.QueueId = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MatchService.GetPhase()
	return S.Phase
end

-- 관리자 패널용
function MatchService.SetTimeLeft(seconds)
	if S.Phase == "Playing" or S.Phase == "Countdown" then
		S.EndsAt = now() + math.max(0, seconds)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function MatchService.GetState()
	return S
end

Combatants.Painted:Connect(function(e)
	if e.Player then
		Telemetry.Funnel(e.Player, "FirstPaint")
	end
end)
Combatants.Killed:Connect(function(killer)
	if killer and killer.Player then
		Telemetry.Funnel(killer.Player, "FirstKill")
	end
end)

return MatchService
