Server.Source:
-- 경기 중 제한시간 랜덤 미션
-- 새 미션 추가: MISSIONS 테이블에 { Id, Name, Desc, Duration, Bonus, Begin, Finish } 하나 추가
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)
local PaintService = require(script.Parent.PaintService)

local MissionService = {}

local api = nil      -- MatchService가 넘겨주는 함수 묶음
local info = nil     -- 맵 정보
local running = false
local current = nil
local generation = 0

local function maxKey(t)
	local best, bestV, tie = nil, 0, false
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		if v > bestV then
			best, bestV, tie = k, v, false
		elseif v == bestV and v > 0 then
			tie = true
		end
	end
	if tie then
		return nil
	end
	return best
end

local function randomSpot()
	return info.MissionSpots[math.random(1, #info.MissionSpots)]
end

local function marker(position, radius, color)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = "MissionZone"
	p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
	p.Color = color
	p.Size = Vector3.new(14, radius * 2, radius * 2)
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	p.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX") or workspace
	return p
end

local MISSIONS = {
	{
		Id = "Hotspot", Name = "핫스팟 점령", Duration = 25, Bonus = 4,
		Desc = "빛나는 구역을 가장 많이 칠하라!",
		Begin = function(ctx)
			ctx.Pos = randomSpot()
			ctx.Radius = 12
			ctx.Part = marker(ctx.Pos, ctx.Radius, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 80))
		end,
		Finish = function(ctx)
			if ctx.Part then
				ctx.Part:Destroy()
			end
			return maxKey(PaintService.CountInRadius(ctx.Pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), ctx.Radius))
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "GoldenCan", Name = "골든 캔", Duration = 20, Bonus = 3,
		Desc = "황금 페인트통을 먼저 주워라!",
		Begin = function(ctx)
			ctx.Pos = randomSpot()
			local can = Instance.new("Part")
			can.Name = "GoldenCan"
			can.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			can.Size = Vector3.new(3, 2.4, 2.4)
			can.Anchored = true
			can.CanCollide = false
			can.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			can.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40)
			can.CFrame = CFrame.new(ctx.Pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color = can.Color
			light.Range = 16
			light.Brightness = 3
			light.Parent = can
			can.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("FX") or workspace
			ctx.Part = can
			ctx.Winner = nil
			can.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				if ctx.Winner then
					return
				end
				local e = Combatants.FromPart(hit)
				if e and e.Alive then
					ctx.Winner = e.OwnerId
					ctx.Taker = e
					PaintService.PaintAt(ctx.Pos, 16, e.OwnerId, e)
					can:Destroy()
					api.EndMissionEarly(ctx)
				end
			end)
		end,
		Finish = function(ctx)
			if ctx.Part and ctx.Part.Parent then
				ctx.Part:Destroy()
			end
			return ctx.Winner
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "Hunt", Name = "스플래시 헌트", Duration = 25, Bonus = 3,
		Desc = "먼저 3킬을 달성하라!",
		Begin = function(ctx)
			ctx.Kills = {}
			ctx.Conn = Combatants.Killed:Connect(function(killer)
				if killer and not ctx.Winner then
					ctx.Kills[killer.OwnerId] = (ctx.Kills[killer.OwnerId] or 0) + 1
					if ctx.Kills[killer.OwnerId] >= 3 then
						ctx.Winner = killer.OwnerId
						api.EndMissionEarly(ctx)
					end
				end
			end)
		end,
		Finish = function(ctx)
			ctx.Conn.Disconnect()
			return ctx.Winner
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "PaintRush", Name = "페인트 러시", Duration = 20, Bonus = 3,
		Desc = "20초 동안 가장 많이 칠하라!",
		Begin = function(ctx)
			ctx.Cells = {}
			ctx.Conn = Combatants.Painted:Connect(function(e, n)
				ctx.Cells[e.OwnerId] = (ctx.Cells[e.OwnerId] or 0) + n
			end)
		end,
		Finish = function(ctx)
			ctx.Conn.Disconnect()
			return maxKey(ctx.Cells)
		end,
	},
	{
		Id = "Headhunter", Name = "헤드헌터", Duration = 25, Bonus = 2,
		Desc = "헤드샷으로 먼저 처치하라!",
		Begin = function(ctx)
			ctx.Conn = Combatants.Killed:Connect(function(killer, victim, headshot)
				if killer and headshot and not ctx.Winner then
					ctx.Winner = killer.OwnerId
					ctx.Taker = killer
					api.EndMissionEarly(ctx)
				end
			end)
		end,
		Finish = function(ctx)
			ctx.Conn.Disconnect()
			return ctx.Winner
		end,
	},
}
MissionService.List = MISSIONS

local function finish(ctx)
	if ctx.Done then
		return
	end
	ctx.Done = true
	local ok, winner = pcall(ctx.Def.Finish, ctx)
	if not ok then
		warn("[SplashFront] mission error:", winner)
		winner = nil
	end
	if current == ctx then
		current = nil
	end
	api.SetMission(nil)
	if running and winner then
		api.Cue("mission_result", winner)
		api.AddBonus(winner, ctx.Def.Bonus)
		api.RewardOwner(winner, Config.Rewards.Mission)
		if api.RewardItems then
			api.RewardItems(winner)
		end
		if ctx.Taker then
			ctx.Taker.MissionWins = ctx.Taker.MissionWins + 1
		end
		api.Announce(string.format("%s 성공! %s +%d", ctx.Def.Name, api.OwnerName(winner), ctx.Def.Bonus), api.ColorOf(winner))
	elseif running then
		api.Cue("mission_fail")
		api.Announce(ctx.Def.Name .. " — 아무도 달성하지 못했어요", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200))
	end
end

function MissionService.SetMap(mapInfo)
	info = mapInfo
end

function MissionService.Init(mapInfo, matchApi)
	info = mapInfo
	api = matchApi
	matchApi.EndMissionEarly = function(ctx)
		task.defer(finish, ctx)
	end
end

function MissionService.Start()
	running = true
	generation = generation + 1
	local myGen = generation
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(Config.MissionFirstDelay)
		local last = nil
		while running and myGen == generation do
			local def
			repeat
				def = MISSIONS[math.random(1, #MISSIONS)]
			until def ~= last or #MISSIONS == 1
			last = def
			local ctx = { Def = def }
			current = ctx
			local ok, err = pcall(def.Begin, ctx)
			if not ok then
				warn("[SplashFront] mission begin error:", err)
			end
			api.SetMission({
				Name = def.Name, Desc = def.Desc, Bonus = def.Bonus,
				EndsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + def.Duration, Pos = ctx.Pos,
			})
			api.Cue("mission_start")
			local t = 0
			while t < def.Duration and not ctx.Done and running do
				task.wait(0.25)
				t = t + 0.25
			end
			finish(ctx)
			task.wait(Config.MissionInterval - def.Duration)
		end
	end)
end

function MissionService.Stop()
	running = false
	generation = generation + 1
	if current then
		finish(current)
	end
	current = nil
end

return MissionService

-- 업로드된 Blender 모델(AssetIds.Models)을 서버 시작 때 불러와 ReplicatedStorage.SplashModels에 둠
-- Studio 3D 가져오기로 직접 넣은 모델이 이미 SplashModels에 있으면 그대로 씀
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local AssetIds = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AssetIds)

local ModelService = {}

local function hasPart(m)
	for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function ModelService.Load()
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SplashModels")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "SplashModels"
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	local loaded = 0
	for name, id in pairs(AssetIds.Models) do
		if id ~= 0 and not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local ok, asset = pcall(function()
				return InsertService:LoadAsset(id)
			end)
			if ok and asset then
				-- LoadAsset은 Model 안에 업로드된 모델을 한 겹 더 감싸서 줌
				local model = asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model") or asset
				if hasPart(model) then
					model.Name = name
					model.Parent = folder
					loaded = loaded + 1
				end
				if model ~= asset then
					asset:Destroy()
				end
			else
				warn("[SplashFront] 모델 불러오기 실패:", name, id, asset)
			end
		end
	end
	print("[SplashFront] 모델", loaded, "개 로드 (없는 모델은 내장 대체 모델 사용)")
end

return ModelService

-- 페인트 셀 관리: 칠하기, 면적 집계, 발밑 색 조회
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Combatants = require(script.Parent.Combatants)

local PaintService = {}

local cellsFolder = nil
local palette = {}      -- ownerId -> Color3
local counts = {}       -- ownerId -> 셀 수
local totalCells = 0
local radiusMul = 1
local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
local downRay = RaycastParams.new()
downRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

function PaintService.Init(folder)
	cellsFolder = folder
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	downRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	totalCells = #folder:GetChildren()
	PaintService.Reset()
end

function PaintService.SetPalette(map)
	palette = map
end

function PaintService.SetRadiusMultiplier(m)
	radiusMul = m
end

function PaintService.Reset()
	counts = {}
	if not cellsFolder then
		return
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(cellsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		c:SetAttribute("Owner", 0)
		c.Color = Config.NeutralColor
		c.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	end
end

local function setOwner(cell, ownerId, material)
	local prev = cell:GetAttribute("Owner") or 0
	if prev == ownerId then
		return false
	end
	if prev ~= 0 then
		counts[prev] = (counts[prev] or 1) - 1
	end
	counts[ownerId] = (counts[ownerId] or 0) + 1
	cell:SetAttribute("Owner", ownerId)
	cell.Color = palette[ownerId] or Config.NeutralColor
	cell.Material = material or Enum.Material.Glass -- 기본: 젖은 페인트 느낌 / 페인트 패턴 장착 시 해당 재질
	return true
end

-- position 주변 radius 안의 셀을 ownerId로 칠함. 새로 칠한 셀 수를 돌려줌
function PaintService.PaintAt(position, radius, ownerId, painterEntity)
	if not cellsFolder or ownerId == nil or ownerId == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local r = radius * radiusMul
	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, r, overlap)
	local changed = 0
	local material = painterEntity and painterEntity.PatternMaterial or nil
	for _, cell in ipairs(parts) do
		-- 높이 차이가 큰 셀(다른 층)은 제외
		if math.abs(cell.Position.Y - position.Y) <= math.max(3, r * 0.6) then
			if setOwner(cell, ownerId, material) then
				changed = changed + 1
			end
		end
	end
	if changed > 0 and painterEntity then
		painterEntity.Cells = painterEntity.Cells + changed
		painterEntity.Special = painterEntity.Special + changed
		Combatants.Painted:Fire(painterEntity, changed)
	end
	return changed
end

-- 지점 아래로 레이를 쏴 가장 가까운 바닥 셀을 찾아 칠함 (탄도 경로 칠하기용)
function PaintService.PaintBelow(position, radius, ownerId, painterEntity)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), downRay)
	if hit then
		return PaintService.PaintAt(hit.Position, radius, ownerId, painterEntity)
	end
	return 0
end

-- 발밑 셀의 주인 (없으면 0)
function PaintService.OwnerBelow(position)
	if not cellsFolder then
		return 0
	end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(position, Vector3.new(0, -6, 0), downRay)
	if hit then
		return hit.Instance:GetAttribute("Owner") or 0
	end
	return 0
end

function PaintService.CountInRadius(position, radius)
	local result = {}
	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius, overlap)
	for _, cell in ipairs(parts) do
		local o = cell:GetAttribute("Owner") or 0
		if o ~= 0 then
			result[o] = (result[o] or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	return result
end

function PaintService.GetCounts()
	return counts
end

function PaintService.GetTotal()
	return totalCells
end

-- ownerId -> 0~100 (%)
function PaintService.GetCoverage()
	local out = {}
	for owner, n in pairs(counts) do
		out[owner] = (totalCells > 0) and (n / totalCells * 100) or 0
	end
	return out
end

return PaintService

Server.Source:
-- 일일·주간 퀘스트: 한국 시간 자정(일일)·월요일 0시(주간)에 바뀜. 같은 날엔 모든 플레이어가 같은 퀘스트
-- 진행도는 프로필(p.Quests)에 저장, 달성하면 자동으로 코인·경험치 지급
-- 클라이언트에는 속성 "Quests"(JSON)로 보냄
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local QuestService = {}

local remotes = nil
local KST = 9 * 3600

local function dayKey()
	return math.floor((os.time() + KST) / 86400)
end
local function weekKey()
	-- 1970-01-01은 목요일 → +3일 하면 월요일 시작 주
	return math.floor((os.time() + KST + 3 * 86400) / (7 * 86400))
end
local function secondsLeft(period)
	local t = os.time() + KST
	if period == "Daily" then
		return 86400 - (t % 86400)
	end
	local w = 7 * 86400
	return w - ((t + 3 * 86400) % w)
end

-- 기간 키를 씨앗으로 퀘스트 N개를 고름 (모두 같은 결과)
local function pick(period, key)
	local pool = Config.Quests[period]
	local idx = {}
	for i = 1, #pool do
		idx[i] = i
	end
	local rng = Random.new(key * 7919 + (period == "Daily" and 1 or 2))
	for i = #idx, 2, -1 do
		local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		idx[i], idx[j] = idx[j], idx[i]
	end
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(Config.Quests.PerPeriod, #idx) do
		table.insert(out, pool[idx[i]])
	end
	return out
end

local function ensure(p)
	p.Quests = type(p.Quests) == "table" and p.Quests or {}
	local q = p.Quests
	for _, period in ipairs({ "Daily", "Weekly" }) do
		local key = (period == "Daily") and dayKey() or weekKey()
		local cur = q[period]
		if type(cur) ~= "table" or cur.Key ~= key then
			local list = {}
			for _, def in ipairs(pick(period, key)) do
				table.insert(list, { Id = def.Id, P = 0, Done = false })
			end
			q[period] = { Key = key, List = list }
		end
	end
	return q
end

local function defOf(period, id)
	for _, d in ipairs(Config.Quests[period]) do
		if d.Id == id then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function QuestService.Publish(player)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	if not p then
		return
	end
	local q = ensure(p)
	local view = {}
	for _, period in ipairs({ "Daily", "Weekly" }) do
		for _, it in ipairs(q[period].List) do
			local d = defOf(period, it.Id)
			if d then
				table.insert(view, { Period = period, Name = d.Name, P = math.min(it.P, d.Goal), Goal = d.Goal, Reward = d.Reward, Done = it.Done,
					Left = secondsLeft(period) })
			end
		end
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Quests", HttpService:JSONEncode(view))
end

-- 통계 stat을 n만큼 올림 (달성 시 보상)
function QuestService.Add(player, stat, n)
	if not player or not player.Parent or (n or 0) <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	if not p then
		return
	end
	local q = ensure(p)
	local changed = false
	for _, period in ipairs({ "Daily", "Weekly" }) do
		for _, it in ipairs(q[period].List) do
			local d = defOf(period, it.Id)
			if d and d.Stat == stat and not it.Done then
				it.P = it.P + n
				changed = true
				if it.P >= d.Goal then
					it.Done = true
					DataService.AddCoins(player, d.Reward)
					DataService.AddXP(player, Config.XP.Quest)
					if remotes then
						remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, string.format("[%s] %s 완료! +%d 코인", period == "Daily" and "일일" or "주간", d.Name, d.Reward),
							Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if changed then
		QuestService.Publish(player)
	end
end

function QuestService.Init(remoteFolder)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	-- 날짜가 바뀌면 새 퀘스트로 (1분마다 확인)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				QuestService.Publish(pl)
			end
			task.wait(60)
		end
	end)
end

return QuestService

Server.Source:
-- 시즌 레이팅 + 글로벌 리더보드(OrderedDataStore)
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local RankService = {}

local ordered = nil
local meta = nil -- userId -> { n = 이름, w = 승수, r = 레이팅 } (TOP 50 창에 승수 표시용)
pcall(function()
	ordered = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("SplashFront_Rating_" .. Config.DataVersion .. "_" .. Config.Season)
	meta = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SplashFront_RankMeta_" .. Config.DataVersion .. "_" .. Config.Season)
end)

local cache = { At = -1e9, Rows = nil }
local CACHE_SECONDS = 90

-- 경기가 끝날 때마다 이름·승수·레이팅을 기록
function RankService.RecordMeta(player)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	if not p or not meta then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			meta:SetAsync("u" .. player.UserId, { n = player.DisplayName, w = p.Wins or 0, r = p.Rating })
		end)
	end)
end

local function serverRows()
	local list = {}
	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = pl:GetAttribute("Rating") or Config.Rating.Start
		table.insert(list, { UserId = pl.UserId, Name = pl.DisplayName, Rating = r, Tier = Config.GetTier(r).Name, Wins = pl:GetAttribute("Wins") or 0 })
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.Rating > b.Rating
	end)
	for i, row in ipairs(list) do
		row.Rank = i
	end
	return list
end

-- 상위 count명 (기본 50). DataStore를 못 쓰면 현재 서버 플레이어로 대신
function RankService.GetTop(count)
	count = math.clamp(count or 50, 1, 100)
	if cache.Rows and os.clock() - cache.At < CACHE_SECONDS then
		return cache.Rows, cache.Global
	end
	local rows = nil
	if ordered then
		pcall(function()
			local entries = ordered:GetSortedAsync(false, count):GetCurrentPage()
			local out = {}
			local pending = #entries
			for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do
				local userId = tonumber(string.sub(entry.key, 2)) or 0
				out[i] = { Rank = i, UserId = userId, Name = "?", Rating = entry.value, Tier = Config.GetTier(entry.value).Name, Wins = 0 }
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok, m = pcall(function()
						return meta and meta:GetAsync(entry.key)
					end)
					if ok and type(m) == "table" then
						out[i].Name = m.n or out[i].Name
						out[i].Wins = m.w or 0
					else
						pcall(function()
							out[i].Name = Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
						end)
					end
					pending = pending - 1
				end)
			end
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while pending > 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 8 do
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			if #out > 0 then
				rows = out
			end
		end)
	end
	local global = rows ~= nil
	rows = rows or serverRows()
	cache = { At = os.clock(), Rows = rows, Global = global }
	return rows, global
end

function RankService.Init(remotes)
	remotes.Leaderboard.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
		local rows, global = RankService.GetTop(50)
		return { Rows = rows, Global = global, Season = Config.Season }
	end
end

-- performance: 0~1 (팀 내 기여 순위). 반환: 레이팅 변화량
function RankService.Apply(player, won, performance)
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	if not p then
		return 0
	end
	local delta = won and Config.Rating.Win or Config.Rating.Lose
	delta = delta + math.floor(Config.Rating.PerformanceMax * (performance or 0) + 0.5)
	p.Rating = math.max(0, p.Rating + delta)
	DataService.Publish(player)
	if ordered then
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				ordered:SetAsync("u" .. player.UserId, p.Rating)
			end)
		end)
	end
	return delta
end

function RankService.StartBoard(textLabel)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local lines = { "  시즌 " .. Config.Season .. " 랭킹 TOP 10", "" }
			local ok = false
			if ordered then
				ok = pcall(function()
					local pages = ordered:GetSortedAsync(false, 10)
					local entries = pages:GetCurrentPage()
					for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do
						local userId = tonumber(string.sub(entry.key, 2))
						local name = "?"
						pcall(function()
							name = Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
						end)
						local tier = Config.GetTier(entry.value).Name
						table.insert(lines, string.format("  %2d. %s  %d (%s)", i, name, entry.value, tier))
					end
				end)
			end
			if not ok then
				-- DataStore를 쓸 수 없을 때(스튜디오 등)는 현재 서버 플레이어로 표시
				local list = {}
				for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					table.insert(list, { pl.Name, pl:GetAttribute("Rating") or Config.Rating.Start })
				end
				table.sort(list, function(a, b)
					return a[2] > b[2]
				end)
				for i, row in ipairs(list) do
					if i > 10 then
						break
					end
					table.insert(lines, string.format("  %2d. %s  %d (%s)", i, row[1], row[2], Config.GetTier(row[2]).Name))
				end
				table.insert(lines, "")
				table.insert(lines, "  (서버 내 순위 · 글로벌 랭킹은 게시 후 표시)")
			end
			textLabel.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
			task.wait(60)
		end
	end)
end

return RankService

-- 무기 상점(게임 코인) + 로벅스 결제 처리
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local CrateService = require(script.Parent.CrateService)
local Telemetry = require(script.Parent.TelemetryService)

local ShopService = {}

local function handle(player, action, weaponId)
	if (action == "buy" or action == "buyCosmetic") and not DataService.IsSafe(player) then
		return { ok = false, msg = "저장 데이터를 불러오지 못해 지금은 구매할 수 없어요. 다시 접속해 주세요" }
	end
	if action == "crateTest" then
		return CrateService.TestOpen(player)
	elseif action == "equipCosmetic" then
		return CrateService.Equip(player, weaponId)
	elseif action == "buyCosmetic" then
		-- 포인트(코인)로 외형 직접 구매
		local Cosmetics = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Cosmetics)
		local item = Cosmetics.ById[weaponId]
		local p = DataService.Get(player)
		local price = item and Config.SkinPrices[item.Rarity]
		if not item or not p or not price then
			return { ok = false, msg = "알 수 없는 아이템" }
		end
		p.Cosmetics = p.Cosmetics or {}
		if p.Cosmetics[item.Id] then
			return { ok = false, msg = "이미 보유 중" }
		end
		if p.Coins < price then
			return { ok = false, msg = "코인이 부족해요 (" .. (price - p.Coins) .. " 부족)" }
		end
		p.Coins = p.Coins - price
		p.Cosmetics[item.Id] = true
		DataService.Publish(player)
		DataService.Save(player)
		Telemetry.Economy(player, false, price, p.Coins, "Shop", "Cosmetic_" .. item.Id)
		return { ok = true, msg = item.Name .. " 구매 완료! 컬렉션에서 장착하세요" }
	end
	local p = DataService.Get(player)
	local w = Weapons.ById[weaponId]
	if not p or not w then
		return { ok = false, msg = "알 수 없는 무기" }
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
		return { ok = false, msg = "경기 중에는 변경할 수 없어요" }
	end
	if action == "buy" then
		if p.Owned[w.Id] then
			return { ok = false, msg = "이미 보유 중" }
		end
		if p.Coins < w.Price then
			return { ok = false, msg = "코인이 부족해요 (" .. (w.Price - p.Coins) .. " 부족)" }
		end
		p.Coins = p.Coins - w.Price
		p.Owned[w.Id] = true
		p.Equipped = w.Id
		DataService.Publish(player)
		DataService.Save(player)
		Telemetry.Economy(player, false, w.Price, p.Coins, "Shop", "Weapon_" .. w.Id)
		return { ok = true, msg = w.Name .. " 구매 완료!" }
	elseif action == "equip" then
		if not p.Owned[w.Id] then
			return { ok = false, msg = "먼저 구매하세요" }
		end
		p.Equipped = w.Id
		DataService.Publish(player)
		return { ok = true, msg = w.Name .. " 장착" }
	end
	return { ok = false, msg = "잘못된 요청" }
end

function ShopService.Init(remotes)
	remotes.Shop.OnServerInvoke = handle
	CrateService.Init(remotes)

	-- 코인 팩 / 크로마 크레이트 (개발자 상품)
	-- PurchaseId를 DataStore에 기록해 서버 재시도·재접속 시 중복 지급을 막음
	local purchaseStore = nil
	pcall(function()
		purchaseStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SplashFront_Purchases_" .. Config.DataVersion)
	end)

	local function grant(player, productId)
		if productId == Config.Monetization.CrateProductId and productId ~= 0 then
			return CrateService.Open(player) ~= nil
		end
		local coins = Config.Monetization.CoinProducts[productId]
		local p = DataService.Get(player)
		if not coins or not p then
			return false
		end
		p.Coins = p.Coins + coins
		DataService.Publish(player)
		DataService.Save(player)
		Telemetry.Economy(player, true, coins, p.Coins, "IAP", "CoinPack_" .. tostring(productId))
		return true
	end

	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receipt)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
		-- 데이터를 못 불러온 상태면 지급을 미룸 (로벅스 구매품이 저장 안 되는 일이 없게, 다음 접속 때 다시 처리됨)
		if not player or not DataService.Get(player) or not DataService.IsSafe(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
		local key = "p_" .. tostring(receipt.PurchaseId)
		if purchaseStore then
			local ok, done = pcall(function()
				return purchaseStore:GetAsync(key)
			end)
			if not ok then
				return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
			end
			if done then
				return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
			end
		end
		if not grant(player, receipt.ProductId) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
		if purchaseStore then
			pcall(function()
				purchaseStore:SetAsync(key, { u = receipt.PlayerId, p = receipt.ProductId, t = os.time() })
			end)
		end
		Telemetry.Custom(player, "Purchase", receipt.CurrencySpent or 0, tostring(receipt.ProductId))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end

	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if purchased and passId == Config.Monetization.VipGamePassId then
			player:SetAttribute("Vip", true)
		end
	end)
end

return ShopService

Server.Name: Signal
TelemetryService
Server.Source:
-- 클로즈 테스트 지표 수집
-- 1) Roblox AnalyticsService: 온보딩 퍼널 / 경제 / 커스텀 이벤트 → Creator Hub > 분석 에서 확인
-- 2) 무기별 밸런스 통계 (자체 DataStore) → 관리자 패널 "밸런스 리포트"
-- 3) 게임 내 피드백 (자체 DataStore) → 관리자 패널 "피드백 보기"
local AnalyticsService = game:GetService("AnalyticsService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)

local Telemetry = {}

local balanceStore, feedbackStore
pcall(function()
	balanceStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SplashFront_Balance_" .. Config.DataVersion)
	feedbackStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SplashFront_Feedback_" .. Config.DataVersion)
end)

local funnelDone = {}   -- player -> { [step] = true }
local joinTime = {}
local lastFeedback = {}

-- 내부 메모리 집계 (DataStore를 못 쓸 때 리포트용)
local localBalance = {}

local function fields(a, b, c)
	local f = {}
	pcall(function()
		if a then
			f[Enum.AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.CustomField01.Name] = tostring(a)
		end
		if b then
			f[Enum.AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.CustomField02.Name] = tostring(b)
		end
		if c then
			f[Enum.AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.CustomField03.Name] = tostring(c)
		end
	end)
	return f
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AnalyticsService 래퍼 (실패해도 게임에 영향 없음)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 온보딩 퍼널 단계 (세션당 1회)
Telemetry.Steps = {
	Joined = { 1, "입장" },
	Queued = { 2, "대기열 참가" },
	MatchStarted = { 3, "첫 경기 시작" },
	FirstPaint = { 4, "첫 페인트" },
	FirstKill = { 5, "첫 처치" },
	MatchFinished = { 6, "첫 경기 완료" },
	SecondMatch = { 7, "두 번째 경기 시작" },
	OpenedShop = { 8, "상점 열기" },
}

function Telemetry.Funnel(player, key)
	local step = Telemetry.Steps[key]
	if not step or not player then
		return
	end
	funnelDone[player] = funnelDone[player] or {}
	if funnelDone[player][key] then
		return
	end
	funnelDone[player][key] = true
	pcall(function()
		AnalyticsService:LogOnboardingFunnelStepEvent(player, step[1], step[2])
	end)
end

function Telemetry.Economy(player, isSource, amount, endingBalance, transactionType, sku)
	pcall(function()
		AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent(player,
			isSource and Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Source or Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Sink,
			"Coins", amount, endingBalance, transactionType, sku)
	end)
end

function Telemetry.Custom(player, name, value, a, b, c)
	pcall(function()
		AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player, name, value or 1, fields(a, b, c))
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 무기 밸런스 통계
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local STAT_KEYS = { "Matches", "Wins", "Kills", "Deaths", "Shots", "Hits", "Headshots", "Cells", "Seconds" }

-- rows: { {WeaponId, Won, Kills, Deaths, Shots, Hits, Headshots, Cells, Seconds}, ... } (사람 플레이어만)
function Telemetry.RecordMatch(rows)
	local agg = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
		local a = agg[r.WeaponId]
		if not a then
			a = {}
			for _, k in ipairs(STAT_KEYS) do
				a[k] = 0
			end
			agg[r.WeaponId] = a
		end
		a.Matches = a.Matches + 1
		a.Wins = a.Wins + (r.Won and 1 or 0)
		for _, k in ipairs({ "Kills", "Deaths", "Shots", "Hits", "Headshots", "Cells", "Seconds" }) do
			a[k] = a[k] + (r[k] or 0)
		end
	end
	for weaponId, a in pairs(agg) do
		local mem = localBalance[weaponId] or {}
		for _, k in ipairs(STAT_KEYS) do
			mem[k] = (mem[k] or 0) + a[k]
		end
		localBalance[weaponId] = mem
		if balanceStore then
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					balanceStore:UpdateAsync("w_" .. weaponId, function(old)
						old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
						for _, k in ipairs(STAT_KEYS) do
							old[k] = (old[k] or 0) + a[k]
						end
						return old
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function Telemetry.BalanceReport()
	local lines = { string.format("%-10s %5s %6s %6s %6s %7s %7s", "무기", "판수", "승률", "K/D", "명중률", "헤드%", "셀/분") }
	for _, w in ipairs(Weapons.List) do
		local s = nil
		if balanceStore then
			pcall(function()
				s = balanceStore:GetAsync("w_" .. w.Id)
			end)
		end
		s = s or localBalance[w.Id]
		if s and (s.Matches or 0) > 0 then
			local kd = (s.Kills or 0) / math.max(1, s.Deaths or 0)
			local acc = (s.Hits or 0) / math.max(1, s.Shots or 0) * 100
			local head = (s.Headshots or 0) / math.max(1, s.Hits or 0) * 100
			local cpm = (s.Cells or 0) / math.max(1, (s.Seconds or 0) / 60)
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%-10s %5d %5.0f%% %6.2f %5.0f%% %6.0f%% %7.0f", w.Id, s.Matches,
				(s.Wins or 0) / s.Matches * 100, kd, acc, head, cpm))
		else
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%-10s %5d  (데이터 없음)", w.Id, 0))
		end
	end
	table.insert(lines, "")
	table.insert(lines, "판단 기준(예시): 승률 45~55%, K/D 0.8~1.25 밖이면 조정 후보")
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 피드백
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local CATEGORIES = { Bug = "버그", Balance = "밸런스", Fun = "재미", Other = "기타" }

function Telemetry.SubmitFeedback(player, rating, category, text)
	if type(rating) ~= "number" or rating < 1 or rating > 5 then
		return { ok = false, msg = "별점을 골라주세요" }
	end
	if not CATEGORIES[category] then
		category = "Other"
	end
	if type(text) ~= "string" then
		text = ""
	end
	text = string.sub(text, 1, 500)
	local now = os.time()
	if lastFeedback[player] and now - lastFeedback[player] < Config.CBT.FeedbackCooldown then
		return { ok = false, msg = "잠시 후 다시 보내주세요" }
	end
	lastFeedback[player] = now
	local entry = {
		t = now, u = player.UserId, n = player.Name, r = math.floor(rating), c = category, m = text,
		b = Config.Build, phase = player:GetAttribute("InMatch") and "match" or "lobby",
	}
	Telemetry.Custom(player, "Feedback", entry.r, category, Config.Build)
	print(string.format("[SplashFront][피드백] %s *%d [%s] %s", player.Name, entry.r, CATEGORIES[category], text))
	if feedbackStore then
		local key = "day_" .. os.date("!%Y%m%d", now)
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				feedbackStore:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
					old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
					table.insert(old, entry)
					while #old > 300 do
						table.remove(old, 1)
					end
					return old
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end
	return { ok = true, msg = "피드백 고마워요! 테스트에 큰 도움이 됩니다" }
end

function Telemetry.FeedbackList()
	local list = {}
	if feedbackStore then
		for d = 0, 1 do
			local key = "day_" .. os.date("!%Y%m%d", os.time() - d * 86400)
			pcall(function()
				local v = feedbackStore:GetAsync(key)
				if type(v) == "table" then
					for _, e in ipairs(v) do
						table.insert(list, e)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.t > b.t
	end)
	local lines = {}
	local sum, n = 0, 0
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		sum = sum + e.r
		n = n + 1
	end
	if n == 0 then
		return "최근 2일 피드백 없음 (DataStore가 꺼져 있으면 서버 출력창에만 기록됩니다)"
	end
	table.insert(lines, string.format("최근 2일 피드백 %d건 · 평균 *%.1f", n, sum / n))
	for i, e in ipairs(list) do
		if i > 20 then
			break
		end
		table.insert(lines, string.format("%s  *%d [%s] %s: %s", os.date("!%m/%d %H:%M", e.t + 9 * 3600), e.r,
			CATEGORIES[e.c] or e.c, e.n, e.m))
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Telemetry.Init(remotes)
	remotes.Feedback.OnServerInvoke = function(player, rating, category, text)
		return Telemetry.SubmitFeedback(player, rating, category, text)
	end
	remotes.Telemetry.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, key)
		-- 클라이언트에서 오는 건 상점 열기 같은 UI 단계만 허용
		if key == "OpenedShop" then
			Telemetry.Funnel(player, key)
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		joinTime[player] = os.clock()
		Telemetry.Funnel(player, "Joined")
	end)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		joinTime[p] = os.clock()
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		if joinTime[player] then
			Telemetry.Custom(player, "SessionMinutes", math.floor((os.clock() - joinTime[player]) / 60 + 0.5), Config.Build)
		end
		joinTime[player] = nil
		funnelDone[player] = nil
		lastFeedback[player] = nil
	end)
end

return Telemetry

Client.Name: CBTPanel
Client.Source:
-- 클로즈 테스트 UI: 피드백 창(모든 테스터) + 관리자 패널(F2, 관리자만)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local UI = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("UIKit"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local CBT = {}

local remotes, HUD
local gui, feedbackFrame, adminFrame, reportBox, feedbackBtn
local rating = 0
local modalHandler = function() end
local category = "Fun"

local function make(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		o[k] = v
	end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

local function corner(p, r)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8) }, p)
end

local function button(parent, text, color, props)
	local b = make("TextButton", { Text = text, BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, AutoButtonColor = true }, parent)
	corner(b, 8)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
		b[k] = v
	end
	return b
end

local function label(parent, props)
	local t = make("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "" }, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		t[k] = v
	end
	return t
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 피드백 창
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local starButtons = {}
local catButtons = {}

local function refreshFeedback()
	for i, b in ipairs(starButtons) do
		b.TextColor3 = (i <= rating) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110)
	end
	for id, b in pairs(catButtons) do
		b.BackgroundColor3 = (id == category) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 46, 170) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80)
	end
end

function CBT.OpenFeedback()
	feedbackFrame.Visible = true
	modalHandler(true)
	refreshFeedback()
end

local function buildFeedback()
	feedbackFrame = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 330), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -230, 0.5, -165), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30),
		Visible = false, ZIndex = 30 }, gui)
	corner(feedbackFrame, 14)
	make("UIStroke", { Thickness = 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 214, 200) }, feedbackFrame)
	label(feedbackFrame, { Text = "테스트 피드백", TextSize = 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 12), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 30), ZIndex = 31 })
	label(feedbackFrame, { Text = "이번 판 어땠나요?", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 48), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 20), ZIndex = 31,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 210), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham })
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local b = make("TextButton", { Text = tostring(i), TextSize = 30, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14 + (i - 1) * 42, 70), ZIndex = 31 }, feedbackFrame)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			rating = i
			refreshFeedback()
		end)
		starButtons[i] = b
	end
	local cats = { { "Bug", "버그" }, { "Balance", "밸런스" }, { "Fun", "재미" }, { "Other", "기타" } }
	for i, c in ipairs(cats) do
		local b = button(feedbackFrame, c[2], nil, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18 + (i - 1) * 106, 118), ZIndex = 31 })
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			category = c[1]
			refreshFeedback()
		end)
		catButtons[c[1]] = b
	end
	local box = make("TextBox", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 100), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 158), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 50),
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), PlaceholderText = "자유롭게 적어주세요 (버그는 어디서·무엇을 하다가 생겼는지)", Text = "",
		ClearTextOnFocus = false, MultiLine = true, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 14, ZIndex = 31 }, feedbackFrame)
	corner(box, 8)
	make("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8) }, box)
	local send = button(feedbackFrame, "보내기", Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 160), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 38), Position = UDim2.new(1, -158, 1, -52), ZIndex = 31 })
	UI.CloseButton(feedbackFrame, function()
		feedbackFrame.Visible = false
		modalHandler(adminFrame ~= nil and adminFrame.Visible)
	end, 36).ZIndex = 35
	send.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if rating == 0 then
			HUD.Banner("별점을 먼저 골라주세요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80))
			return
		end
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			return remotes.Feedback:InvokeServer(rating, category, box.Text)
		end)
		if ok and res then
			HUD.Banner(res.msg, res.ok and Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
			if res.ok then
				box.Text = ""
				rating = 0
				feedbackFrame.Visible = false
				modalHandler(adminFrame ~= nil and adminFrame.Visible)
			end
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 관리자 패널
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function admin(action, arg)
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return remotes.Admin:InvokeServer(action, arg)
	end)
	if ok and res then
		local text = tostring(res.msg)
		if string.find(text, "\n") then

	label(adminFrame, { Text = "<- 시간/코인/개봉 수/레이팅 값", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(142, 40), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 30), ZIndex = 41,
		TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 190) })
	local cmds = {
		{ "time", "남은 시간 설정" }, { "endMatch", "경기 즉시 종료" }, { "coins", "코인 지급" }, { "unlockAll", "무기 전부 해금" },
		{ "crate", "무료 크레이트 개봉" }, { "special", "스페셜 100%" }, { "bots", "봇 채우기 토글" }, { "fastMissions", "빠른 미션 토글" },
		{ "rankedBots", "봇 랭크반영 토글" }, { "rating", "레이팅 설정" }, { "resetProfile", "내 데이터 초기화" },
		{ "nextMap", "다음 맵 변경" }, { "balance", "밸런스 리포트" }, { "feedback", "피드백 보기" },

		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, Text = "밸런스 리포트 / 피드백 결과가 여기 표시됩니다", ZIndex = 41 }, adminFrame)

function CBT.ToggleAdmin()
	if not player:GetAttribute("IsAdmin") or not adminFrame then
		return
	end
	adminFrame.Visible = not adminFrame.Visible
	modalHandler(adminFrame.Visible or feedbackFrame.Visible)
end

-- 창이 열리면 1인칭 마우스 잠금을 풀기 위해 WeaponController에 알림

	modalHandler = fn
end

function CBT.Init(remoteFolder, hud)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	HUD = hud
	gui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "SplashCBT", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 20, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling },
		player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	buildFeedback()
	-- 서버가 DevTools 속성을 넣을 때까지 잠깐 대기 (정식 서버면 운영 명령만 표시)
	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while player:GetAttribute("DevTools") == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 5 do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		buildAdmin()
	end)

	-- 항상 보이는 피드백 버튼 (로비 + 결과 화면)
	-- 0.5: 왼쪽 아래 피드백 버튼 제거 (채팅창 자리). 피드백은 F4 또는 결과 화면 안내로
	feedbackBtn = nil
	label(gui, { Text = (Config.CBT.Enabled and "CLOSED BETA · " or "SPLASH FRONT v") .. Config.Build, Position = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(204, 20), TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold })

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
			CBT.ToggleAdmin()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F4 and Config.CBT.Enabled then
			CBT.OpenFeedback()
		end
	end)

end

-- 결과 화면이 뜰 때 피드백 유도
function CBT.OnResults()
	if not Config.CBT.Enabled then
		return
	end
	HUD.Banner("이번 판 어땠나요? 피드백 [F4]", Color3.fromRGB(0, 214, 200))
end

return CBT

Client.Name: CharacterPose
Client.Source:
-- 캐릭터 자세 (클라이언트): 경기 중인 모든 캐릭터(플레이어·봇)
--  · 조준: 총을 앞으로 겨누고 상체·머리·팔이 조준 각도(AimPitch)를 나눠서 따라감
--  · 달리기: 상체를 숙이고 총을 비스듬히 내려 듦 · 걷기: 몸을 낮추고 조심스럽게 · 앉기: 무릎을 굽힌 자세 (움직이면 종종걸음)
--  · 사격 반동: 팔이 위로 튀었다가 돌아옴
-- 애니메이션 에셋 없이 Motor6D.Transform을 Roblox 기본 애니메이션 다음 단계에서 덮어씀
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Pose = {}

local kicks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- model -> 반동 각도(도)
local cache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- model -> 관절
local smooth = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) -- model -> { Pitch, Run, Crouch, Walk }
local localStance = "Normal"

function Pose.Kick(model, recoil)
	if model then
		kicks[model] = math.min(28, (kicks[model] or 0) + 7 + (recoil or 1) * 2.5)
	end
end

function Pose.SetLocalStance(s)
	localStance = s or "Normal"
end

local function find(model, partName, jointName)
	local p = model:FindFirstChild(partName)
	return p and p:FindFirstChild(jointName)
end

local function jointsOf(model)
	local j = cache[model]
	if j and j.RS and j.RS.Parent then
		return j
	end
	j = {
		RS = find(model, "RightUpperArm", "RightShoulder"), LS = find(model, "LeftUpperArm", "LeftShoulder"),
		RE = find(model, "RightLowerArm", "RightElbow"), LE = find(model, "LeftLowerArm", "LeftElbow"),
		RW = find(model, "RightHand", "RightWrist"), LW = find(model, "LeftHand", "LeftWrist"),
		Waist = find(model, "UpperTorso", "Waist"), Neck = find(model, "Head", "Neck"),
		LH = find(model, "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftHip"), RH = find(model, "RightUpperLeg", "RightHip"),
		LK = find(model, "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftKnee"), RK = find(model, "RightLowerLeg", "RightKnee"),
		LA = find(model, "LeftFoot", "LeftAnkle"), RA = find(model, "RightFoot", "RightAnkle"),
	}
	if not j.RS then
		j.R6 = true
		j.RS = find(model, "Torso", "Right Shoulder")
		j.LS = find(model, "Torso", "Left Shoulder")
	end
	cache[model] = j
	return j
end

local function armed(model)
	if not model or not model:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun") then
		return false
	end
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0
end

local function rad(d)
	return math.rad(d)
end

local function pose(model, pitchDeg, stance, dt)
	local j = jointsOf(model)
	if not j.RS then
		return
	end
	local sm = smooth[model]
	if not sm then
		sm = { Pitch = pitchDeg, Run = 0, Crouch = 0, Walk = 0, T = 0 }
		smooth[model] = sm
	end
	local k = 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt)
	sm.Pitch = sm.Pitch + (pitchDeg - sm.Pitch) * k
	sm.Run = sm.Run + (((stance == "Run") and 1 or 0) - sm.Run) * k
	sm.Crouch = sm.Crouch + (((stance == "Crouch") and 1 or 0) - sm.Crouch) * k
	sm.Walk = sm.Walk + (((stance == "Walk") and 1 or 0) - sm.Walk) * k
	local kick = kicks[model] or 0
	if kick > 0.05 then
		kicks[model] = kick * math.exp(-14 * dt)
	end
	local p = sm.Pitch
	local run, crouch, walk = sm.Run, sm.Crouch, sm.Walk

	if j.R6 then
		local raise = rad(90 + p * 0.8 + kick - run * 45)
		j.RS.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, raise)
		if j.LS then
			j.LS.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -raise) * CFrame.Angles(rad(30), 0, 0)
		end
		return
	end

	-- 상체·머리가 조준 각도의 일부를 맡음 (달리기는 앞으로 숙임, 걷기는 살짝 웅크림)
	if j.Waist then
		j.Waist.Transform = CFrame.Angles(rad(p * 0.3 - run * 14 - walk * 6 - crouch * 8), 0, 0)
	end
	if j.Neck then
		j.Neck.Transform = CFrame.Angles(rad(p * 0.35 + run * 10 + crouch * 6), 0, 0)
	end

	-- 팔: 조준 자세 ↔ 달리기 들기 자세
	local armPitch = 90 + p * 0.35 + kick
	local runDown = run * 48
	j.RS.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, rad(8 + run * 22), 0) * CFrame.Angles(rad(armPitch - runDown), 0, 0)
	if j.RE then
		j.RE.Transform = CFrame.Angles(rad(run * 25), 0, 0)
	end
	if j.RW then
		j.RW.Transform = CFrame.new()
	end
	if j.LS then
		j.LS.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-42 + run * 10), 0) * CFrame.Angles(rad(armPitch - 6 - runDown), 0, 0)
	end
	if j.LE then
		j.LE.Transform = CFrame.Angles(rad(18 + run * 20), 0, 0)
	end
	if j.LW then
		j.LW.Transform = CFrame.new()
	end

	-- 앉기: 무릎을 굽힘 (움직이면 좌우 번갈아 종종걸음). 기본 걷기 다리 동작 위에 섞음
	if crouch > 0.02 then
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local v = root and Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude or 0
		sm.T = sm.T + dt * (v > 1 and 7 or 0)
		local step = (v > 1) and math.sin(sm.T) * 14 or 0
		for _, side in ipairs({ { j.LH, j.LK, j.LA, 1 }, { j.RH, j.RK, j.RA, -1 } }) do
			local hip, knee, ankle, sgn = side[1], side[2], side[3], side[4]
			if hip and knee then
				local h = (70 + step * sgn) * crouch
				hip.Transform = hip.Transform:Lerp(CFrame.Angles(rad(h), 0, 0), crouch)
				knee.Transform = knee.Transform:Lerp(CFrame.Angles(rad(-105 * crouch), 0, 0), crouch)
				if ankle then
					ankle.Transform = ankle.Transform:Lerp(CFrame.Angles(rad(35 * crouch), 0, 0), crouch)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Pose.Init()
	local signal = RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Stepped
	signal:Connect(function(a, b)
		local dt = (type(b) == "number") and b or a -- Stepped(time, dt) / PreSimulation(dt)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local myPitch = 0
		if cam then
			myPitch = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(cam.CFrame.LookVector.Y, -1, 1)))
		end
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local c = pl.Character
			if c and pl:GetAttribute("InMatch") and armed(c) then
				if pl == player then
					pose(c, math.clamp(myPitch, -70, 70), localStance, dt)
				else
					pose(c, pl:GetAttribute("AimPitch") or 0, pl:GetAttribute("Stance") or "Normal", dt)
				end
			end
		end
		local bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bots")
		if bots then
			for _, m in ipairs(bots:GetChildren()) do
				if armed(m) then
					pose(m, m:GetAttribute("AimPitch") or 0, "Normal", dt)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Pose

-- SPLASH FRONT 클라이언트 진입점
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local HUD = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("HUD"))
local Effects = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Effects"))
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WeaponController"))
local LobbyUI = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("LobbyUI"))
local CBTPanel = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CBTPanel"))
local MapInteract = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MapInteract"))
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local MusicPlayer = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MusicPlayer"))
local CharacterPose = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CharacterPose"))
local PaintVisual = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PaintVisual"))
local ItemClient = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ItemClient"))
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- 채팅창은 왼쪽 아래, 기본 가방(1~0 단축키)은 끔 → 숫자키는 무기 교체용
task.spawn(function()
	local cfg = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration") or TextChatService:WaitForChild("ChatWindowConfiguration", 10)
	if cfg then
		cfg.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
		cfg.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	end
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		if pcall(function()
			StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)
		end) then
			break
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

HUD.Build()
-- 전체 UI 글꼴을 SF 이탤릭으로 (이후 만들어지는 창·킬피드·결과 화면 포함)
require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("UIKit")).AutoStyle(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
LobbyUI.Init(remotes, HUD)
WeaponController.Init(remotes, HUD, Effects)
CBTPanel.Init(remotes, HUD)
MapInteract.Init(Effects)
-- 창(상점·랭킹·크레이트·피드백·관리자)이 하나라도 열려 있으면 마우스 커서를 풀어 줌
local openWindows = {}
local function modal(source, on)
	openWindows[source] = on and true or nil
	WeaponController.SetUIMode(next(openWindows) ~= nil)
end
CBTPanel.SetModalHandler(function(on)
	modal("cbt", on)
end)
LobbyUI.SetModalHandler(function(on)
	modal("lobby", on)
end)
HUD.SetLeaveHandler(function(on)
	modal("leave", on)
end, function()
	remotes.Queue:FireServer("leaveMatch")
end)
CharacterPose.Init()
PaintVisual.Init()
ItemClient.Init(remotes, HUD)
HUD.UpdateQuests()
LobbyUI.UpdateQuests()

-- 저장 데이터 경고 (불러오기 실패 시)
local function dataWarn()
	local w = player:GetAttribute("DataWarning")
	if w then
		HUD.Banner(w, Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 120))
	end
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("DataWarning"):Connect(dataWarn)
task.delay(3, dataWarn)

-- 레벨 업 축하
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LevelUp"):Connect(function()
	local v = player:GetAttribute("LevelUp") or ""
	local lv, coins = string.match(v, "^(%d+):(%d+)")
	if lv then
		HUD.Banner(string.format("레벨 %s 달성!  +%s 코인", lv, coins), Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80))
		SoundBank.Play("crate_epic", nil, 0.6)
	end
end)
MusicPlayer.Init()

-- 스페셜 충전 완료 / 부활
local lastSpecial = 0
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Special"):Connect(function()
	local v = player:GetAttribute("Special") or 0
	if v >= 1 and lastSpecial < 1 then
		SoundBank.Play("special_ready", nil, 0.6)
	end
	lastSpecial = v
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
		SoundBank.Play("respawn", nil, 0.5)
	end
end)

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InMatch"):Connect(function()
	if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") and player:GetAttribute("FirstMatch") then
		HUD.ShowTips()
	end
end)

remotes.State.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(s)
	HUD.OnState(s)
	LobbyUI.OnState(s)
	MusicPlayer.OnState(s)
end)

remotes.Results.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(r)
	-- 이번 판에 참가한 사람만 결과창을 봄 (중간에 나간 사람·로비 사람은 제외)
	local joined = false
	for _, row in ipairs(r.Rows) do
		if row.Player == player then
			joined = true
		end
	end
	if not joined then
		return
	end
	HUD.ShowResults(r)
	CBTPanel.OnResults()
	for _, row in ipairs(r.Rows) do
		if row.Player == player then
			MusicPlayer.PlayResult(row.Won)
		end
	end
end)

remotes.Notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg, color)
	HUD.Banner(msg, color)
end)

remotes.FX.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
	Effects.OnFX(kind, data)
	if kind == "Kill" then
		HUD.KillFeed(data)
		if data.VictimPlayer == player then
			SoundBank.Play("splashed", nil, 0.8)
		end
	elseif kind == "Elim" then
		HUD.Elim(data)
	elseif kind == "Cue" then
		-- 서버가 알려주는 상황: 미션·깃발은 우리 팀이면 성공음, 아니면 실패음
		local mine = player:GetAttribute("OwnerId")
		local name = data.Name
		if name == "mission_result" then
			name = (data.Owner == mine) and "mission_success" or "mission_fail"
		elseif name == "flag" then
			name = (data.Owner == mine) and "flag_captured" or "flag_lost"
		end
		SoundBank.Play(name, data.Pos, data.Volume or 0.7)
	end
end)

remotes.HitConfirm.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(d)
	HUD.Hitmarker(d.Head, d.Kill)
	if d.Pos then
		Effects.DamageNumber(d.Pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), d.Damage, d.Head, d.Kill)
	end
	SoundBank.Play(d.Head and "hit_head" or "hit", nil, d.Head and 0.8 or 0.6)
	if d.Kill then
		SoundBank.Play("kill", nil, 0.8)
	end
end)

remotes.Damaged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(fromPos, amount, color)
	HUD.DamageFlash(color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)) -- 기획서 4장: 화면 가장자리 적 색 비네트
	HUD.ScreenSplat(color, amount)
	Effects.Shake(math.clamp(amount / 80, 0.05, 0.35))
	SoundBank.Play("hurt", nil, 0.5)
end)

remotes.CrateResult.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(res)
	LobbyUI.ShowCrate(res)
end)

print("[SplashFront] 클라이언트 준비 — B: 상점, F4: 피드백, F2: 관리자, 경기 중 좌클릭 발사 / 우클릭 조준 / Q 스페셜 / C 앉기 / V 1·3인칭 / 스폰에서 1~6·T 무기 교체")

Client.Name: Effects
Client.Source:
-- 시각/청각 효과: 트레이서, 착탄 스플래시, 크로마 봄, 처치 이펙트, 데미지 숫자
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local CharacterPose = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CharacterPose"))
local PaintVisual = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PaintVisual"))


local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Effects = {}
function Effects.WallSplat(inst, pos, normal, color)
	PaintVisual.WallSplat(inst, pos, normal, color)
end

local function folder()
	local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientFX")
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "ClientFX"
		f.Parent = workspace
	end
	return f
end

local function fxPart(props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		p[k] = v
	end
	p.Parent = folder()
	return p
end

function Effects.Sound(id, position, volume, pitch)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = id
	s.Volume = volume or 0.5
	s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
	if position then
		local a = fxPart({ Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), Transparency = 1, Position = position })
		s.Parent = a
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(a, 2)
	else
		s.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(s, 2)
	end
end

function Effects.Tracer(from, to, color, width)
	local dist = (to - from).Magnitude
	if dist < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local p = fxPart({
		Size = Vector3.new(width or 0.18, width or 0.18, dist), Color = color,
		CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist / 2), Transparency = 0.1,
	})
	TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, dist) }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(p, 0.2)
	Effects.Splash(to, color, 1)
end

-- 파티클 한 번 터뜨리기 (잉크 방울은 포물선으로 떨어지고, 연기는 퍼지며 사라짐)
local function burst(pos, color, count, speed, size, life, gravity, lightEmission, transparency)
	local holder = fxPart({ Size = Vector3.one * 0.1, Position = pos, Transparency = 1 })
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Parent = holder
	local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	pe.LightEmission = lightEmission or 0.15
	pe.LightInfluence = 0.6
	pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, size * 0.3) })
	pe.Transparency = transparency or NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life * 0.6, life)
	pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed)
	pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -(gravity or 0), 0)
	pe.Drag = 2
	pe.Rate = 0
	pe.Parent = att
	pe:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(holder, life + 0.1)
end
Effects.Burst = burst

function Effects.Splash(pos, color, scale)
	scale = scale or 1
	-- 잉크 방울 + 옅은 물보라
	burst(pos, color, math.floor(10 * scale), 16 * scale, 0.32 * scale, 0.55, 45)
	burst(pos, color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35), math.floor(4 * scale), 4, 1.4 * scale, 0.35, 0, 0.1,
		NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }))
	local blob = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 0.6 * scale, Color = color, Position = pos })
	TweenService:Create(blob, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Size = Vector3.one * 2.4 * scale, Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(blob, 0.3)
	for _ = 1, math.floor(3 * scale) do
		local drop = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 0.35, Color = color, Position = pos })
		local off = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.8, math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * scale
		TweenService:Create(drop, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { Position = pos + off, Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(drop, 0.35)
	end
end

function Effects.Muzzle(cf, color)
	local p = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 0.5, Color = color, CFrame = cf })
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = color
	light.Range = 8
	light.Brightness = 4
	light.Parent = p
	TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Size = Vector3.one * 1.1, Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(p, 0.08)
	-- 십자 섬광 + 옅은 총구 연기
	for _, rot in ipairs({ 0, 90 }) do
		local f = fxPart({ Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 1.2, 0.08), Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200), Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			CFrame = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(rot + math.random(-20, 20))) })
		TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.05), { Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 1.8, 0.02) }):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(f, 0.07)
	end
	if math.random() < 0.5 then
		burst(cf.Position, Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 195), 2, 2, 0.6, 0.6, -2, 0,
			NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }))
	end
end

function Effects.Bomb(from, to, color, radius)
	local ball = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 1.6, Color = color, Position = from })
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local dur = 0.7
	local conn
	conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local a = math.min(1, (os.clock() - t0) / dur)
		local p = from:Lerp(to, a) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(a * math.pi) * 10, 0)
		ball.Position = p
		if a >= 1 then
			conn:Disconnect()
			ball:Destroy()
			local ring = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 2, 2), Color = color,
				CFrame = CFrame.new(to + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) })
			TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = Vector3.new(0.3, radius * 2, radius * 2), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.4)
			Effects.Splash(to + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), color, 4)
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if cam and (cam.CFrame.Position - to).Magnitude < radius * 2.5 then
				Effects.Shake(0.5)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- 처치 이펙트 (크로마 크레이트 아이템)
function Effects.KillEffect(kind, pos, color)
	if not pos then
		return
	end
	if kind == "Confetti" then
		for _ = 1, 24 do
			local c = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 0.8, 1)
			local p = fxPart({ Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.05, 0.25), Color = c, Position = pos })
			local off = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 1.2, math.random() - 0.5) * 10
			TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Position = pos + off,
				Orientation = Vector3.new(math.random(0, 360), math.random(0, 360), 0), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(p, 1)
		end
	elseif kind == "Smoke" then
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local p = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 2, Color = color, Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
				Transparency = 0.3, Position = pos + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, i * 0.4, math.random() - 0.5) * 2 })
			TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(1.4), { Size = Vector3.one * 7, Transparency = 1, Position = p.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) }):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(p, 1.5)
		end
	elseif kind == "Starburst" then
		for i = 1, 12 do
			local a = i / 12 * math.pi * 2
			local p = fxPart({ Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 3), Color = color, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0.4, math.sin(a))) })
			TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -6), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(p, 0.55)
		end
		Effects.Splash(pos, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 2)
	elseif kind == "Rainbow" then
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local c = Color3.fromHSV(i / 7, 0.9, 1)
			local ring = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 1), Color = c,
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, i * 0.6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) })
			TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.6 + i * 0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),
				{ Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 10 + i * 2, 10 + i * 2), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(ring, 1)
		end
	else
		Effects.Splash(pos, color, 3)
	end
end

function Effects.DamageNumber(pos, amount, head, killed)
	local a = fxPart({ Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), Transparency = 1, Position = pos })
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 40)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bb.Adornee = a
	bb.Parent = a
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.Text = tostring(amount)
	t.TextColor3 = killed and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) or (head and Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 40) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	t.Parent = bb
	TweenService:Create(a, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { Position = pos + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 2.5, 0) }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(t, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(a, 0.7)
end

-- 카메라 흔들림 (WeaponController가 매 프레임 Effects.ShakeOffset()을 적용)
local shake = 0
function Effects.Shake(amount)
	shake = math.max(shake, amount)
end
function Effects.ShakeOffset(dt)
	if shake <= 0.001 then
		shake = 0
		return CFrame.new()
	end
	local s = shake
	shake = shake * math.exp(-12 * dt)
	return CFrame.Angles(math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * s * 1.6), math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * s * 1.6), 0)
end

-- 투척물 (스페셜 크로마 봄 · 연막탄): 서버와 같은 초기값으로 포물선을 그리다 ProjEnd에서 터짐
local projs = {}
local ModelKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ModelKit)
local function startProj(d)
	local visual
	if d.Kind == "Smoke" then
		visual = ModelKit.Item("Smoke")
		for _, p in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Anchored = true
			end
		end
		visual.Parent = folder()
	else
		visual = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 1.7, Color = d.Color, Position = d.From })
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		a0.Parent = visual
		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0)
		a1.Parent = visual
		local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
		trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = a0, a1
		trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(d.Color)
		trail.LightEmission = 0.8
		trail.Lifetime = 0.25
		trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
		trail.Parent = visual
		local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
		l.Color = d.Color
		l.Range = 10
		l.Brightness = 3
		l.Parent = visual
	end
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local rec = { Visual = visual }
	projs[d.Id] = rec
	rec.Conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock() - t0
		if t > (Config.Throw.MaxTime + 0.5) then
			rec.Conn:Disconnect()
			visual:Destroy()
			projs[d.Id] = nil
			return
		end
		local pos = d.From + d.Vel * t + d.G * (0.5 * t * t)
		local cf = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(t * 9, t * 5, 0)
		if visual:IsA("Model") then
			visual:PivotTo(cf)
		else
			visual.CFrame = cf
		end
	end)
	SoundBank.Play("special_throw", d.From, 0.7)
end

local function endProj(d)
	local rec = projs[d.Id]
	if rec then
		rec.Conn:Disconnect()
		rec.Visual:Destroy()
		projs[d.Id] = nil
	end
	local pos = d.Pos
	if d.Kind == "Smoke" then
		SoundBank.Play("land", pos, 0.8)
		Effects.Splash(pos, Color3.fromRGB(230, 232, 240), 3)
		return
	end
	local radius = d.Radius or Config.SpecialRadius
	local ring = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 2, 2), Color = d.Color,
		CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) })
	TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = Vector3.new(0.3, radius * 2, radius * 2), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.4)
	local ball = fxPart({ Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 2, Color = d.Color, Position = pos })
	TweenService:Create(ball, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = Vector3.one * radius * 1.4, Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(ball, 0.35)
	Effects.Splash(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), d.Color, 4)
	SoundBank.Play("special_boom", pos, 1)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam and (cam.CFrame.Position - pos).Magnitude < radius * 2.5 then
		Effects.Shake(0.4)
	end
end

-- 서버 FX 이벤트 처리
function Effects.OnFX(kind, d)
	if kind == "Tracer" then
		if d.Shooter == player then
			return -- 내 사격은 즉시 로컬로 그렸음
		end
		local from = d.From
		if d.Model then
			-- 손에 든 총의 총구에서 나가도록 + 발사 반동 자세
			CharacterPose.Kick(d.Model, 1.5)
			local gun = d.Model:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun")
			local muzzle = nil
			if gun then
				for _, p in ipairs(gun:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("Kind") == "Muzzle" then
						muzzle = p
					end
				end
			end
			local hand = muzzle or d.Model:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			if hand then
				from = hand.Position
			end
		end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { d.Model, folder(), workspace:FindFirstChild("PaintLayer") }
		for _, to in ipairs(d.To) do
			Effects.Tracer(from, to, d.Color, (d.Golden and 0.6) or (d.Weapon == "Sniper" and 0.35) or 0.18)
			-- 다른 사람 총알도 벽에 맞은 자리에 페인트 자국
			local dir = to - d.From
			if dir.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(d.From, dir + dir.Unit * 0.6, params)
				if hit then
					PaintVisual.WallSplat(hit.Instance, hit.Position, hit.Normal, d.Color)
				end
			end
		end
		SoundBank.Play("fire_" .. string.lower(d.Weapon or "pistol"), d.From, 0.55)
	elseif kind == "Proj" then
		startProj(d)
	elseif kind == "ProjEnd" then
		endProj(d)
	elseif kind == "Bomb" then
		Effects.Bomb(d.From, d.To, d.Color, d.Radius)
		SoundBank.Play("special_throw", d.From, 0.7)
		task.delay(0.7, function()
			SoundBank.Play("special_boom", d.To, 1)
		end)
	elseif kind == "Kill" then
		if d.Pos then
			Effects.KillEffect(d.Effect, d.Pos, d.KillerColor or d.VictimColor)
		end
	end
end

return Effects

local function fmtTime(sec)
	sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(sec / 60), sec % 60)
end

function HUD.OnState(s)
	state = s
	local inMatch = player:GetAttribute("InMatch") == true
	gui.Enabled = inMatch
	if not inMatch then
		return
	end
	modeLbl.Text = (s.ModeName or "") .. " · " .. (s.MapName or "")
	HUD.RenderBoard(s.Board or {})
	-- 점수바
	for _, c in ipairs(barHolder:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local total = 0
	for _, t in ipairs(s.Teams) do
		total = total + math.max(0, t.Score)
	end
	for i, t in ipairs(s.Teams) do
		local share = (total > 0) and (t.Score / total) or (1 / math.max(1, #s.Teams))
		local f = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(share, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = t.Color, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i }, barHolder)
		if share > 0.12 then
			local label = (s.Mode == "Flag") and string.format("%s %.0f", t.Name, t.Score)
				or string.format("%.0f점 · 페인트 %.0f%%", t.Score, t.Coverage or 0)
			text(f, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Text = label, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold })
		end
	end
	-- 깃발
	if s.Mode == "Flag" and s.Flags then
		local parts = {}
		for _, f in ipairs(s.Flags) do
			local who = "중립"
			for _, t in ipairs(s.Teams) do

				end
			end
			local p = (f.Progress > 0) and string.format(" (%d%%)", math.floor(f.Progress * 100)) or ""
			table.insert(parts, f.Name .. ": " .. who .. p)
		end
		flagLbl.Text = table.concat(parts, "   ")
	else
		flagLbl.Text = ""
	end

	if s.Mission then
		missionFrame.Visible = true
		missionLbl.Text = string.format("<b>미션! %s  (+%s)</b>\n%s", s.Mission.Name, tostring(s.Mission.Bonus), s.Mission.Desc)
	else
		missionFrame.Visible = false
	end
	timerLbl.TextColor3 = s.FinalSplash and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

-- 매 프레임 갱신 (WeaponController에서 호출)
function HUD.Update(spreadPx, weaponId, sight, zoomText)
	local scoped = sight == "Scope"
	if not gui.Enabled then
		return
	end
	if state then
		timerLbl.Text = fmtTime(state.EndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		if state.Mission then
			missionTimer.Text = tostring(math.max(0, math.ceil(state.Mission.EndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())))
		end
	end
	local gap = 6 + spreadPx
	local len = 9
	cross[1].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, len)
	cross[1].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -gap - len / 2)
	cross[2].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, len)
	cross[2].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, gap + len / 2)
	cross[3].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2)
	cross[3].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -gap - len / 2, 0.5, 0)
	cross[4].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2)
	cross[4].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, gap + len / 2, 0.5, 0)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		cross[i].Visible = sight == nil
	end
	scope.Visible = scoped
	scopeZoomLbl.Text = zoomText or ""
	sightDot.Visible = sight == "Dot" or sight == "Holo"
	sightHolo.Visible = sight == "Holo"
	-- 효과 남은 시간
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local parts = {}
	local ju, su, zu = player:GetAttribute("JetpackUntil"), player:GetAttribute("ShieldUntil"), player:GetAttribute("ZoomUntil")
	if ju and ju > now then
		table.insert(parts, string.format('<font color="#FFB050"> 제트팩 %d초 (Space)</font>', math.ceil(ju - now)))
	end
	if su and su > now then
		table.insert(parts, string.format('<font color="#70C8FF"> 무적 %d초</font>', math.ceil(su - now)))
	end
	if zu and zu > now then
		table.insert(parts, string.format('<font color="#90FF90"> %d배 줌 %d초</font>', player:GetAttribute("ZoomBuff") or 1, math.ceil(zu - now)))
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("Golden") then
		table.insert(parts, '<font color="#FFD040"> 황금총 장전 — 다음 1발 즉사</font>')
	end
	buffLbl.Text = table.concat(parts, "   ")

	local color = player:GetAttribute("TeamColor") or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local ink = math.clamp((player:GetAttribute("Ink") or 100) / Config.InkMax, 0, 1)
	local low = ink < 0.15
	for i, pip in ipairs(inkPips) do
		local on = ink >= (i - 0.5) / 10
		pip.BackgroundColor3 = on and (low and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) or color) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 58, 80)
		pip.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.4
	end
	inkNum.Text = string.format('%d<font size="20">%%</font>', math.floor(ink * 100))
	inkNum.TextColor3 = low and Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local sp = player:GetAttribute("Special") or 0
	specialFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(sp, 0, 1), 1)
	specialLbl.Text = sp >= 1 and "준비 완료!" or string.format("크로마 봄 %d%%", math.floor(sp * 100))
	specialLbl.TextColor3 = sp >= 1 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 80) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local w = Weapons.Get(weaponId)
	weaponLbl.Text = player:GetAttribute("Golden") and "황금총" or w.Class
	-- 경험치
	local lv, xp, need = player:GetAttribute("Level") or 1, player:GetAttribute("XP") or 0, player:GetAttribute("XPNeed") or 100
	levelLbl.Text = "레벨 " .. lv
	xpLbl.Text = string.format("%d / %d XP", xp, need)
	xpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(xp / math.max(1, need), 0.04, 1), 1)

	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		local hp = hum.Health / math.max(1, hum.MaxHealth)
		healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(hp, 0, 1), 1)
		healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = hp < 0.35 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 140)
		healthLbl.Text = tostring(math.ceil(hum.Health))
	end
end

-- 맞으면 화면 가장자리에 공격자 색 잉크가 튀었다 흘러내리며 사라짐 (레퍼런스 3번)
local splatCount = 0
function HUD.ScreenSplat(color, amount)
	local imgs = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Images")
	local url = imgs and imgs:GetAttribute("icon_splat")
	if not url or not gui or splatCount > 8 then
		return
	end
	local n = math.clamp(math.floor((amount or 20) / 25) + 1, 1, 3)
	for _ = 1, n do
		splatCount = splatCount + 1
		local size = math.random(140, 260)
		-- 가운데(조준점)는 피해서 가장자리 쪽에
		local x = (math.random() < 0.5) and math.random(2, 28) / 100 or math.random(72, 98) / 100
		local y = math.random(8, 85) / 100
		local img = make("ImageLabel", { Image = url, ImageColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size * 0.6, size * 0.6),
			Rotation = math.random(-40, 40), ImageTransparency = 0.12, ZIndex = 0 }, gui)
		TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size) }):Play()
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			local t = TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
				{ ImageTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y + 0.06) })
			t:Play()
			t.Completed:Connect(function()
				img:Destroy()
				splatCount = splatCount - 1
			end)
		end)
	end
end

function HUD.KillFeed(d)
	local row = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = -math.floor(os.clock() * 100) }, feed)
	make("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),

		end
		local kc = chip(row, d.Killer, d.KillerColor or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 140, 2)
		make("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Transparency = (d.KillerPlayer == player) and 0 or 1 }, kc)
		local gun = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 30), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250), LayoutOrder = 3 }, row)
		corner(gun, 8)

			UI.Icon(gun, "target", "", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 0), ZIndex = 3 })
		end

	local vc = chip(row, d.Victim, Color3.fromRGB(40, 38, 58), d.VictimColor, 140, 4)

	for _, c in ipairs(feed:GetChildren()) do

	task.delay(7, function()

		myStreak = 0
		streakFrame.Visible = false
		HUD.DeathCard(d)
	end
end

	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		text(elimFrame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 44), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, side * 150 - 35, 0, y + 8), Text = "///", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 120), TextStrokeTransparency = 1 })
	end
	text(elimFrame, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y + 60), Text = "" .. tostring(d.Victim), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
		TextColor3 = d.VictimColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 160), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6 })

-- 왼쪽 위 퀘스트 카드 (미완료 우선 3개)
function HUD.UpdateQuests()
	if not questBox then
		return
	end
	local ok, list = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(player:GetAttribute("Quests") or "[]")
	end)
	if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if a.Done ~= b.Done then
			return not a.Done
		end
		if a.Period ~= b.Period then
			return a.Period == "Daily"
		end
		return (a.P / math.max(1, a.Goal)) > (b.P / math.max(1, b.Goal))
	end)
	for _, c in ipairs(questBox:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for i = 1, math.min(3, #list) do
		local q = list[i]
		local cardF = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 58), BackgroundColor3 = DARKP, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, LayoutOrder = i }, questBox)
		corner(cardF, 10)
		UI.Icon(cardF, q.Done and "check" or "quest", q.Done and "" or "", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 9) })
		text(cardF, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 8), Text = string.format("[%s] %s", q.Period == "Daily" and "일일" or "주간", q.Name),
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 15, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 })
		text(cardF, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 18), Position = UDim2.new(1, -184, 0, 9), Text = string.format("%d / %d", q.P, q.Goal), TextScaled = false,
			TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 })
		local bar = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 7), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 36), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 58, 82) }, cardF)
		corner(bar, 4)
		local fill = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(q.P / math.max(1, q.Goal), 0, 1), 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = q.Done and Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, bar)
		corner(fill, 4)
		UI.Icon(cardF, "coin", "", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, -12) })
		text(cardF, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -13), Text = "+" .. q.Reward, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left })
	end
end
