-- 결과창: 팀 vs 상대 (각 팀 안에서 점수 → 처치 → 데스 적은 순). 솔로는 한 표
local RCOLS = { { "#", 34 }, { "플레이어", 160 }, { "처치", 52 }, { "데스", 52 }, { "점수", 70 }, { "코인", 56 }, { "레이팅", 58 } }
local function resultRow(parent, y, values, color, bold, width)
	local x = 0
	local scale = width / 482
	for i, c in ipairs(RCOLS) do
		local w = c[2] * scale
		local t = text(parent, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w - 4, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 2, y), Text = values[i], TextScaled = false, TextSize = 16,
			Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7, ZIndex = 12,
			TextXAlignment = (i == 2) and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })
		x = x + w
	end
end

local function sortRows(list)
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if (a.Score or 0) ~= (b.Score or 0) then
			return (a.Score or 0) > (b.Score or 0)
		end
		if a.Kills ~= b.Kills then
			return a.Kills > b.Kills
		end
		return a.Deaths < b.Deaths
	end)
	return list
end

local function teamTable(parent, x, width, title, color, scoreText, rows)
	local box = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, -150), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 112), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 26, 42),
		ZIndex = 11 }, parent)
	corner(box, 12)
	make("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = 2 }, box)
	local head = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = color, ZIndex = 11 }, box)
	corner(head, 12)
	text(head, { Size = UDim2.new(0.68, -12, 1, -8), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 4), Text = title, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 14, 24), TextStrokeTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 12 })
	text(head, { Size = UDim2.new(0.32, -12, 1, -8), Position = UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0, 4), Text = scoreText, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 14, 24), TextStrokeTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 12 })
	resultRow(box, 48, { "#", "플레이어", "처치", "데스", "점수", "코인", "레이팅" }, Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 195), false, width)
	make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 75), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 78, 110), BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 12 }, box)
	for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
		if i > 10 then
			break
		end
		local y = 52 + i * 30
		if row.Player == player then
			local hl = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, y - 2), BackgroundColor3 = color, BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
				ZIndex = 11 }, box)
			corner(hl, 6)
		end
		local rating = row.RatingDelta and string.format("%+d", row.RatingDelta) or "-"
		local name = (i == 1 and "MVP " or "") .. row.Name .. (row.IsBot and " (봇)" or "")
		resultRow(box, y, { tostring(i), name, tostring(row.Kills), tostring(row.Deaths), tostring(row.Score or row.Cells), tostring(row.Coins), rating },
			(row.Player == player) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 240), row.Player == player, width)
	end
end

function HUD.ShowResults(r)
	for _, c in ipairs(results:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	results.Visible = true
	gui.Enabled = true
	local head = r.WinnerName and (r.WinnerName .. " 승리!") or "무승부!"
	local mine = player:GetAttribute("OwnerId")
	local won = false
	for _, row in ipairs(r.Rows) do
		if row.Player == player then
			won = row.Won
		end
	end
	text(results, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 50), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 14), Text = head,
		TextColor3 = r.WinnerColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = 11 })
	text(results, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 66), Text = won and "VICTORY" or "다음 판엔 이길 수 있어요!",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = won and Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220), ZIndex = 11 })
	local unit = (r.Mode == "Flag") and "점" or "%"
	if r.Mode == "Solo" then
		local t = r.Teams[1]
		teamTable(results, 20, 960, "솔로 순위", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60), t and string.format("1위 %.1f%s", t.Score, unit) or "", sortRows(r.Rows))
	else
		-- 왼쪽 = 우리 팀, 오른쪽 = 상대 팀
		local teams = {}
		for _, t in ipairs(r.Teams) do
			table.insert(teams, t)
		end
		table.sort(teams, function(a, b)
			return (a.OwnerId == mine) and b.OwnerId ~= mine
		end)
		for i, t in ipairs(teams) do
			if i > 2 then
				break
			end
			local rows = {}
			for _, row in ipairs(r.Rows) do
				if row.OwnerId == t.OwnerId then
					table.insert(rows, row)
				end
			end
			local title = (i == 1 and mine == t.OwnerId) and ("우리 팀 · " .. t.Name) or ((mine and i == 2) and ("상대 팀 · " .. t.Name) or t.Name)
			local st = (r.Mode == "Flag") and string.format("%.0f점", t.Score)
				or string.format("%.1f점 (페인트 %.1f%% · 처치 %d)", t.Score, t.Coverage or 0, t.Kills or 0)
			teamTable(results, 20 + (i - 1) * 490, 470, title, t.Color, st, sortRows(rows))
		end
		text(results, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 112), Text = "VS", ZIndex = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) })
	end
	text(results, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -32), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, ZIndex = 11, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 15,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180), Text = (r.Ranked and "랭크전 · " or "일반전 · 레이팅 변동 없음 · ") .. (r.Mode == "Flag" and "깃발 점수로 승패" or "승패 = 페인트 면적 80% + 처치·미션 20%") .. " · 개인 점수 = 칠한 셀 + 처치×30" })
	task.delay(Config.ResultsTime, function()
		results.Visible = false
	end)
end

Client.Name: ItemClient
Client.Source:
-- 미션 보상 아이템 (클라이언트): F 사용 · G 순서 바꾸기 · 제트팩 추진(Space) · 연막탄 조준점
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local ItemClient = {}

local remotes, HUD
local lastJetSound = 0

local function aimPoint()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientFX"), workspace:FindFirstChild("PaintLayer") }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 75, params)
	return hit and hit.Position or (cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * 75)
end

local function items()
	local s = player:GetAttribute("Items") or ""
	local out = {}
	for x in string.gmatch(s, "[^,]+") do
		table.insert(out, x)
	end
	return out
end

local function useItem()
	if not player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
		return
	end
	local list = items()
	if #list == 0 then
		HUD.Banner("아이템이 없어요 — 미션을 성공하면 받아요", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220))
		return
	end
	remotes.UseItem:FireServer("use", aimPoint())
	SoundBank.Play("ui_buy", nil, 0.5)
end

local function onAction(name, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if name == "SF_UseItem" then
		useItem()
	elseif name == "SF_CycleItem" then
		remotes.UseItem:FireServer("cycle")
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

function ItemClient.Init(remoteFolder, hud)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	HUD = hud
	local function bind()
		if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
			ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_UseItem", onAction, true, Enum.KeyCode.F, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX)
			ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_CycleItem", onAction, false, Enum.KeyCode.G, Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight)
			ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_UseItem", "아이템")
			ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_UseItem", UDim2.new(1, -170, 1, -300))
		else
			ContextActionService:UnbindAction("SF_UseItem")
			ContextActionService:UnbindAction("SF_CycleItem")
		end
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InMatch"):Connect(bind)
	bind()

	-- 새 아이템 획득 연출
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastItem"):Connect(function()
		local v = player:GetAttribute("LastItem")
		local id = v and string.match(v, "^(%w+):")
		if id then
			HUD.ItemToast(id)
		end
	end)
	for _, a in ipairs({ "Items", "JetpackUntil", "ShieldUntil", "ZoomBuff", "Golden" }) do
		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(a):Connect(function()
			HUD.UpdateItems()
		end)
	end

	-- 제트팩: 효과 시간 동안 Space(모바일은 점프 버튼)를 누르고 있으면 상승
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local untilT = player:GetAttribute("JetpackUntil")
		if not untilT or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() > untilT then
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local thrusting = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or UserInputService:IsGamepadButtonDown(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)
			or (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and hum.Jump)
		if thrusting then
			local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local up = math.min(v.Y + (workspace.Gravity + Config.JetpackThrust) * dt, Config.JetpackMaxRise)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, up, v.Z)
			if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
			end
			if os.clock() - lastJetSound > 0.35 then
				lastJetSound = os.clock()
				SoundBank.Play("zipline_ride", root.Position, 0.35, 1.6)
			end
		end
	end)
	HUD.UpdateItems()
end

return ItemClient

local priceCache = {}
local function robuxPrice(id, infoType)
	local key = tostring(infoType) .. id
	if priceCache[key] then
		return priceCache[key]
	end
	local ok, info = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(id, infoType)
	end)
	local p = ok and info and info.PriceInRobux or nil
	priceCache[key] = p
	return p
end

local function buildRobux(page)
	clear(page)
	label(page, { Text = "로벅스로 VIP와 코인을 충전할 수 있어요 · 코인은 스킨 상점·무기 구매에 사용", TextSize = 18, TextColor3 = C.Sub,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28), LayoutOrder = 0 })

	local items = {

	}
	local packs = {}
	for id, coins in pairs(M.CoinProducts or {}) do
		table.insert(packs, { Id = id, Coins = coins })
	end
	table.sort(packs, function(a, b)
		return a.Coins < b.Coins
	end)
	for _, pk in ipairs(packs) do
		table.insert(items, { Kind = "Product", Id = pk.Id, Title = string.format("코인 %d", pk.Coins), Sub = (pk.Coins >= 3000 and "50% 보너스")
			or (pk.Coins >= 1200 and "20% 보너스") or "기본 팩", Icon = "coin", Color = C.Cyan })
	end
	for i, it in ipairs(items) do
		if it.Id and it.Id ~= 0 then
			local owned = it.Kind == "Pass" and player:GetAttribute("Vip")
			local cardF = make("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Panel, LayoutOrder = i }, grid)

			UI.Icon(pic, it.Icon, "", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 88), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -44, 0.5, -44) })
			label(cardF, { Text = it.Title, TextSize = 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 124), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center })
			label(cardF, { Text = it.Sub, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 154), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center })
			local b = button(cardF, owned and "보유 중" or "...", owned and C.Dim or Color3.fromRGB(0, 176, 111),
				{ Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 46), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -54), TextSize = 20 })
			if not owned then
				task.spawn(function()
					local price = robuxPrice(it.Id, it.Kind == "Pass" and Enum.InfoType.GamePass or Enum.InfoType.Product)
					if b.Parent then
						b.Text = price and (price .. " R$") or "구매"
					end
				end)
			end
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if owned then
					return
				end
				if it.Kind == "Pass" then
					MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, it.Id)
				else
					MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, it.Id)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

	currentTab = name

local function toggleShop(force)
	local on = force
	if on == nil then
		on = not shop.Visible
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then

	end
	shop.Visible = on

		board.Visible = false
		questPanel.Visible = false

		showTab(currentTab)
	end
	updateModal()
end

local function fmtLeft(sec)
	sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec or 0))
	local d = math.floor(sec / 86400)
	local h = math.floor((sec % 86400) / 3600)
	local m = math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60)
	if d > 0 then
		return string.format("%d일 %d시간", d, h)
	end
	return string.format("%d시간 %d분", h, m)
end

function Lobby.UpdateQuests()
	if not questList then
		return
	end
	local ok, list = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(player:GetAttribute("Quests") or "[]")
	end)
	if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	clear(questList)
	local order = 0
	for _, period in ipairs({ "Daily", "Weekly" }) do
		local left = nil
		for _, q in ipairs(list) do
			if q.Period == period then
				left = q.Left
			end
		end
		order = order + 1
		label(questList, { Text = string.format("%s  ·  초기화까지 %s", period == "Daily" and "일일 미션" or "주간 미션", fmtLeft(left)), TextSize = 21,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 32), LayoutOrder = order })
		for _, q in ipairs(list) do
			if q.Period == period then
				order = order + 1
				local row = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 70), BackgroundColor3 = q.Done and Color3.fromRGB(34, 60, 50) or C.Panel, LayoutOrder = order }, questList)
				corner(row, 12)
				UI.stroke(row, q.Done and Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170) or C.Dim, 2, 0.3)
				UI.Icon(row, q.Done and "check" or "quest", "", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 15) })
				label(row, { Text = q.Name, TextSize = 20, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 24) })
				local bar = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 10), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 44), BackgroundColor3 = C.Dim }, row)
				corner(bar, 5)
				local fill = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(q.P / math.max(1, q.Goal), 0, 1), 1), BorderSizePixel = 0,
					BackgroundColor3 = q.Done and Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170) or C.Cyan }, bar)
				corner(fill, 5)
				label(row, { Text = string.format("%d / %d", q.P, q.Goal), TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Position = UDim2.new(1, -164, 0, 10),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 22), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right })
				label(row, { Text = (q.Done and "받음 " or "") .. "+" .. q.Reward .. " 코인", TextSize = 19, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextColor3 = C.Gold,
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 34), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(136, 26), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right })
			end
		end
	end
end

local function queueTitle(q)
	local mode = Config.Modes[q.Mode]
	return (q.Mode == "Solo") and "솔로 페인트 로얄 8인" or string.format("%s %dvs%d", mode.Name, q.TeamSize, q.TeamSize)
end

local function rebuildMatch()
	local s = lastState
	local mine = player:GetAttribute("Queue")
	local counts = (s and s.QueueCounts) or {}
	local info = (s and s.QueueInfo) or {}
	local mySide = player:GetAttribute("QueueSide")
	local sig = tostring(mine) .. tostring(mySide) .. "|" .. (s and s.Phase or "")
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		local qi = info[q.Id] or {}
		local sd = qi.Sides or {}
		sig = sig .. q.Id .. (counts[q.Id] or 0) .. tostring(qi.Host) .. tostring(qi.Map) .. tostring(sd[1]) .. tostring(sd[2])
	end
	if sig == matchSig then
		return
	end
	matchSig = sig
	clear(matchBody)
	local order = 0
	local function nextOrder()
		order = order + 1
		return order
	end

	label(matchBody, { Text = "대기 중인 배틀", TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = nextOrder() })
	local any = false
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		local n = counts[q.Id] or 0
		if n > 0 or mine == q.Id then
			any = true
			local qi = info[q.Id] or {}
			local joined = mine == q.Id
			local b = button(matchBody, "", joined and C.Pink or C.Panel2, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 62), LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), Text = "" })
			label(b, { Text = queueTitle(q) .. (q.Ranked and "  [랭크]" or ""), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 20, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 6),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 26) })
			label(b, { Text = string.format("%s  ·  %s", qi.Host or "-", qi.Map or "-"), TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = joined and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or C.Sub,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 34), Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 20), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })
			local sd = qi.Sides
			local countText = sd and string.format("A %d/%d · B %d/%d", sd[1] or 0, q.TeamSize, sd[2] or 0, q.TeamSize) or string.format("%d명 대기", n)
			label(b, { Text = countText, TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = C.Gold, Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(136, 24),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right })
			-- 대기 취소는 발판에서 내려오면 됨 (나가기 버튼 없음)
			local status = joined and ((mySide == 1 and "A존 대기 중") or (mySide == 2 and "B존 대기 중") or "대기 중") or "참가 >"
			label(b, { Text = status, TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 34),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(136, 20), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right })
			if not joined then
				b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					remotes.Queue:FireServer(q.Id)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	if not any then
		label(matchBody, { Text = "지금 대기 중인 배틀이 없어요 — 아래에서 새로 시작하세요", TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = C.Sub, TextWrapped = true,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), LayoutOrder = nextOrder() })
	end

	-- 방장 맵 선택
	if mine then
		local qi = info[mine] or {}
		if qi.HostId == player.UserId and s and s.Maps then
			label(matchBody, { Text = "방장 — 맵을 고르세요", TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = C.Gold, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), LayoutOrder = nextOrder() })
			local row = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder() }, matchBody)
			make("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6) }, row)
			local opts = { { nil, "순환" }, { "random", "랜덤" } }
			for _, m in ipairs(s.Maps) do
				table.insert(opts, { m.Id, m.Name })
			end
			local w = 1 / #opts
			for _, o in ipairs(opts) do
				local sel = (qi.MapId == o[1])
				local mb = button(row, o[2], sel and C.Cyan or C.Panel2, { Size = UDim2.new(w, -6, 1, 0), TextSize = 15, TextWrapped = true })
				mb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					remotes.Queue:FireServer("map", o[1])
				end)
			end
			-- 정원이 다 모이면 카운트다운 없이 바로 시작
			local n = counts[mine] or 0
			if qi.Full then
				local go = button(matchBody, "> 바로 시작 (정원 " .. n .. "/" .. tostring(qi.Capacity) .. ")", C.Pink,
					{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), TextSize = 19 })
				go.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					remotes.Queue:FireServer("startNow")
				end)
			else
				label(matchBody, { Text = string.format("정원 %d / %d — 모두 모이면 '바로 시작' 버튼이 생겨요 (빈자리는 봇)", n, qi.Capacity or 0), TextSize = 15,
					TextColor3 = C.Sub, TextWrapped = true, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), LayoutOrder = nextOrder() })
			end
		end
	end

	label(matchBody, { Text = "새 배틀 시작", TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = nextOrder() })
	local grid = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder() }, matchBody)
	make("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 44), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, grid)
	for i, q in ipairs(Config.Queues) do
		local qb = button(grid, queueTitle(q), (mine == q.Id) and C.Pink or C.Panel, { TextSize = 15, LayoutOrder = i, TextWrapped = true })
		UI.stroke(qb, C.Dim, 1, 0.3)
		qb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			remotes.Queue:FireServer(q.Id)
		end)
	end
end

local function refreshStatus()
	local s = lastState
	local mine = player:GetAttribute("Queue")
	if not s then
		statusLbl.Text = ""
	elseif s.Phase == "Countdown" then
		local qi = s.QueueInfo and s.QueueInfo[s.QueueId] or {}
		statusLbl.Text = string.format("%s 시작까지 %d초 · 맵 %s", s.QueueId or "", math.max(0, math.ceil(s.EndsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())), qi.Map or "")
	elseif s.Phase == "Playing" or s.Phase == "Results" then
		statusLbl.Text = "다른 경기 진행 중 — 대기하면 다음 판에 참가해요"
	else
		statusLbl.Text = mine and "참가자를 기다리는 중... 발판에서 내려오면 취소" or "발판을 밟거나 아래에서 배틀을 고르세요"
	end
end

function Lobby.OnState(s)
	lastState = s
	local inMatch = player:GetAttribute("InMatch") == true

Client.Name: MapInteract
Client.Source:
-- 맵 장치(클라이언트): 점프패드 발사, 집라인 탑승
-- 캐릭터 물리는 클라이언트 소유라서 플레이어 이동은 여기서 처리 (봇은 서버 MapBuilder가 처리)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local MapInteract = {}

local Effects
local lastPad = 0
local riding = nil -- { From, To, T, Len }
local rideSound = nil
local ZIP_SPEED = 48
local HANG = 3.5

local function rootAndHum()
	local c = player.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function checkPads()
	if os.clock() - lastPad < 0.8 then
		return
	end
	local root, hum = rootAndHum()
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	for _, pad in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SF_JumpPad")) do
		local localPos = pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
		if math.abs(localPos.X) < pad.Size.X / 2 + 0.5 and math.abs(localPos.Z) < pad.Size.Z / 2 + 0.5 and localPos.Y > 0 and localPos.Y < 5 then
			local launch = pad:GetAttribute("Launch")
			if launch then
				lastPad = os.clock()
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launch
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
				Effects.Splash(pad.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), pad.Color, 3)
				SoundBank.Play("jump_pad", nil, 0.8)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

local function stopRide(jumpOff)
	if not riding then
		return
	end
	local root, hum = rootAndHum()
	local dir = (riding.To - riding.From).Unit
	riding = nil
	if rideSound then
		rideSound:Destroy()
		rideSound = nil
	end
	SoundBank.Play("land", nil, 0.5)
	if root then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * ZIP_SPEED * 0.6 + Vector3.new(0, jumpOff and 30 or 0, 0)
	end
	if hum then
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end
end

local function startRide(pole)
	local from, to = pole:GetAttribute("ZipFrom"), pole:GetAttribute("ZipTo")
	local root, hum = rootAndHum()
	if not from or not to or not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or riding then
		return
	end
	riding = { From = from, To = to, T = 0, Len = (to - from).Magnitude }
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	SoundBank.Play("zipline_start", nil, 0.7)
	rideSound = SoundBank.Play("zipline_ride", nil, 0.45, 1, true)
end

local function updateRide(dt)
	if not riding then
		return
	end
	local root, hum = rootAndHum()
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		riding = nil
		if rideSound then
			rideSound:Destroy()
			rideSound = nil
		end
		return
	end
	riding.T = riding.T + (ZIP_SPEED * dt) / riding.Len
	if riding.T >= 1 then
		stopRide(false)
		return
	end
	local p = riding.From:Lerp(riding.To, riding.T) - Vector3.new(0, HANG, 0)
	-- 위치만 강제하고 회전은 그대로 → 1인칭으로 주변을 보며 공중에서 사격 가능
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * root.CFrame.Rotation
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (riding.To - riding.From).Unit * ZIP_SPEED
end

-- 로비 진열대 총 회전 (Spin 속성 = 초당 각도). 서버는 그대로 두고 화면에서만 돌림
local spinners = {}
local function addSpinner(m)
	if m:IsA("Model") and m:GetAttribute("Spin") and not spinners[m] then
		spinners[m] = { Base = m:GetPivot(), Speed = m:GetAttribute("Spin"), T = math.random() * 10 }
	end
end
local function startSpinners()
	local lobby = workspace:WaitForChild("Lobby", 30)
	if not lobby then
		return
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(lobby:GetDescendants()) do
		addSpinner(d)
	end
	lobby.DescendantAdded:Connect(addSpinner)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		for m, sp in pairs(spinners) do
			if not m.Parent then
				spinners[m] = nil
			else
				sp.T = sp.T + dt
				m:PivotTo(sp.Base * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(sp.T * 1.6) * 0.35, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(sp.Speed * sp.T), 0))
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MapInteract.Init(effects)
	Effects = effects
	task.spawn(startSpinners)
	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, who)
		if who ~= player then
			return
		end
		local pole = prompt.Parent
		if pole and CollectionService:HasTag(pole, "SF_Zipline") then
			startRide(pole)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and riding and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA) then
			stopRide(true) -- 스페이스로 중간에 뛰어내리기
		end
	end)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		riding = nil
		if rideSound then
			rideSound:Destroy()
			rideSound = nil
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		updateRide(dt)
		if not riding then
			checkPads()
		end
	end)
end

function MapInteract.IsRiding()
	return riding ~= nil
end

return MapInteract

Client.Name: MusicPlayer
Client.Source:
-- 맵별 배경음악: 로비 → lobby, 크로마 스퀘어 → chroma, 스카이 루프탑 → sky, 결과 → victory/defeat 징글
-- 파이널 스플래시(마지막 30초)에는 템포를 올림. 음원 ID는 AssetIds.Music (업로드 전이면 무음)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local AssetIds = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AssetIds)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local MusicPlayer = {}

local MAP_TRACK = { ChromaSquare = "chroma", SkyRooftop = "sky" }
local loop, jingle
local current = nil
local jinglePlaying = false

local function idOf(track)
	local id = AssetIds.Music[track]
	if id and id ~= 0 then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. id
	end
	return nil
end

local function setTrack(track)
	if track == current then
		return
	end
	current = track
	local id = track and idOf(track)
	if not id then
		loop:Stop()
		return
	end
	-- 짧게 줄였다가 새 곡으로
	TweenService:Create(loop, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Volume = 0 }):Play()
	task.delay(0.4, function()
		if current ~= track then
			return
		end
		loop.SoundId = id
		loop.TimePosition = 0
		loop:Play()
		TweenService:Create(loop, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { Volume = Config.Music.Volume }):Play()
	end)
end

function MusicPlayer.Init()
	loop = Instance.new("Sound")
	loop.Name = "SplashMusic"
	loop.Looped = true
	loop.Volume = Config.Music.Volume
	loop.Parent = SoundService
	jingle = Instance.new("Sound")
	jingle.Name = "SplashJingle"
	jingle.Volume = Config.Music.Volume + 0.2
	jingle.Parent = SoundService
	jingle.Ended:Connect(function()
		jinglePlaying = false
	end)
end

function MusicPlayer.OnState(s)
	if jinglePlaying then
		return
	end
	local inMatch = player:GetAttribute("InMatch") == true
	if inMatch and (s.Phase == "Playing" or s.Phase == "Results") then
		setTrack(MAP_TRACK[s.MapId] or "chroma")
	else
		setTrack("lobby")
	end
	loop.PlaybackSpeed = (inMatch and s.FinalSplash and s.Phase == "Playing") and Config.Music.FinalSplashSpeed or 1
end

-- 결과 화면: 승리/패배 징글 (음악은 잠깐 멈춤)
function MusicPlayer.PlayResult(won)
	local id = idOf(won and "victory" or "defeat")
	if not id then
		return
	end
	loop:Stop()
	current = nil
	jinglePlaying = true
	jingle.SoundId = id
	jingle:Play()
	task.delay(20, function()
		jinglePlaying = false
	end)
end

return MusicPlayer

Client.Name: PaintVisual
Client.Source:
-- 바닥 페인트 연출 (클라이언트 전용)
-- 서버의 바닥 셀(4스터드 격자)은 점수·이동속도 판정용으로 그대로 두고 화면에서는 숨김.
-- 대신 셀마다 셀보다 큰 둥근 페인트 방울을 무작위로 겹쳐 깔아 스플래툰처럼 번진 모양을 만들고,
-- 칠해질 때 '촥' 하고 퍼지는 애니메이션 + 주변 물방울을 뿌림
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)

local PV = {}

local CELL = Config.CellSize
local NEUTRAL = Config.NeutralColor
local layer = nil
local conns = {}
local visuals = {}      -- cell -> { Blob, Drops = {} }
local pending = {}      -- cell -> true (같은 프레임의 색·주인 변경을 한 번에 처리)
local rng = Random.new()
local GROW = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local DROP = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function disc(pos, d, color, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = "Paint"
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	p.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, d, d)
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.Reflectance = (material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic) and 0.12 or 0
	p.Parent = layer
	return p
end

local function paintMaterial(cell)
	-- 기본 '젖은 페인트'(Glass)는 바닥 위에서 투명해 보이므로 반짝이는 플라스틱으로, 패턴 재질은 그대로
	local m = cell.Material
	if m == Enum.Material.Glass then
		return Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	end
	return m
end

local function clearCell(cell)
	local v = visuals[cell]
	if v then
		v.Blob:Destroy()
		for _, d in ipairs(v.Drops) do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		visuals[cell] = nil
	end
end

local function paintCell(cell, animate)
	pending[cell] = nil
	if not cell.Parent then
		clearCell(cell)
		return
	end
	local owner = cell:GetAttribute("Owner") or 0
	if owner == 0 or cell.Color == NEUTRAL then
		clearCell(cell)
		return
	end
	local color, mat = cell.Color, paintMaterial(cell)
	local top = cell.Position + Vector3.new(0, cell.Size.Y / 2 + 0.02, 0)
	local v = visuals[cell]
	if not v then
		-- 셀보다 큰 원(1.4~1.9배)을 조금씩 어긋나게 → 이웃 방울과 겹쳐 둥글게 번진 경계
		local d = CELL * rng:NextNumber(1.4, 1.9)
		local jitter = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-0.7, 0.7), rng:NextNumber(0, 0.03), rng:NextNumber(-0.7, 0.7))
		local blob = disc(top + jitter, animate and 0.4 or d, color, mat)
		v = { Blob = blob, Size = d, Drops = {} }
		visuals[cell] = v
		if animate then
			TweenService:Create(blob, GROW, { Size = Vector3.new(0.05, d, d) }):Play()
		end
		-- 가장자리에 흩뿌린 물방울
		if rng:NextNumber() < 0.35 then
			for _ = 1, rng:NextInteger(1, 2) do
				local a = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
				local r = CELL * rng:NextNumber(0.9, 1.5)
				local dd = rng:NextNumber(0.5, 1.3)
				local pos = top + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, rng:NextNumber(0, 0.03), math.sin(a) * r)
				local drop = disc(animate and top or pos, dd, color, mat)
				if animate then
					drop.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.2, 0.2)
					TweenService:Create(drop, DROP, { CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Size = Vector3.new(0.05, dd, dd) }):Play()
				end
				table.insert(v.Drops, drop)
			end
		end
	else
		-- 다른 색이 덮어 칠함: 색을 바꾸고 살짝 '퐁' 튀게
		v.Blob.Color = color
		v.Blob.Material = mat
		for _, d in ipairs(v.Drops) do
			d.Color = color
			d.Material = mat
		end
		if animate then
			local s = v.Size
			v.Blob.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, s * 0.6, s * 0.6)
			TweenService:Create(v.Blob, GROW, { Size = Vector3.new(0.05, s, s) }):Play()
		end
	end
end

local function queue(cell)
	if pending[cell] then
		return
	end
	pending[cell] = true
	task.defer(paintCell, cell, true)
end

local function bind(folder)
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	conns = {}
	for cell in pairs(visuals) do
		clearCell(cell)
	end
	if not folder then
		return
	end
	for _, cell in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if cell:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(conns, cell:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Owner"):Connect(function()
				queue(cell)
			end))
			table.insert(conns, cell:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"):Connect(function()
				queue(cell)
			end))
			if (cell:GetAttribute("Owner") or 0) ~= 0 then
				paintCell(cell, false)
			end
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 벽·엄폐물 페인트 자국: 총알이 벽·상자·컨테이너에 맞으면 둥근 자국 + 흘러내린 방울
-- (바닥 셀이 없는 곳에도 색이 묻어 맵 전체가 칠해지는 느낌. 판정·점수와는 무관)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local walls = {}
local MAX_WALL = 900
local function isCharacter(inst)
	local m = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while m do
		if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return true
		end
		m = m.Parent and m.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	end
	return false
end

function PV.WallSplat(inst, pos, normal, color)
	if not layer or not inst or not inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst.Name == "Cell" or inst.Transparency > 0.8 then
		return
	end
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
	if (lobby and inst:IsDescendantOf(lobby)) or isCharacter(inst) then
		return
	end
	local active = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ActiveCells")
	local mapRoot = active and active.Value and active.Value.Parent
	if mapRoot and not inst:IsDescendantOf(mapRoot) then
		return
	end
	local n = normal.Unit
	local up = (math.abs(n.Y) < 0.95) and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis
	local vy = (up - n * up:Dot(n)).Unit
	local vz = n:Cross(vy)
	local d = rng:NextNumber(1.6, 3.2)
	local cf = CFrame.fromMatrix(pos + n * (0.03 + rng:NextNumber(0, 0.02)), n, vy, vz)
	local splat = disc(Vector3.zero, 0.3, color, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	splat.CFrame = cf
	TweenService:Create(splat, GROW, { Size = Vector3.new(0.05, d, d) }):Play()
	table.insert(walls, splat)
	-- 세로 벽이면 아래로 흘러내린 방울 1~2개
	if math.abs(n.Y) < 0.4 then
		for k = 1, rng:NextInteger(1, 2) do
			local dd = rng:NextNumber(0.4, 0.9)
			local drop = disc(Vector3.zero, dd, color, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
			drop.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0.01, -(d * 0.45 + k * dd * 0.9), rng:NextNumber(-d * 0.25, d * 0.25))
			table.insert(walls, drop)
		end
	end
	while #walls > MAX_WALL do
		local old = table.remove(walls, 1)
		old:Destroy()
	end
end

local function clearWalls()
	for _, p in ipairs(walls) do
		p:Destroy()
	end
	walls = {}
end

function PV.Init()
	layer = Instance.new("Folder")
	layer.Name = "PaintLayer"
	layer.Parent = workspace
	local active = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ActiveCells")
	active.Changed:Connect(function()
		clearWalls()
		bind(active.Value)
	end)
	game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InMatch"):Connect(clearWalls)
	bind(active.Value)
end

return PV

Client.Name: SoundBank
Client.Source:
-- 상황별 효과음 재생
-- 업로드 후: 효과음 37개가 든 아틀라스 1개(AssetIds.SfxAtlas)에서 PlaybackRegion으로 해당 구간만 재생
-- 업로드 전: Studio 기본음으로 대체
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local AssetIds = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AssetIds)

local SoundBank = {}

local PING = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
local WATER = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3"
local SWOOSH = "rbxasset://sounds/swoosh.wav"
local FALLBACK = {
	fire_pistol = { PING, 1.1 }, fire_rifle = { PING, 1.0 }, fire_smg = { PING, 1.3 }, fire_shotgun = { PING, 0.7 },
	fire_sniper = { PING, 0.55 }, fire_launcher = { PING, 0.5 }, low_ink = { PING, 2.0 },
	hit = { WATER, 1.1 }, hit_head = { WATER, 1.4 }, kill = { SWOOSH, 1.0 }, hurt = { WATER, 0.8 }, splashed = { SWOOSH, 0.8 },
	paint_land = { WATER, 1.2 }, jump_pad = { SWOOSH, 1.5 }, zipline_start = { PING, 0.8 }, respawn = { SWOOSH, 1.2 },
	special_throw = { SWOOSH, 1.0 }, special_boom = { WATER, 0.6 },
}

local function container(position)
	if not position then
		return SoundService, nil
	end
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientFX")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "ClientFX"
		folder.Parent = workspace
	end
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.Transparency = 1
	p.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
	p.Position = position
	p.Parent = folder
	return p, p
end

-- name: atlas 이름(fire_rifle, hit_head …), position: 3D 위치(없으면 2D), volume 0~1, pitch 배속
function SoundBank.Play(name, position, volume, pitch, looped)
	local region = AssetIds.SfxRegions[name]
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Volume = volume or 0.6
	s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
	local length = 2
	if AssetIds.SfxAtlas ~= 0 and region then
		s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. AssetIds.SfxAtlas
		s.PlaybackRegionsEnabled = true
		s.PlaybackRegion = NumberRange.new(region[1], region[2])
		if looped then
			s.LoopRegion = NumberRange.new(region[1], region[2])
		end
		length = region[2] - region[1]
	else
		local fb = FALLBACK[name]
		if not fb then
			return nil
		end
		s.SoundId = fb[1]
		s.PlaybackSpeed = (pitch or 1) * fb[2]
	end
	s.Looped = looped == true
	s.RollOffMaxDistance = 160
	local parent, part = container(position)
	s.Parent = parent
	s:Play()
	if not looped then
		Debris:AddItem(part or s, length / s.PlaybackSpeed + 0.3)
	end
	return s
end

return SoundBank

Client.Name: UIKit
Client.Source:
-- 공용 UI 스타일: 패널·버튼·닫기 버튼·아이템 이미지(3D 미리보기)
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ModelKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ModelKit)
local Cosmetics = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Cosmetics)
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))

local UI = {}

-- SF 톤: 짙은 남색 강철 + 네온 포인트 (로비 격납고와 같은 색)
UI.Colors = {
	Bg = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 30),
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 50),
	Panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 42, 72),
	Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 46, 170),
	Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255),
	Gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50),
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(0, 190, 150),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255),
	Sub = Color3.fromRGB(180, 178, 205),
	Dim = Color3.fromRGB(62, 74, 108),
	Neon = Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 40),
}

-- 글꼴: 제목·버튼·숫자는 두꺼운 이탤릭 (하이퍼 FPS 느낌), 본문은 Gotham Bold
UI.Fonts = {
	Heavy = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Italic),
	Black = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Italic),
}
local ITALIC_FONTS = { [Enum.Font.GothamBlack] = true, [Enum.Font.FredokaOne] = true, [Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy] = true }
local C = UI.Colors

function UI.make(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		o[k] = v
	end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local make = UI.make

function UI.corner(p, r)
	return make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10) }, p)
end

function UI.stroke(p, color, thick, transp)
	return make("UIStroke", { Color = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = thick or 2, Transparency = transp or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, p)
end

function UI.gradient(p, c1, c2, rot)
	return make("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Rotation = rot or 90 }, p)
end

function UI.label(parent, props)
	local t = make("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = C.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 18, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "" }, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
		t[k] = v
	end
	return t
end

-- 둥근 버튼 (마우스를 올리면 살짝 커짐)
function UI.button(parent, text, color, props)
	local b = make("TextButton", { Text = text, BackgroundColor3 = color or C.Pink, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 18, AutoButtonColor = true }, parent)
	UI.corner(b, 10)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
		b[k] = v
	end
	local scale = make("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, b)
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), { Scale = 1.04 }):Play()
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		SoundBank.Play("ui_click", nil, 0.4)
	end)
	return b
end

-- 닫기 버튼: 둥근 빨강-분홍 그라데이션 + 흰 X, 마우스를 올리면 회전
function UI.CloseButton(parent, onClose, size)
	size = size or 40
	local b = make("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), Position = UDim2.new(1, -size - 12, 0, 12), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 50 }, parent)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, b)
	UI.gradient(b, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 110), Color3.fromRGB(220, 30, 140), 45)
	UI.stroke(b, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 2, 0.2)
	for _, rot in ipairs({ 45, -45 }) do
		make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 4), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = rot, ZIndex = 51 }, b)
	end
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Rotation = 90 }):Play()
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Rotation = 0 }):Play()
	end)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		SoundBank.Play("ui_click", nil, 0.4)
		if onClose then
			onClose()
		end
	end)
	return b
end

-- 제목 띠가 있는 패널 (SF: 남색 강철 판 + 네온 테두리 + 사선 줄무늬 제목 띠)
function UI.Panel(parent, title, size, accent)
	accent = accent or C.Pink
	local f = make("Frame", { Size = size, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = C.Bg }, parent)
	UI.corner(f, 14)
	UI.stroke(f, accent, 2, 0.05)
	UI.gradient(f, Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 60), Color3.fromRGB(10, 13, 26), 90)
	local head = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true }, f)
	UI.corner(head, 14)
	make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -20), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, head)
	UI.gradient(head, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 175), 90)
	-- 사선 줄무늬 장식
	for k = 0, 6 do
		make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 140), Position = UDim2.new(1, -60 - k * 26, 0, -30), Rotation = 28, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, head)
	end
	-- 제목 아래 얇은 네온 선
	make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 2), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 66), BackgroundColor3 = C.Neon, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
		BorderSizePixel = 0 }, f)
	UI.label(head, { Text = title, FontFace = UI.Fonts.Black, TextSize = 32, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0),
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5 })
	return f, head
end

-- 화면 전체 글꼴 정리: GothamBlack·FredokaOne(이전 카툰 글꼴)과 SFItalic 표시가 붙은 글자를 두꺼운 이탤릭으로
local function styleText(o)
	if not (o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton")) then
		return
	end
	if o:GetAttribute("SFItalic") or ITALIC_FONTS[o.Font] then
		o.FontFace = UI.Fonts.Heavy
	end
end
function UI.AutoStyle(root)
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		styleText(d)
	end
	root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		-- 만든 직후 속성을 채우는 코드가 있으니 한 박자 뒤에 적용
		task.defer(styleText, d)
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 커스텀 아이콘 (업로드한 이미지). 아직 없으면 이모지로 보였다가 이미지가 준비되면 바뀜
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local images = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Images", 10)
function UI.Icon(parent, name, emoji, props)
	local holder = make("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32) }, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
		holder[k] = v
	end
	local img = make("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Visible = false,
		ZIndex = holder.ZIndex }, holder)
	local txt = make("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = emoji or "", TextScaled = true,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = holder.ZIndex }, holder)
	local function refresh()
		local url = images and images:GetAttribute("icon_" .. name)
		img.Image = url or ""
		img.Visible = url ~= nil
		txt.Visible = url == nil
	end
	refresh()
	if images then
		images:GetAttributeChangedSignal("icon_" .. name):Connect(refresh)
	end
	return holder
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 아이템 이미지: 총은 3D 미리보기(ViewportFrame), 패턴은 재질 견본, 이펙트는 아이콘
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function viewportModel(parent, model, size, rotY)
	local vp = make("ViewportFrame", { Size = size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180), LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -0.5) }, parent)
	local world = make("WorldModel", {}, vp)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, rotY or math.rad(90), 0))
	model.Parent = world
	local cf, sz = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = make("Camera", { FieldOfView = 30 }, vp)
	local dist = sz.Magnitude * 1.9
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, sz.Magnitude * 0.18, dist), cf.Position)
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	return vp
end

function UI.ModelImage(parent, model, size, rotY)
	return viewportModel(parent, model, size, rotY)
end

function UI.GunImage(parent, weaponId, accent, skin, size)
	local model = ModelKit.Gun(weaponId, accent or C.Cyan, skin, skin and Cosmetics.MaterialOf(skin.Material) or nil)
	return viewportModel(parent, model, size, math.rad(90))
end

function UI.ItemImage(parent, item, size)
	if item.Kind == "Skin" then
		return UI.GunImage(parent, "Rifle", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), item, size)
	end
	local holder = make("Frame", { Size = size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, parent)
	if item.Kind == "Pattern" then
		-- 재질 견본: 작은 바닥 셀 3×3을 3D로
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		local cols = { C.Pink, C.Cyan, C.Gold }
		for x = -1, 1 do
			for z = -1, 1 do
				local p = Instance.new("Part")
				p.Anchored = true
				p.Size = Vector3.new(0.95, 0.2, 0.95)
				p.Position = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
				p.Color = cols[((x + z) % 3) + 1]
				p.Material = Cosmetics.MaterialOf(item.Material) or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				p.Parent = m
			end
		end
		local vp = viewportModel(holder, m, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0)
		vp.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 2.4), Vector3.zero)
	else
		-- 처치 이펙트: 가운데 빛나는 구 + 사방으로 튀는 색 구슬
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		local palette = (item.Effect == "Rainbow") and { Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40), Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60),
			Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 90), Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 255), Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255) }
			or (item.Effect == "Smoke") and { Color3.fromRGB(220, 222, 230), Color3.fromRGB(180, 184, 196) }
			or { C.Pink, C.Cyan, C.Gold }
		local core = Instance.new("Part")
		core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		core.Anchored = true
		core.Size = Vector3.one * ((item.Effect == "Smoke") and 1.6 or 0.9)
		core.Material = (item.Effect == "Smoke") and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or Enum.Material.Neon
		core.Color = palette[1]
		core.Parent = m
		for k = 1, 10 do
			local a = k / 10 * math.pi * 2
			local b = Instance.new("Part")
			b.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			b.Anchored = true
			local r = (k % 2 == 0) and 1.5 or 1.05
			b.Size = Vector3.one * ((k % 2 == 0) and 0.35 or 0.5)
			b.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r, 0)
			b.Color = palette[(k % #palette) + 1]
			b.Material = (item.Effect == "Smoke") and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or Enum.Material.Neon
			b.Parent = m
		end
		local vp = viewportModel(holder, m, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0)
		vp.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 6), Vector3.zero)
	end
	return holder
end

return UI

Client.Name: WeaponController
Client.Source:
-- 1인칭 사격 컨트롤: 뷰모델, 반동·탄퍼짐, 조준(ADS/스코프), 스페셜, 앉기, 바닥 색에 따른 이동속도
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local Cosmetics = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Cosmetics)
local ModelKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.ModelKit)
local SoundBank = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local CharacterPose = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CharacterPose"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local WC = {}

local remotes, HUD, Effects
local enabled = false
local firing = false
local firedThisPress = false
local aiming = false
local crouched = false
local running = false      -- Shift 누르는 동안
local walking = false      -- Z로 켜고 끔
local runBlockedUntil = 0  -- 쏜 직후 잠깐은 달리기 속도 안 붙음
local touchRun = false     -- 모바일 달리기 버튼
local lastFire = 0
local spreadExtra = 0
local localInk = Config.InkMax
local viewmodel = nil
local kick = 0           -- 화면 반동(도)
local vmKick = 0         -- 뷰모델 반동
local baseHip = nil
local speedTimer = 0
local cellsFolder = nil
local uiMode = false
local thirdPerson = false -- V 키로 1인칭 ↔ 3인칭(어깨 시점) 전환
local modalGui = nil      -- 창이 열려 있는 동안 마우스를 풀어 주는 투명 버튼
local TP_ZOOM = 8         -- 3인칭 카메라 거리
local TP_OFFSET = Vector3.new(2.8, 1.5, 0) -- 어깨 너머: 캐릭터가 화면 왼쪽 아래로 비켜서 조준점을 가리지 않음

-- 3인칭이 실제로 적용 중인지 (3인칭에서도 우클릭 조준 중에는 1인칭 조준경으로 전환)
local function tpActive()
	return thirdPerson and not aiming
end

local function camera()
	return workspace.CurrentCamera
end

local function weapon()
	return Weapons.Get(player:GetAttribute("Weapon"))
end

local function teamColor()
	return player:GetAttribute("TeamColor") or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

local function humanoid()
	local c = player.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 뷰모델
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local vmMuzzle = nil      -- 총구 표식 파트 (Blender 모델의 _Muzzle 또는 대체 모델)
local vmLength = 1.5

-- 조준 배율: 총마다 ZoomFov, 3배·6배 스코프 아이템이 있으면 더 크게. 반환: 시야각, 조준점 모양, 배율 글자
local function zoomInfo(w)
	local fov = w.ZoomFov or 56
	local buff = player:GetAttribute("ZoomBuff")
	local untilT = player:GetAttribute("ZoomUntil")
	if buff and untilT and untilT > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
		fov = math.min(fov, 70 / buff)
	else
		buff = nil
	end
	local sight = (w.Scope or buff) and "Scope" or (w.Sight or "Dot")
	local mag = 70 / fov
	local txt = (sight == "Scope") and string.format("%.1fx", mag) or nil
	return fov, sight, txt
end
WC.ZoomInfo = zoomInfo
local goldenSpent = false

-- 1인칭 총 모형은 1인칭일 때만, 스코프로 볼 때는 숨김
function WC.UpdateViewmodelParent()
	if not viewmodel then
		return
	end
	local w = weapon()
	local _, sight = zoomInfo(w)
	local show = enabled and not tpActive() and not (aiming and sight == "Scope")
	viewmodel.Parent = show and camera() or nil
end

local function buildViewmodel()
	if viewmodel then
		viewmodel:Destroy()
	end
	local w = weapon()
	local skin = Cosmetics.ById[player:GetAttribute("Skin") or ""]
	local m, muzzle = ModelKit.Gun(w.Id, teamColor(), skin, skin and Cosmetics.MaterialOf(skin.Material) or nil)
	m.Name = "Viewmodel"
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	vmLength = math.max(size.Z, 0.8)
	vmMuzzle = muzzle
	-- 카툰 외곽선 (셀 셰이딩 느낌)
	local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
	hl.FillTransparency = 1
	hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 28)
	hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
	hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	hl.Parent = m
	if player:GetAttribute("Golden") then
		ModelKit.SetGolden(m, true)
	end
	viewmodel = m
	WC.UpdateViewmodelParent()
end

local vm = { Aim = 0, Run = 0, Crouch = 0, Phase = 0, SwayX = 0, SwayY = 0, Land = 0, LastLook = nil }
local currentStance = "Normal"
local lastPoseSent, lastPitchSent, lastStanceSent = 0, 999, ""

local function placeViewmodel(dt)
	if not viewmodel then
		return
	end
	local w = weapon()
	local cam = camera()
	local scoped = aiming and w.Scope
	for _, p in ipairs(viewmodel:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("Kind") ~= "Anchor" and p:GetAttribute("Kind") ~= "Muzzle" then
			p.LocalTransparencyModifier = scoped and 1 or 0
		end
	end
	-- Anchor(손잡이) 기준 위치: 오른쪽 아래(허리 사격) / 화면 가운데(조준)
	local hipOffset = CFrame.new(0.85, -0.95, -1.25)
	local adsOffset = CFrame.new(0, -0.8, -1.0) -- 조준점 아래로 내려 표적이 가리지 않게
	local hum = humanoid()
	local speed = (hum and hum.RootPart) and Vector3.new(hum.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, hum.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude or 0
	local k = 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt)
	vm.Aim = vm.Aim + ((aiming and 1 or 0) - vm.Aim) * k
	vm.Run = vm.Run + ((currentStance == "Run" and 1 or 0) - vm.Run) * k
	vm.Crouch = vm.Crouch + ((crouched and 1 or 0) - vm.Crouch) * k
	-- 걷는 속도에 맞춘 흔들림 (조준 중엔 거의 없음)
	vm.Phase = vm.Phase + dt * (4 + speed * 0.45)
	local amp = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0, 1.6) * (0.045 + vm.Run * 0.05) * (1 - vm.Aim * 0.85)
	local bob = CFrame.new(math.sin(vm.Phase) * amp, -math.abs(math.cos(vm.Phase)) * amp * 0.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(vm.Phase) * amp * 0.6)
	-- 화면을 돌리면 총이 살짝 늦게 따라옴 (무게감)
	local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
	if vm.LastLook then
		local d = cam.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(vm.LastLook)
		vm.SwayX = vm.SwayX + (math.clamp(d.X * 3, -0.12, 0.12) - vm.SwayX) * k
		vm.SwayY = vm.SwayY + (math.clamp(d.Y * 3, -0.12, 0.12) - vm.SwayY) * k
	end
	vm.LastLook = look
	local sway = CFrame.new(vm.SwayX * (1 - vm.Aim * 0.7), vm.SwayY * (1 - vm.Aim * 0.7), 0) * CFrame.Angles(vm.SwayY * 0.6, vm.SwayX * 0.8, 0)
	-- 달리기: 총을 비스듬히 내려 듦 / 앉기: 살짝 낮게 / 착지: 툭 내려앉음
	local runPose = CFrame.new(0.25 * vm.Run, -0.3 * vm.Run - 0.06 * vm.Crouch - vm.Land, 0.1 * vm.Run)
		* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-18) * vm.Run, math.rad(38) * vm.Run, math.rad(12) * vm.Run)
	vm.Land = vm.Land * math.exp(-10 * dt)
	vmKick = vmKick * math.exp(-14 * dt)
	local base = hipOffset:Lerp(adsOffset, vm.Aim)
	local cf = cam.CFrame * base * runPose * sway * bob * CFrame.new(0, 0, vmKick * 0.12) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(vmKick * 3), 0, 0)
	viewmodel:PivotTo(cf)
end

local function muzzleCFrame()
	if tpActive() then
		local g = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("SF_Gun")
		if g then
			for _, p in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("Kind") == "Muzzle" then
					return p.CFrame
				end
			end
			return g:GetPivot()
		end
	end
	if vmMuzzle and vmMuzzle.Parent then
		return vmMuzzle.CFrame
	end
	return camera().CFrame
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 사격
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function coneDir(dir, degrees)
	if degrees <= 0 then
		return dir
	end
	local r = math.rad(degrees)
	local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local m = math.sqrt(math.random()) * r
	return (CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, dir) * CFrame.Angles(math.cos(a) * m, math.sin(a) * m, 0)).LookVector
end

local function currentSpread(w)
	local s = w.Spread + spreadExtra
	if w.HipSpread and not aiming then
		s = w.HipSpread
	end
	if aiming then
		s = s * 0.5
	end
	local hum = humanoid()
	local moving = hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
	if moving and not crouched then
		if running and not aiming then
			s = s + 1.4
		elseif not walking then
			s = s + 0.6
		end
	end
	if walking then
		s = s * 0.7
	end
	if crouched then
		s = s * 0.8
	end
	return s
end

local function fire()
	local w = weapon()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastFire < w.FireInterval then
		return
	end
	local golden = player:GetAttribute("Golden") == true and not goldenSpent
	if not golden and localInk < w.InkCost then
		if now - lastFire > 0.35 then
			lastFire = now
			SoundBank.Play("low_ink", nil, 0.6)
			HUD.Banner("잉크 부족! 우리 색 위에서 빠르게 충전돼요", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
		end
		return
	end
	local hum = humanoid()
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	lastFire = now
	runBlockedUntil = now + 0.4
	if golden then
		goldenSpent = true
	else
		localInk = localInk - w.InkCost
	end

	local cam = camera()
	local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
	local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
	local spread = golden and 0 or currentSpread(w)
	local range = golden and Config.GoldenRange or w.Range
	local pellets = golden and 1 or w.Pellets
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, viewmodel, workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientFX"), workspace:FindFirstChild("FX") }
	if tpActive() then
		-- 3인칭: 조준점이 가리키는 곳을 먼저 찾고, 실제 총알은 머리에서 그쪽으로
		local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then
			local aimHit = workspace:Raycast(origin, look * w.Range, params)
			local aimPoint = aimHit and aimHit.Position or (origin + look * w.Range)
			origin = head.Position
			local d = aimPoint - origin
			if d.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				look = d.Unit
			end
		end
	end
	local dirs = {}
	local color = golden and Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40) or teamColor()
	local muzzle = muzzleCFrame().Position
	local claims = {}
	for i = 1, pellets do
		local d = coneDir(look, spread)
		dirs[i] = d
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, d * range, params)
		local to = hit and hit.Position or (origin + d * range)
		Effects.Tracer(muzzle, to, color, golden and 0.6 or (w.Id == "Sniper" and 0.3 or 0.16))
		if hit then
			Effects.WallSplat(hit.Instance, hit.Position, hit.Normal, color)
		end
		-- 내 화면에서 캐릭터를 맞혔으면 서버에 알림 (서버가 위치·시야를 검증해 인정)
		if hit then
			local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while model and not model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") do
				model = model.Parent and model.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end
			if model then
				claims[i] = { Part = hit.Instance, Pos = hit.Position }
			end
		end
	end
	remotes.Fire:FireServer(w.Id, origin, dirs, claims)

	Effects.Muzzle(muzzleCFrame(), color)
	SoundBank.Play("fire_" .. string.lower(w.Id), nil, 0.55, 0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
	-- 화면 반동은 작게(복귀 포함), 손맛은 총 모형 반동으로
	kick = math.min(kick + w.Recoil * 0.35, 4)
	vmKick = vmKick + math.min(1.5, w.Recoil * 0.4)
	CharacterPose.Kick(player.Character, w.Recoil)
	spreadExtra = math.min(w.SpreadMax, spreadExtra + w.SpreadGrow)
	Effects.Shake(w.Recoil * 0.02)
end

local function special()
	if (player:GetAttribute("Special") or 0) < 1 then
		HUD.Banner("스페셜 게이지가 부족해요 — 더 칠하세요!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80))
		return
	end
	local cam = camera()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, viewmodel, workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientFX") }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 70, params)
	local target = hit and hit.Position or (cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * 70)
	remotes.Special:FireServer(target)
end

local applyViewRef = nil
local function setAim(on)
	aiming = on
	local w = weapon()
	local fov = 70
	if on then
		fov = zoomInfo(w)
	end
	TweenService:Create(camera(), TweenInfo.new(0.12), { FieldOfView = fov }):Play()
	-- 확대한 만큼 감도를 낮춰 정밀 조준
	UserInputService.MouseDeltaSensitivity = on and math.clamp(fov / 70, 0.15, 1) or 1
	if thirdPerson and applyViewRef then
		applyViewRef() -- 3인칭 ↔ 1인칭 조준 전환
	end
	WC.UpdateViewmodelParent()
end

local function setCrouch(on)
	local hum = humanoid()
	if not hum then
		return
	end
	if baseHip == nil then
		baseHip = hum.HipHeight
	end
	crouched = on
	hum.HipHeight = on and math.max(0.4, baseHip - 1.1) or baseHip
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 바닥 색 → 이동 속도
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function updateSpeed()
	local hum = humanoid()
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or not root then
		return
	end
	local active = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ActiveCells")
	cellsFolder = active and active.Value
	if not cellsFolder then
		return
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { cellsFolder }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -6, 0), params)
	local owner = hit and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("Owner") or 0
	local mine = player:GetAttribute("OwnerId")
	local speed = Config.WalkSpeed
	if owner ~= 0 and owner == mine then
		speed = Config.WalkSpeedOwn
	elseif owner ~= 0 then
		speed = Config.WalkSpeedEnemy
	end
	-- Shift를 누르고 있으면 달리기 (입력 이벤트를 놓쳐도 키 상태로 한 번 더 확인)
	running = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
		or UserInputService:IsGamepadButtonDown(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3) or touchRun
	local mode = "일반"
	if crouched then
		speed = speed * Config.CrouchSpeedMul
		mode = "앉기"
	elseif running and not aiming and os.clock() > runBlockedUntil and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		speed = speed * Config.RunSpeedMul
		mode = "달리기"
	elseif walking then
		speed = speed * Config.WalkSpeedMul
		mode = "걷기"
	end
	if aiming then
		speed = speed * 0.75
	end
	hum.WalkSpeed = speed
	if HUD and HUD.SetMove then
		HUD.SetMove(mode)
	end
	currentStance = (mode == "앉기" and "Crouch") or (mode == "달리기" and "Run") or (mode == "걷기" and "Walk") or "Normal"
	CharacterPose.SetLocalStance(currentStance)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 켜기 / 끄기
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local bindAll, unbindAll

local function setModal(on)
	if not modalGui then
		modalGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		modalGui.Name = "SF_Modal"
		modalGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		modalGui.DisplayOrder = -10
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
		b.Name = "Modal"
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
		b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		b.Text = ""
		b.Modal = true -- 1인칭에서도 마우스 커서를 풀어 줌 (Roblox 공식 방법)
		b.Parent = modalGui
		modalGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end
	modalGui.Enabled = on
end

-- 카메라를 강제로 바깥으로 빼서 1인칭 잠금을 확실히 풀기
local function zoomOut(dist)
	player.CameraMinZoomDistance = dist
	player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = math.max(dist, 20)
	task.delay(0.15, function()
		if not enabled or uiMode then
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 40
		end
	end)
end

-- 현재 상태(1인칭/3인칭/창 열림)에 맞게 카메라 적용
local function applyView()
	local hum = humanoid()
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	if uiMode then
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
		setModal(true)
		return
	end
	setModal(false)
	if tpActive() then
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = TP_ZOOM
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = TP_ZOOM
		if hum then
			hum.CameraOffset = TP_OFFSET
			hum.AutoRotate = false
		end
	else
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 40
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		if hum then
			hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
			hum.AutoRotate = true
		end
	end
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
	WC.UpdateViewmodelParent()
end

applyViewRef = applyView

function WC.ToggleView()
	thirdPerson = not thirdPerson
	applyView()
	if HUD and HUD.Banner then
		HUD.Banner(thirdPerson and "3인칭 시점 [V]" or "1인칭 시점 [V]", Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255))
	end
end

local function enable()
	if enabled then
		return
	end
	enabled = true
	localInk = player:GetAttribute("Ink") or Config.InkMax
	buildViewmodel()
	if uiMode then
		WC.SetUIMode(true)
	else
		applyView()
		bindAll()
	end
end

local function disable()
	enabled = false
	firing = false
	unbindAll()
	setAim(false)
	setCrouch(false)
	player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	setModal(uiMode)
	zoomOut(12) -- 로비에서는 3인칭 + 마우스 자유
	if viewmodel then
		viewmodel:Destroy()
		viewmodel = nil
	end
	local hum = humanoid()
	if hum then
		hum.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
		hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
		hum.AutoRotate = true
	end
end

local function onAction(name, inputState)
	if not enabled then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	local began = inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin
	if name == "SF_Fire" then
		firing = began
		if began then
			firedThisPress = false
		end
	elseif name == "SF_Aim" then
		setAim(began)
	elseif name == "SF_Special" and began then
		special()
	elseif name == "SF_Crouch" and began then
		setCrouch(not crouched)
		if crouched then
			running = false
		end
	elseif name == "SF_Run" then
		touchRun = (inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin) and UserInputService.TouchEnabled
		running = (inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
		if running and crouched then
			setCrouch(false)
		end
		updateSpeed()
	elseif name == "SF_Walk" and began then
		walking = not walking
		HUD.Banner(walking and "걷기 (조용히 · 정밀 사격) [Z]" or "일반 이동", Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255))
		updateSpeed()
	elseif name == "SF_View" and began then
		WC.ToggleView()
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

bindAll = function()
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_Fire", onAction, true, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_Aim", onAction, true, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_Special", onAction, true, Enum.KeyCode.Q, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_Crouch", onAction, true, Enum.KeyCode.C, Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_Run", onAction, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_Walk", onAction, false, Enum.KeyCode.Z)
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_Run", "달리기")
	ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_Run", UDim2.new(1, -170, 1, -220))
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SF_View", onAction, true, Enum.KeyCode.V, Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp)
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_Fire", "발사")
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_Aim", "조준")
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_Special", "스페셜")
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_Crouch", "앉기")
	ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_Fire", UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, -150))
	ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_Aim", UDim2.new(1, -230, 1, -110))
	ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_Special", UDim2.new(1, -230, 1, -190))
	ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_Crouch", UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, -220))
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("SF_View", "시점")
	ContextActionService:SetPosition("SF_View", UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, -300))
end

unbindAll = function()
	running = false
	for _, n in ipairs({ "SF_Fire", "SF_Aim", "SF_Special", "SF_Crouch", "SF_View", "SF_Run", "SF_Walk" }) do
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(n)
	end
end

-- 피드백/관리자 창이 열려 있는 동안 1인칭 잠금 해제
function WC.SetUIMode(on)
	uiMode = on
	if not enabled then
		-- 로비: 카메라는 이미 3인칭, 커서만 확실히 풀어 줌
		setModal(on)
		if on then
			zoomOut(12)
		end
		return
	end
	if on then
		firing = false
		setAim(false)
		unbindAll()
		applyView()
	else
		applyView()
		bindAll()
	end
end

function WC.Init(remoteFolder, hud, effects)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	HUD = hud
	Effects = effects

	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InMatch"):Connect(function()
		if player:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
			enable()
		else
			disable()
		end
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ink"):Connect(function()
		localInk = player:GetAttribute("Ink") or localInk
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Golden"):Connect(function()
		if player:GetAttribute("Golden") then
			goldenSpent = false
			HUD.Banner("황금총 장전! 다음 1발은 맞으면 즉사", Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60))
		end
		if enabled then
			buildViewmodel()
		end
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ZoomBuff"):Connect(function()
		if aiming then
			setAim(true)
		end
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Skin"):Connect(function()
		if enabled then
			buildViewmodel()
		end
	end)
	-- 무기가 바뀌면(스폰 지점 교체) 1인칭 총 모형·잉크 갱신
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Weapon"):Connect(function()
		if enabled then
			setAim(false)
			spreadExtra = 0
			localInk = Config.InkMax
			buildViewmodel()
			SoundBank.Play("ui_buy", nil, 0.5)
		end
	end)
	-- 스폰 지점 무기 교체: 숫자 1~6 = 무기 목록 순서, T = 다음 보유 무기
	-- 숫자 = 보유 무기 순서 (교체 바의 [번호]와 같음)
	local NUM = { Enum.KeyCode.One, Enum.KeyCode.Two, Enum.KeyCode.Three, Enum.KeyCode.Four, Enum.KeyCode.Five, Enum.KeyCode.Six,
		Enum.KeyCode.Seven, Enum.KeyCode.Eight, Enum.KeyCode.Nine }
	local function ownedList()
		local s = "," .. (player:GetAttribute("Owned") or "") .. ","
		local out = {}
		for _, w in ipairs(Weapons.List) do
			if string.find(s, "," .. w.Id .. ",", 1, true) and ModelKit.HasStoreModel(w.Id) then
				table.insert(out, w.Id)
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed or not enabled or uiMode then
			return
		end
		local target = nil
		for i, k in ipairs(NUM) do
			if input.KeyCode == k then
				target = ownedList()[i]
			end
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
			local list = ownedList()
			local cur = player:GetAttribute("Weapon")
			for i, id in ipairs(list) do
				if id == cur then
					target = list[(i % #list) + 1]
				end
			end
			target = target or list[1]
		end
		if not target or target == player:GetAttribute("Weapon") then
			return
		end
		if not player:GetAttribute("SpawnZone") then
			HUD.Banner("무기 교체는 스폰 지점에서만 가능해요 (부활 직후 " .. Config.WeaponSwitchGrace .. "초)", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90))
			return
		end
		remotes.SwitchWeapon:FireServer(target)
	end)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		baseHip = nil
		crouched = false
		aiming = false
		if enabled then
			task.defer(function()
				buildViewmodel()
				applyView()
			end)
		end
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
			if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
				vm.Land = 0.18 -- 착지할 때 총이 툭 내려앉음
			end
		end)
		hum.Died:Connect(function()
			firing = false
			setAim(false)
		end)
	end)

	-- 카메라 반동: 기본 카메라 갱신 직후에 덧붙임
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("SF_Mouse", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
		if uiMode then
			-- 창이 열려 있으면 어떤 시점이든 커서 자유
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
			return
		end
		if not enabled then
			return
		end
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if tpActive() and root then
			-- 어깨 시점: 몸이 카메라가 보는 방향을 따라 돎
			local look = camera().CFrame.LookVector
			local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat)
			end
		end
		-- 1인칭: 내 헬멧·가방·손에 든 총이 화면을 가리지 않게 숨김
		if char then
			local hide = tpActive() and 0 or 1
			for _, n in ipairs({ "SF_Helmet", "SF_Backpack", "SF_Gun", "SF_Armor", "SF_Jetpack" }) do
				local g = char:FindFirstChild(n)
				if g then
					for _, p in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") then
							p.LocalTransparencyModifier = hide
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- 카메라 반동: 기본 카메라는 매 프레임 '지난 프레임 카메라 방향'에서 출발하므로
	-- 반동을 통째로 매번 더하면 계속 쌓여 하늘로 솟구침(0.5 버그). 지난 프레임에 더한 만큼 빼고 새 값만 적용
	local lastOffset = CFrame.new()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("SF_Recoil", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
		local cam = camera()
		if not enabled or uiMode then
			lastOffset = CFrame.new()
			kick = 0
			return
		end
		kick = kick * math.exp(-14 * dt) -- 빠르게 원위치 (조준점 복귀)
		local offset = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(kick), 0, 0) * Effects.ShakeOffset(dt)
		cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * lastOffset:Inverse() * offset
		lastOffset = offset
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not enabled then
			return
		end
		local w = weapon()
		if firing then
			if w.Auto or not firedThisPress then
				local before = lastFire
				fire()
				if lastFire ~= before then
					firedThisPress = true
				end
			end
		end
		if os.clock() - lastFire > 0.15 then
			spreadExtra = math.max(0, spreadExtra - dt * 8)
		end
		placeViewmodel(dt)
		-- 달릴 때 시야가 살짝 넓어져 속도감 (조준 중엔 조준 배율 유지)
		if not aiming then
			local cam = camera()
			local target = (currentStance == "Run") and 78 or 70
			cam.FieldOfView = cam.FieldOfView + (target - cam.FieldOfView) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
		end
		-- 내 조준 각도·자세를 다른 사람에게 공유 (상체가 조준 방향을 따라 움직이게)
		local t = os.clock()
		if t - lastPoseSent > 0.12 and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pose") then
			local pitch = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(camera().CFrame.LookVector.Y, -1, 1)))
			if math.abs(pitch - lastPitchSent) >= 2 or currentStance ~= lastStanceSent then
				lastPoseSent, lastPitchSent, lastStanceSent = t, pitch, currentStance
				remotes.Pose:FireServer(pitch, currentStance)
			end
		end
		speedTimer = speedTimer + dt
		if speedTimer > 0.1 then
			speedTimer = 0
			updateSpeed()
		end
		local _, sight, ztxt = zoomInfo(w)
		HUD.Update(currentSpread(w) * 7, w.Id, aiming and sight or nil, aiming and ztxt or nil)
	end)
end

return WC
